What kind of all inclusive has no entertainment?   We saw one person try to use the pool table in the Ginger Bar and the worker said he was not allowed to till 3pm. Poor kid was just bored because there is LITERALLY nothing else to do but sit by the pool. The Ginger Bar also ran out of tequila one night... in Mexico! Who runs out of tequila in Mexico ... land of tequila!? 

We booked reservations at Ceilos and they said they wouldn't seat us at our time because our entire party wasn't with us. My brother was just using the bathroom. I got in 20 mins after our reservation time as I watched them slowly cleaning our table. At Sal's Steakhouse, I asked for my steak rare and it was over done and chewy. Of course it's the restaurant that is not part of the all inclusive. So we paid $380 American for a meal that was totally not worth it. 

The only breakfast option is the one buffet and good luck trying to ever get bacon which would always run out. All of the food was really mediocre except for the oysters we got at Agua Marina which we also had to pay for. There is an oyster bar at the pool but they never ever served oysters there. 

We pre-booked our Covid test time slot in advance but it didn't matter. We had to still wait in a really long line up. Barely anyone in the line wore masks even though the family in front of us said they were redoing their test because their daughter had a positive result the day before. The 4 of us booked online in advance but they could not find my mother's registration form and took 20 mins to re-register her. Why did they have the other 3 reservations when they were all done together? 

I think all of these mishaps I could have dealt with better if the staff was just nice to us.  No one was apologetic or friendly with the exception of some waiters. Oh except the one who asked my mother if she was going to tip him. This was the most expensive resort I have ever booked at and there is absolutely no way it should be a 5 star hotel. The food is truly mediocre, bathrooms in the rooms are dark and grimy, no entertainment, and staff was rude. I would never recommend this resort to anyone.

reviews.author: Jaime M
reviews.title: Do Not Stay - No A/C, Terrible Concierge, Food Poisoning
reviews.text:
We just returned a day early from our family vacation. I will say that a major reason we decided to return early was due to the terrible experience at this resort. I have screen shots of all of the messages between the hotel concierge and our family. It breaks my heart that we want to take our kids somewhere fun and warm and leave so disappointed.

1. The Melia App is terrible, you are unable to use many of the functions. The first being online checkin. We were not able to check in online and I was told from the front desk via email "this feature may not work and we cannot do anything about it, you will need to check in when you arrive". This is find, but our flight was getting in late and we wanted to make restaurant reservations and work with our concierge to ensure our arrival went smoothly. 

2. Check-in takes a long time. We checked in around 6:00pm and it took about 30 minutes. The part that took a long time was another employee would jump in and use the same computer as the gentlemen that was checking us in. Then finding a concierge to take us to our room took time. We had concierge service because we upgraded to the "Reserve" which included this service for approximately $150 USD more a day. 

3. We were assigned room 5212, do not stay in this room. The AC was not working. At first I thought it would take some time, so we set the thermostat at 70 degrees and left for dinner and a small tour of the resort. We arrived back a few hours later and the temperature had not changed. It was 74.5 degrees in our room and humid. I mentioned this to Janick, our concierge/butler and he said it should be working.

4. We did not have restaurant reservations, so we had dinner at the buffet. The food was ok. The wait staff at ALL of the dining areas are amazing and I hope their hard work is recognized.

5. We requested through our concierge distilled water for my husband's CPAP. The hotel responded like they had never had that request. I cannot imagine that no one has ever needed distilled water for a CPAP? I was told we could walk to the convenient store and see if they have any, but that is where the assistance stopped.

6. I then requested to change rooms or have the AC fixed, we could not get comfortable. Our concierge left for the evening and at 11:10pm a maintenance person came to look. This person spoke little English and I spoke little Spanish, so we had to use google translate. He stated he could not fix the issue and we would have to wait until the morning to get it fixed or be moved to a new room. We slept very little that first night, it was like sleeping in a humid jungle.

7. In the morning, I immediately sent a message to our concierge, and email to the website email address, and went down to the check in to explain we have to change rooms, this is not acceptable. Please be advise, we upgraded to the "Reserve Level" and did not find the value in this at all. After all of these contacts and following up from 7:30am to 2:00pm, we finally were given a new room. We were essentially without a room for most of the second day. The only room they were able to offer us was a King room with a roll away bed. We are a family of 4, so we now had to have one child on a roll away bed and the other on a couch. Again, unacceptable, but were were desperate for a room with working air conditioning. 

8. The service on the beach is hit or miss. We had no service one day and then great service one day. They also ran out of towels on one of the days, so we had no beach towels. I cannot even imagine being a beach resort and running out of towels half way through the day. Our concierge told us he was going to find towels and send them to us, we waited 4 hours and he never sent towels, we could not find him or get a hold of him that afternoon. Just MIA and gave us no other point of contact.

9. On Sunday, we went to a local church for mass. I knew we would need to check in at the main pool for our reserved Bali bed between 9-11am. I asked our concierge to inform the pool concierge that we will be there, but may be late due to mass and taking the bus. Our concierge, Janick, responded back that he informed the pool and to go as soon as possible. We arrived to checkin for our Bali Bed at 11:09am and were told they gave our spot away and there is nothing available for the day. The pool concierge tried to upsell us to Bali Bed for $220 USD per day since we no longer had a reservation. I showed them the message from our concierge and they said there is nothing they can do. When I let Janick know what happened, he again went MIA and never responded and never fixed the issue.

10. Just to top off our terrible experience, we ordered room service through Janick, our concierge, on our departure day so the kids could eat prior to flying out. Janick confirmed our order and said it would take 35-40 minutes. We waited an hour and followed up, Janick said he would check, but never responded back. 90 minutes later, still no room service, still no response from Janick after multiple messages. As you probably can conclude, we had to leave without eating before our departure. In hindsight maybe this was ok because my son started vomiting after we checked in to our flight. He had food poisoning from the meat on the lunch buffet. He was so sick during our flight, God bless the flight attendants on Sun Country he took care of us and helped as much as they could. We concluded that was the only thing he ate that no one else did. Thank you Paradisus Cancun for topping off taking our money for a terrible experience with food poisoning. I would not expect anything less at this point.

Any communication to get resolution for this issue was met with "I need to check and will get back to you", but then no one follows up. I also wrote a review during our trip and posted on TripAdvisor and was asked by the hotel guest experience manager to remove the post if we wanted to be compensated for our experience. I removed the post, but of course, no compensation was given. I believe they do this to all of the negative reviews and most people comply and delete their true reviews. I just hope that you, as a traveler, know there are many options in Cancun and I would highly encourage you to find a resort that you will not be disappointed and is responsive if there is an issue with your stay.

Positives:
The front line employees are friendly
The beach is as described and ocean is beautiful
The bracelets for room entry are a great idea because no one wants to carry around a room key
Cece at the Reserve reception desk is amazing

reviews.author: Jose Armenta
reviews.title: Bad service, and they still owe me a refund.
reviews.text:
I visited Jan 16th  for a week with my family. Before we went on the trip one of the adults on our booking wasn’t able to make it due to covid. We asked for a refund and we have been getting the runaround ever since. The hotel was a ghost town when we went and even still the service was bad, our “consierge” took hours to reply. And on the day we arrived the hotel had no power. We arrived at 6pm and didn’t get into our room until 10pm due to the power issues. The front desk staff overall was very unfriendly, and not pleasant at all. I would go somewhere else. 
THE ROOMS ARE OLD AND DO NOT LOOK LIKE THE PHOTOS 

Also PLEASE GIVE ME MY REFUND THAT IM OWED

reviews.author: Navi D
reviews.title: Needs huge improvements
reviews.text: We came for a couple night stay and our shower was leaking all over the floor, the water was leaking from the room above us into our washroom, and our balcony door handle was broken on the outside.  Although my wife had stayed here previously, what we experienced on this trip definitely was not what she recalled from before.  In addition, we had called down to arrange pick up of room service dishes and towels; however, even after 4 hours this was not done.  Furthermore, when requesting our room bar drinks, even that wasn’t fulfilled.  Very disappointed as we have the hotel ample opportunity to correct this.

reviews.author: Armin D S
reviews.title: False advertising
reviews.text: This was a total rip off and a fraud. The listing is promoted as "all inclusive" but it's not. You will be asked to pay for a variety of basics when you have already paid a very premium price, including dinner bills, and subbed charges. False advertising and mis-selling by the hotel and the travel platform expedia.  Nowhere in the listing it was mentioned there will be exceptions or extra charges, nor was it communicated when we checked in even though we asked. Hotel manager tried to make ammends with a bottle of sparkling wine since we were there for my girlfriend's birthday - but we were still charged for a petty dinner bill. Will not go back again, and will never trust expedia or any hotel in Cancun with all inclusive promotion.

reviews.author: Victoria
reviews.title: Worst family "vacation", not worth it!
reviews.text: Our family of 3 (husband, wife and 6 yr old daughter) from NYC, booked via Expedia to stay at Paradisus in Cancun for a week (about $2,900+), we paid extra to be apart of the "reserve" club which at first we were sold on all of the "extra" amenities and spaces and thought it might be worth the extra $$. Now, when we arrived, it was another story. Everything was disorganized and unaccommodating! Dinner reservations must be made ahead of time, there will be no more spaces available last minute (ironically, you can only make reservations the day before which is really annoying). We were sold on the idea of a butler doing everything for us, what in the world did they do? They made dinner reservations for us via an app we could do. They were not allowed to reserve any beds by the pool for us. Are you kidding me? The butlers did minimum and sometimes unfriendly, we are generous tippers and honestly felt it was not worth it at all. We had to wake up early and stand on line to get a bali bed by the pools, and I recall multiple guests fighting over this issue. If you were just a minute after 10am and end up at the end of the line, you may lose your chance of getting a bed even though you arrived on time and waited on the line under the sun. EVERYTHING WAS A HEADACHE!!! It was NOT a vacation for us, instead everything was so complicated and time consuming. We wanted to relax, not have to deal with all of this extra drama and this place simply wasn't it. The "reserve" was a joke, they placed us in a room right above the entertainment area (DJ's, events, lobby etc). We didn't even get to stay in the quieter pyramid 5, we didn't mind the loud music until we tried to sleep at night and it was like sleeping above a club. The food was disgusting, what is the point of having so many restaurants but the only one that is really decent is Mole?? Everything was either limited or reserved or require further purchase, what is the point of paying extra for the "reserve" and there still are limitation (WTH)? Honestly, the only good part about the experience was that my daughter loved the Kids Club and enjoyed a lot of the activities. Overall, we will not be returning ever again.

reviews.author: squee-zbear
reviews.title: Construction at 2am?? Unbelievable...
reviews.text: We are on our first of 5 nights at the Paradisus Cancun and already regretting staying here. Loud construction started at midnight. It is now almost 230am. After I complained at least 3 times, and then personally walked down to the front desk, they temporarily stopped working at 145am.  Then at 2am, they are back at work hammering away, running power saws as they build cabanas. WTF are we supposed to do when the property management clearly doesn't care about their guests? We just want to sleep. That is the lowest expectation of a hotel and they are failing.

reviews.author: Zehra Q
reviews.title: Spend your money elsewhere - you're welcome.
reviews.text:
If you can stay somewhere, please do yourself a favor and do it. Save your $ for a resort where you feel welcome instead of trapped. For one, this is an outdated resort- but I could look past that. Before I begin on what made me hate my experience I would like to highlight 1) our concierge was attentive 2) the YHI spa was excellent- Lilian (my spa tech) was probably the only highlight 3) the room was very clean
Now on to the problems.
1) The shampoo/conditioners are in refillable bottles. I felt both were watered down or just downright awful quality. My entire family's hair was feeling damaged after each shower.
2) We paid extra for "The Reserve" experience. Now we've stayed at other hotels/resorts before and when you pay this extra fee- you are PAMPERED! Not here. Once we entered the resort, instead of walking us to the special "reserve" side, someone at the front gave us half sleepy instructions on how to find our way to the special side. Nothing special once we made it there either, three men behind the check in counter- all look distracted, bored and just want to get people away. Which brings me to my third point
3) The staff! this was by far the most drained out, bored and unfriendly staff in general. I heard other guests talk about this too. They have a "you're on your own buddy" attitude. Not room service- that was always on time and on point but at other resorts, the staff feels like family by the time you leave- they make you feel so welcome. The staff can really make or break the environment. At Paradisus, they break the environment. They will be standing starting at walls but don't smile and look very unhappy. The gentleman who serves ice cream was rolling his eyes at kids. Also, at this "kid-friendly" resort they were usually out of the whopping 4 flavors they offered with terribly generic tasting toppings
4) I have never gone to a 5 star Resort to find NOTHING in the room upon arrival. At our other resort, the staff left cute dessert on our dresser daily. Here, not even on the first day did we receive anything special
5) our mini bar and snacks were not stocked after the first day- you had to keep calling for basic things like water
6) This is not a hotel problem but it does matter if you're going there to "relax" but the beach space for the # of guests this hotel has to host is a joke. The beach is a crammed 0.5 mile spread ....its the location, its squeezed next to other resorts. It didn't matter what time you went, it was so packed there was hardly space to sit. The Cabana cost was $200 per day - and if you didn't get that you are pretty screwed with not many seating options
7) For" entertainment" they have music blasting until midnight in the middle of the hotel lobby. We didn't see any beautiful performances or variety. Just different singers each night. 
8) They only have two pools- one for adults one for family. 
9) You will be pushed to attend an onsite meeting - probably to sell timeshare, but we just avoided it at all costs

There's a lot that made this trip a regret- which is not something I say lightly. But it was a lot of money spent on an incredibly underwhelming trip. We have stayed at another resort and EVERY SINGLE thing from the people, to the pools, the variety of entertainment to the service....impeccable! I never write reviews but wanted to save time (and money) for anyone I can.

reviews.author: Inugapoueteca
reviews.title: Won't come back
reviews.text: We always felt pressures to pay more, everywhere. Lots of friendly people but still service is often lacking in some places. Very noisy, the hotel looks very nice but shows its age nonetheless. I recommend you go somewhere else where they understand the meaning of service associated with such a pricy resort .

reviews.author: cccanada2018
reviews.title: A big NOPE
reviews.text:
I'm tempted to write a big "stay away" review but I'll be brief: do not book there and, even more importantly, do not book more expensive Reserve rooms if you're with you're family. Everybody will be "sorry" and you'll get nothing. No special food, can't sit anywhere with your kids, you'll be ignored by servers and everyday will be a battle to get some simple lunch food.

Concierge support is no good either : we simply got nothing of what we prepared in advanced by email for our anniversary. Many disappointments, many hours spent talking. Again, lots of sorries.

The rooms aren't sound proof, at all. Expect very loud music coming to your bed until midnight, every night. Room cleaning happens at 4pm for some reason so don't expect a clean room before that either.

The Bali beds around the pooks are nice but are always magically "taken", despite supposedly being included. The guy in charge will quickly tell you that for 210$, the bed suddenly becomes unreserved though.

One last note for the drinks : all included, sure, but expect diluted alcool, very diluted alcool. Rum barely tastes like rum so we stuck to beer. Cancún used to be nice but this hotel is a good example of things going down in the whole region. Very unfortunate, we won't go back there.

reviews.author: Alejandra Michele
reviews.title: Waste of time and money
reviews.text: Don’t do it y’all. This resort is basically a D level cruise ship on dry land. It’s next to impossible to make dinner reservations (which are oddly required in order to eat?) - super inconvenient and defeats the purpose of ‘all inclusive.’ Maybe they are trying to do guests a favor bc the food is disgusting (even room service). Everything remotely worth your time is an up charge - also the vibe of the building is dated and corporate, and there are more kids than adults. The front desk staff are unhelpful for basic requests… they are generally nice but have no power to problem solve… there is legitimately no upside here.

reviews.author: Natalia M
reviews.title: COVID Testing Nightmare
reviews.text:
The day before our departure we were scheduled a COVID test. This was held in a tiny room crammed with at least 20 people. Nurses were taking test after test, not changing gloves, and stacking the exposed test trays. We were told we would receive results by 5pm same day. 6pm rolls around - our flight is for 11am next day and we have not received an email. We go to the guest services desk asking for an update - they took down our email to forward the results. Ultimately, our tests came back positive for COVID but we did not feel any symptoms at all. 

We expressed to the hotel that we felt our tests might be compromised and requested a retake. We were told to stay in our room until 9am next day to be tested again at the same location - except now we had to pay $35 each. Fine. We get back to the room and I realized we were not given any procedure as to what happens if we can’t make our flight (no negative test=no flight home). I called guest services and was not able to reach them until the third call. This man is now telling me that we have to extend and pay the “current resort rate” of $95 per person per night. To stay isolated in a room. Amazing how I would not have been told this information if I had not asked. 

9am we report to the testing location for a second test and are told “it doesn’t work that way” and we could not be tested twice. Back to guest services - now they’re claiming they have to request a separate lab take a new test and we have to stay in our room. We asked how long this would take and nobody knows, just “later in the day.” 

I start asking guest services if there’s ANYWHERE else I can be tested and have rapid results. NOBODY KNOWS. Hard to believe locals are not aware of any testing locations off site. Around 9:45 we decided to walk down Kukulcan Blvd to find a testing site. Lo and behold there’s a medical center literally across the street from Paradisus. We paid $50 each for antigen tests and had results within 20 mins. Negative. 

Now we had only 1.5 hours until boarding and had to book it to the airport. Luckily, the airline accepted our test results and we made it back to the states safely. Upon reflection, it feels as things went one of two ways - A) there is an extreme organization and communication problem between guest services and the testing center. Very hard to believe considering we’re 2 years into COVID and workers are acting as if this is the first time it’s happened. Or B) the hotel falsified positive test results to force us to pay an additional $200 a night while we would have quarantined. Mind you, each test during our quarantine would have run us $35 per person because apparently only the FIRST COVID test is free at the hotel. 

We strongly feel like it’s option B, sadly. We are two 23 year olds but we’re not stupid. Luckily we thought of testing offsite. Otherwise, we’d be stranded in Mexico dropping an additional thousands of dollars. 

Be careful traveling abroad. Upon doing further research I’ve discovered this is a recurring instance for travelers.

reviews.author: Francesca Z
reviews.title: Don’t stay at Melia Resort or Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: The staff who works the pool, bar, restaurants were fantastic but the management just awful.  Melia is awful too.  We had the presidential suite and 4 deluxe reserve ocean view rooms and both Melia and Paradisus management were just horrendous.  They lie and gave away our rooms and wouldn’t honor what we had paid for.  Don’t they know that they are in the customer service business.   Such a shame that they just didn’t care.

reviews.author: Esteban
reviews.title: Do not recommend. False advertising.
reviews.text:
Paid for an upgraded suite. None of the benefits for the “Reserve” were available. Paid double for no reason. No explanations available including vip check in, concierge service, butler service, specialty restaurants and private Lounges. Additionally regular restaurants were not open and others had no menu. “Family style” very poor food. Pursuing a chargeback with my credit card company.  

The upgraded “Reserve” only Asian restaurant had  pork ribs, white fish and steak for everyone. No options available.

reviews.author: oh_indi
reviews.title: **STAY AWAY FROM THIS RESORT**
reviews.text:
My family had the worst experience at this resort. I'll never go back or recommend this to ANYONE. Let me break down the details of everything that went wrong.  We booked the reserve level. Comes with private check in and a concierge to help book dinner reservations, cabanas etc. 
**1. Check in took 45 min. We arrived and were sent to " The reserve" reception area where we meet Alejandro. Alejandro had no idea what he was doing. Kept stopping to help other people instead of finishing helping us check in. He even stopped helping us to ask his coworker how his day was and what his plans were for the weekend while we're sitting in front of his desk desperately wanting to get our rooms after a 5 hour flight and an infant with a dirty diaper. We didn't get any booklet or paper with our room number, restaurant info or wifi password. He ripped the corner off a piece of paper and wrote it on that after we asked him for info.
**2. We never got a concierge assigned. I had to call the from desk multiple times and everyone kept promising a call back with a name. Once we did get a name 2 days later VICTOR never contacted us. A nice gentleman working the front desk ANTONIO gave us his contact info and he ended up helping us after our hunt for a concierge didn't come up fruitful.
**3. The service...... smh. We went to the buffet after our check in ordeal we get seated order drinks and they came 30 minutes later. Same server had a table seated 2 minutes AFTER us of White English speaker and they got their drinks in 2 minutes. The difference in serves for Spanish speakers vs White English speaker was blatantly obvious. What a shame to be discriminated in your own country. 
**4. The shower flooded. The restroom door didn't close and the ceiling plaster was falling and had a mess all over the floor. Maintenance had to come fix the ceiling and unclog the drain. The drain kept getting clogged but at that point we were just to fed up to call maintenance a 3rd time.
**5. We leave the resort for an all day excursion to come back and not be able to get into our rooms. Our keys didn't work and it took again 30 min for someone to come let us in. This happened twice during our 6 day stay. We had to go get our access bracelets reprogrammed. 
**6. They book large groups and block access to the restaurants to the regular guests and only allow access to the group guests. So basically you can only eat at the buffet. Which doesn't make sense because everyone paid for access not just the group guests. I'm sure that's some kind of breach of Contact. 
**7. The front desk staff isn't friendly. No one greats you everyone tries to pass you off to the next person instead of trying to help you. 
That Norma lady has a terrible attitude probably shouldn't work in hospitality. 
**8. There is construction in the middle of the hotel that wasn't disclosed at booking. 
**I hated this place. Day 2 I wanted to leave**
Towards the end after my mom and I complained  to a gentleman names Alexis. Things get SLIGHTLY better. But it was to little too late. 
The pool was nice and the service there was good that was about THE ONLY THING WE ENJOYED! 
***IF it wasn't for Antonio at reception. Ivonne, Jesus  and Nayelly at the pool we would have DEFINITELY left early. Denise at Enzo was great also. They literally saved our trip. Everything else WAS A SH*T SHOW.

reviews.author: lawrence g
reviews.title: Fake Booze Rip Off
reviews.text: Fake booze. If you have no interest in drinking, this is your place. If you intend to drink anything….don’t come here. None of the alcohol is real….with the exception of beer. The fact that they think nobody can tell the alcohol is flavored color water is insulting…

reviews.author: sergioojeda01
reviews.title: HORRENDOUS EXPERIENCE!
reviews.text: Receptionist experience was AWFUL not accommodating AT ALL, out of all the restaurants the only decent one was Enso, rooms are outdated our room got flooded because of the rain, no compensation for the flooding which caused us to move rooms and took time away from our vacation causing to repack everything in new outdated room and unpack again!! The buffet is not good and the staff aren’t friendly at the buffet. Do yourself a favor and stay at Iberostar Cancun way better resort and better quality! OCEAN FRONT VIEW ARE COVERED BY PLANTS SO IN ORDER TO ENJOY THE OCEAN YOU MUST STAND IN YOUR BALCONY!!!

reviews.author: Qixing T
reviews.title: Be Aware! Don’t choose this toxic hotel it will ruin your vacation!!!!
reviews.text:
11/7 
I’ve been Cancun like four times, and this hotel is my worst experience ever. I booked 4 nights for my family trip and today is only the second day, we all already wanna go home. First of all, the front desk was super slowly and not welcoming at all. The check-in process spent more than 40 minutes. Why? Because the front desk were using 5 minutes to looking for a scissor to cut our bracelet and chatting with her coworkers by the way. She didn’t trying to explain anything except promoting us to book a SPA service. After we went to the rooms, the rooms were old and didn’t look like a luxury hotel room. And then, they spent around one hour to delivery our luggage even we did talked to them twice and told them it’s emergency because our baby need to eat his food. 
For the baby, it also was a big joke. This is a family hotel but it doesn’t welcome little kids at all. They put our room close to a bar, the noise continued until 12am, my baby just COULD NOT SLEEP. omg it’s really a nightmare. Why you put a family to this kind of room? I really don’t understand. And before we went to the hotel, we called them to ask if they can do baby food and they answered yes. Upon we are here we found they don’t know how to make baby food, they even don’t understand what you are saying. We repeated told them no salt no sugar please, and they repeated sent the food super salty.  “No Salt.” Is the two words really hard to understand?
I wish I never come to this hotel, I don’t even know how I spend the rest two days with noise and baby’s crying. 
I will never come back to this hotel and I recommend everyone be away from this hotel. Don’t let this hotel ruin your vacation it’s not worth. 

11/8 UPDATE 
The hotel manager just changed our rooms today and the patio’s chair was broken my father was falling from the chair. The two rooms key broken four times and we just exhausted to go to front desk for asking assist. The most employees don’t speak English, they just talks with us in Spain and don’t care if we understand or not.  It’s just funny we feel suffering in this hotel and wanna come back to home ASAP.  We don’t even want to come to Cancun because of this hotel. It’s not a hotel, it’s a nightmare, it’s a scam, it doesn’t worth 5 stars, Motel 8 is better than this place.

reviews.author: Frequenttraveler3229
reviews.title: Only go here is you want to spend your trip with severe food poisoning
reviews.text: STAY AWAY AT ALL COSTS!!! We chose to spend the extra money to stay here because I've been tp the Playa Del Carmen resort a few years back and had a great experience. My experience in Cancun was FAR from great. I got SEVERE food poisoning from the buffet on the first day of my trip and spent the rest of the trip unable to get out of bed. It was absolutely horrible. The rooms had an odd smell and were dated. The staff was rude. The food was horrible and unsafe to eat. Stay away for your own good!!!

reviews.author: Fred K
reviews.title: Bait and switch in damaged room with faulty appliances
reviews.text: RCI exchange for king size bed and full kitchen. It was neither. Management was going to contact me to correct. Never heard from them. Microwave and mini fridge didn't work. Room flooded in the middle of the night. Called and no one came to do anything about it. Cleaning lady mopped it up the next day.  You could see it was an ongoing problem. Even soaked the bed. To be fair, Pool, cleaning and dining service people were very good.

reviews.author: ajay5112021
reviews.title: Horrible.
reviews.text: This was one of the worst hotel experiences i have had in my life. I had to go back and forth to the front desk 4 times because my room key would not work. The hotel brought random peoples luggage into my room and left them there. We had to call the front desk to come pick them up. During the festival my mother was hit in the head with a door that was not secured down in the festival entrance. The door hit her in the head and landed on her foot. She right now has 4 toes that are bruised and is waiting to go to the doctor to make sure they are not broken. We asked the hotel manager for the report for the incident and we still have not yet received it.The air conditioning in the room and throughout the hotel was horrible. I could not find anywhere to cool off. This was a horrible hotel experience for my family and I. I will not be recommending it to anyone and we will not be going back.

reviews.author: Vero
reviews.title: Noisy, old, bad, run away from it!
reviews.text:
Used to be my favorite hotel and now it’s the biggest nightmare! If you want a nice relaxed vacation this is not for you. Weddings run until pass 11pm on the weekend and you have the music blasting in your room. No regards for people staying here at all.
Rooms are old and outdated. My shower leaks from the ceiling. Balcony door is all rusted. Beds are sooooo uncomfortable. It just ruined my vacation.
Pool… be prepared to pay for 200 if you want to be under some shade. Cabanas everywhere.
No entertainment what so ever. At night they did a silence party WTF is that!!!
Unbelievable how bad the customer service is here.
DO NOT STAY!

reviews.author: MT N
reviews.title: 9/23/21-9/27/21: WORST HOTEL EXPERIENCE OF MY LIFE. 0/10 DO NOT RECCOMMEND AT ALL
reviews.text:
100% NOT A 5 STAR EXPERIENCE. This was honestly the absolute worst hotel experience of my life. I've had much better experiences at a Motel 6

I was here with my friends for a Jack-n-Jill Bachelor/Bachelorette Party. 10 guys + 10 girls. The bride and groom are very organized and called 1 week ahead of our arrival date to confirm and smooth out any details to make sure there were no hiccups. Paradisus Cancun assured us everything was set and in place. WRONG

All guys + bride and I arrived together on the first day and the rest of the girls were to arrive the day after. 

1st Day: Everything was pretty OK at first except the hotel itself was outrageously HOT & HUMID on the INSIDE. So hot and humid that when you walk in, you start sweating immediately to soak your clothes. I have no idea why but the very center of the hotel was set up like a GREENHOUSE. Constantly uncomfortable. Even more unfortunate, our room was humid as well. We couldn't sleep through the night bc of it. I had to call maintenance twice and they still wouldn't fix it and told us the temp was fine. Only until the groom got involved and then finally on the 3rd time, it was fixed. Seriously? On top of that, they gave the guys the wrong rooms. Each room was supposed to have 2 guys per room with 2 beds. They gave each room 1 bed each and wouldn't give them the correct rooms since they were "booked up"

 2nd Day: All the rest of the girls arrived. We tried to check them in and the front LOST all of their reservations. How do you lose 8 whole reservations?? Then they had to scramble and made them wait an extra 2 hours until they could check into their rooms. This was ridiculous, what kind of a "5 Star" Hotel has no idea what's going on and was constantly getting EVERYTHING wrong. They tried to appease us with discounted Spa bookings but they said that they weren't sure if they could get us in because the schedule was booked. ....Then why even pretend to offer us anything? What kind of lack of common sense is this. Then a manager was like ok, for all the trouble, we'll adjust your bookings for ~$900 to ~$600. So we were like ok, can we have that in writing or printed out. They were " Ahhh no, believe us! Don't worry, don't worry, we'll take care of it. Come back tomorrow and we can show you." Suspicious but we were already wasting so much time trying to constantly fix their mistakes instead of enjoying this vacation for the Bride & Groom. So we went to try and enjoy the rest of our day.

3rd Day: In the AM, the girls took a shuttle to XCarat and the boys went to Xelha! XCarat was like a themepark water, safari, zoo experience. Super unique! The closing show is SOO worth it 10/10. Super fun and everything went smooth. Got back to the hotel around 11pm, super tired and drained but we stopped by the front and told them we would be back in the AM for the print-out.

4th Day: In the AM, went to the front once again to check if they confirmed our adjustments in the system. And of course, the front desk ppl still has no idea what's going on and they're saying there's no adjustment and the price is still ~$900. WTF is this?? Called another manager, explained what happened and was told "Ohhh my gosh so sorry, ya'll should be drinking tequila! Not dealing with this!" Uh huh. Then we were promised that it would be adjusted and if we came back tomorrow, the print-out would be ready for us bc they had to wait for upper management to do a final sign-off on it. We said no, we're going to come back tonight for it.

Showed up in the PM, they gave us the print-out. Ok, great, finally. They finally did something right. HAHHH, wrong.

5th Day : This was our last day. During check-out we all showed up and gave them the print-out and the front checked the system. They told us that they don't see what's on the print-out. WHAT? COME ON. Jesus, what is wrong with them? They called the manager, ALEXIS, then the front girl gave us the front desk phone and told us here you deal with it. LOL?! So the bride took the phone and spoke with the manager, ALEXIS and he straight up said "Oh my mistake, it's still ~$900" . We were all FURIOUS, to the point the bride started angry tearing.  At this point we were standing up at the front for 45 min now and the groom said to just leave it for now and they'll email corporate bc we couldn't miss our flights home. And during this time, a line of 15+ people were forming behind us and they still had no common sense to open up another check-in station to help accommodate the other guests until the other guests start complaining why they wouldn't LOLL

They literally lied to us constantly and continuously to get us to shut up and go away. Completely unprofessional and they absolutely have no idea what they're doing in the slightest.

This was hands-down the worst hotel experience all of us has ever had and lots of us have traveled all over. Everywhere in the U.S, Hawaii, Canada, China, Vietnam, France, Germany, Spain, Africa etc... PARADISUS CANCUN WAS AN ABSOLUTE TRASH EXPERIENCE. Totally ruined the whole Bachelor/Bachelorette for the Bride and Groom. Melia is the parent company and all of us will NEVER book at any of their establishments again.

Btw, the managers we dealt with were: Alexis, Daniella and David, all unqualified.

Besides that, the internal buffet, Malva, the food selection was pretty good. Breakfast was better than dinner but the waiters and waitresses there are PHENOMENAL. They remembered ALL of our names and constantly checked up on us. They seem to be the only ones that knows what the hell is going on and how to treat guests. Give them a raise and have them handle the front desk and be the managers.

reviews.author: CSanchez24
reviews.title: Horrible Experience Deal w/ Transfers via Paradisus!!
reviews.text: Been to hotel previously and booked transport via Expedia and zero issues. Today, we are stuck at airport after emailing hotel multiple times and even calling hotel directly. Paradisus still couldn’t get it right. Never staying here again! BEWARE!!!

reviews.author: Robert Glenn Godwin
reviews.title: This hotel is ruined by new Management Mr. Diaz! Loyal employees fired after years of service and no one answers phones!
reviews.text: I've been going here for years and at least 10 times. We last went in April  of 2021 and found the new manager Mr Diaz had fired several long time employees and friends. We returned today and what a circus it has become! Rooms are dumps, phones unanswered and every employee brand new and learning their job. We left and went to Canopy by Hilton. Mel8e, you need to send this clown back to where he came from. He has ruined Paradisius Cancun! 0 stars!

reviews.author: hwassim
reviews.title: Many disappointments
reviews.text: Bad service, no apologies for anything, bad food except buffet, dirty pool, not enough employees, low quality alcohol, overpriced resort, bad beach access, loud construction, front desk takes too long to speak to someone

reviews.author: Marisela M
reviews.title: NOT A 5*** RESORT
reviews.text: I’m currently staying at Paradisus Cancun and am regretting it.  I’ve been here one day and the A/C in my room does not work and my room is very humid.  Out of the 6 rooms that our family currently occupy, one room has a good working air conditioner.  I’ve contacted the lobby numerous times and all I get is the run around and promises of sending maintenance.  DO NOT BOOK HERE, unless you want to gamble on possibly getting a room with a good working A/C.

reviews.author: edb3g123
reviews.title: Property clearly past its prime, on the decline
reviews.text: The Paradisus may have once been a 5 star hotel but poor management and upkeep has made this now a 3 star resort at best.  The facility itself is showing its age in every way.  Most prominently, the air conditioning system cannot keep up with the heat of the summer and my family and I were sweating at almost every meal.  The rooms were slightly cooler but we could not bring the room temperature below around 78 degrees with the bathroom much warmer.  The rooms themselves have not been updated for a very long time and are in sore need of renovation.  Beyond the hotel itself, we were disappointed that there  were very few activities planned for either adults or children and those that were planned often did not take place or were so limited that getting a spot was nearly impossible.  The food was ok although the quality again seems to be in the decline since our last visit, replaced with larger portion sizes.  Finally, staffing needs to be addressed as there are tons of "concierges" everywhere trying to sell a timeshare presentation or spa treatment with no other defined roles but the hotel is short staffed in every other position. My advice is if you can get this at a low price (maybe around $250 or less per night), you may want to stay here as a value but if you need to pay more, there are plenty of other newer, better run properties in Cancun and I would stay there.

reviews.author: Marly N
reviews.title: Bad experience ever
reviews.text: Don’t come here guys if you’re America they are so politics.. some family attacked me and my husbands because their  17 years old drunk kid flirting on me, and when the police came they interviewed them first because they are Mexicans and the manager put us in the lobby for two hours and when police came they didn’t even ask us what happens, they handcuffed my husband and took him to the tourist police and the police told my husband when he was in the car with them you can give us $500 and will release you from the car right now, unfortunately he did not have that amount With him he said take me to closest ATM but they refused and then took him to jail put them in the tank for three hours they did not want to hear our side they are all about money and driving and scamming it was the worst nightmare ever, i was trying to talk to the management and they said you can contact them by email what a shame...

reviews.author: JanyRob
reviews.title: Not as advertised!
reviews.text:
When the CDC announced that the COVID cases in Mexico were rising I reached out (via email) to the Paradise Cancun hotel to ask about the measures they were taking and refund policy if I decided not to go. I have a step-daughter who is not vaccinated and who was going on this trip with us. Granted I cannot force vaccination on others but at the same time I  cannot knowingly expose others either or ourselves for that matter. One of our rooms had already been charged (the 3 person or the 2 Queen room) the other was not. Would you believe the person who I was communicating with via email canceled my reservation for the unpaid room? She also told me that I would get only 50% refund for the other room? I NEVER asked her to cancel. After 49 emails, stress, anxiety, crying and a call to Spain (main number, I could not reach the hotel directly), my itinerary was rebooked (they also wanted to rebook at a higher price blaming me for their error)

Additionally, I had told them how important this family vacation was since my youngest was celebrating her 21st birthday and my oldest had just graduated college but had a virtual graduation so we took this trip to celebrate both. I asked if something could be done in their room to acknowledge that. She said yes that it would be taken care of. FYI: RIU Palace did do a simple yet beautiful something in our room a few years back for our anniversary)

Well then, my stepdaughter decided not to go out of concern for her health.  Rather than go through a miscommunication or the same nightmare again we decided to wait until arrival to let them know.

And so this is where my check-in nightmare began. It took us the entire day to resolve this. I wanted to cry!! They didnt want to issue a  refund for the 3rd person claiming that we had to notify them within 48 hrs and that it was my fault. So imagine how that went trying to explain to them why we had not notified them. ( We didnt know about this policy either).

To say something positive, I did notice that this is a beautiful property indeed. Loved how the lobby smelled and its modern, yet tropical theme. Hot lobby though. However, it is not a place I would return to.

The horrible experience  before we arrived and what happened next during check-in was discouraging. Communication and information is lacking. The front desk agents are cold, not friendly and not empathetic. That birthday and graduation thing… Fabiola at the front desk coldly and simply stated that they don’t do that there, yet I saw it being done for members outside and at restaurants (she didn't provide us with alternatives or other suggestions either). They simply do not go out of their way for you. Alexis did try and at the end refunded some money but the hotel still charged a penalty.

If you are a first timer, expect to be lost and confused. The concierge that is lucky to grab your attention will serve as a temporary guide (first 1/2 hr) but when you do not buy into their membership you are treated differently and forgotten about. Which reminds me, if you are wearing a purple key(non member) you are just another person in the hotel vs a pink bracelet(member) in which you are treated as a guest with all the perks. As a non member, prepare to be confused and figure things out on your own.
Remember how I said that originally, we booked a king bed room and a 2 queen bed room? BEWARE! It is based on availability so if your 3 in a room includes little ones or unrelated grown ups (adolescents) dont expect a room close to you or even on the same floor.  I was given a king bed room in replacement of the 2 queen. The front desk did not ask which we preferred (a king on the same floor or 2 queen on another floor to replace my original booking. They offered a rollaway bed (you pay so much and they offer a rollaway bed 😡!!!) if i decided to keep the king on the same floor. Thankfully my girls are older and so we had to take their room on another floor. Note: Their “queen” size beds are more like a full size bed. The room is small and 3 people cannot comfortably fit in a room.
In our room, the door handle was broken, the AC on all rooms are programmed at 65 so with all the heat outside, inside was not better. I literally couldn’t sleep.
Maintenance was being done during the day (painting and repairs) Not done well to say the least, as I noticed splattered paint on the floor. Construction was being done in the center of hotel as well. Curtain in the lobby was falling off (I have pictures).  I could never get a reservation for dinner in the very few non-member restaurants available so we had to eat at the buffet which offered very little selections especially in the meat section. If you order a drink, you may want to either have your own bottle to add the liquor or just drink straight up water & sugar. The body wash bottle in the bathroom had a broken nozzle and rusty so it shows how there is no upkeep.

There was a tv monitor on Level O which we discovered the night before we left. It gave a schedule of the shows at the hotel. Not impressive. I saw 1 and it was okay not all that ( drone air show) it was short. The beach was dirty (seaweed) but that was not their fault.  The swimming pool was fine but did not smell like chlorine which made me question its sanitary conditions. 

I promise I am being honest and not purposely bashing this resort. I understand that members should get what they pay for and have perks, but non members also pay a lot of money. We save for a year at times for a family vacation. Hence we should also feel as a guest. If not perks, at least attention and respect. 

This was my personal experience. I have been to other resorts and although they may not have been great or had a few flaws, nothing compares to my experience in this hotel. I can ONLY commend the housekeepers, that 1 waiter at the pool and the male servers at the buffet for their friendliness and daily welcome. THEY made my stay there more tolerable. I am just thankful, as is my family, that we went on tours and didn’t have to be there all 5 days. Money wasted!

reviews.author: Tranka
reviews.title: Terrible!!!
reviews.text: Rooms are outdated , AC broke late at night, food is ok , in some restaurants , coffee stations close very early since from 7 am to 11 am , then open againg at 4 pm and close at 7 pm ,,, POOLS ARE GROSS (attached pics), I even got ear infection I had to go to the doctor and get some antibiotics !!! They need to improve a lot .....

reviews.author: Marcelinha
reviews.title: If I could give zero in the evaluation, I would.
reviews.text:
I was staying in Mexico for 15 days for a reason: I had to quarantine to enter in the US and get my covid vaccionation. So my main concern was: staying somewhere where we did not want to leave and where we could stay in a lessa crowded place.
We decided to stay at Paradisus and I made the reservation BY PHONE, for a couple and two kids. I was offered a room at The Reserve, a place in the hotel where we would have an exclusive pool and restaurant, avoiding the crowds. The price, that was already high, skyrocketed, but the promisse for a separate place and lots of addicional amennities got our heart.
It all started in the check in, that was suposed to be faster. It took 45 minutes for someone to even SHOW UP at the desk. The clerk, Fabiola, was very rude and treated us like she was doing a favour.
We went to the room and NONE of the amenities offered was there: no special treats at the minibar, no amenities for kids, no playstation. the kids, who were anixous for that, got really frustrated.
We changed clothes to go to the pool, and then the worst surprise came: we were not allowed to use the pool AND the restaurante at The Reserve because we had kids and they are not allowed. That was a HUGE disapointment, because the only purpose on staying there were this places. NO ONE TOLD ME THAT BEFORE, there was NOTHING written in the website back then (funny that now they mention it in SOME PLACES) and the person who offered me that also did not tell me anything. Of course that if we knew that, we woudn't have payed that much more for the ridicuouls The Reserve.
I talked to the manager who was very rude to me and said he could do absolutely nothing for us and if we wanted to leave, we could. He couldn't even compensate us for the mistake with anither thing, we was pretty clear about that. It was a pitty that we had payed in advance.
But it bever ends: when we tryed to rserve restaurants, we only got reservations for 6 or 9 p.m, all other times were booked before. However, the 'system' was opened few minutes ago, so we could never understand. After a lot of screams, 'misteriously' a few reservations showed up. It is important to say that every night a lot of tables were always empty.
The kids club was simply awfull: Nicol and the other girl, who I dot even know the name were mean and rude to my kids (and to others) more than once. Nothing could be done, nothing was available to them et. I have never seen such a bad attitude and such a bad runed kids club before.
The restaurants were just average: if you went to have lunch after 2 p.m, the salmon was always over. The sushis at night took more thatn one hour to arrive and were always 'hot', terrible terrible. The wine in unedible and so on.
One day, I went to The Paradisus for an adult activity, scheduled to 10 a.m. The guy in the pool, named Lucas, was absurdely rude and said he couldn't give me a chair, since I did not reserved the day before. There were more than 40 of them free and I assured him I would leave in one hour to join my family in the main pool (pilled up with people everywhere, by the way - evrything we did not want). , but I only got one after saying I would call the manager. Then, he found chairs to EVERYONE that was BEHIND me in the line (most of them without the previous reservations, but with one dollar bills in habd) and only after that he put me in the last one, in a place in the shade.
On the last day, we took the covid test and we submited it to the airline company. However, my son's was not accepted, because of an error made by the pharmacy in his date of birth. I asked help to the hotel - specificaly to Eduardo, at the front desk- and he said to me that this was my problem and he could not do anything to help me. I said that my flight was in 3 hours and since the pharmacy is inside of the hotel, that I needed help to correct this, but he categorically said he wasn't doing anything to me, also because I was checking out.
I mentioned above only a few things, a lot of others happened during my stay.
I can only say that I have almost nothing positive to say about Paradisus. We have four familes of friends who are in Mexico now to quarantine and none of them is staying there, because of our reccomentations not to. This was a terrible experience in so many ways, I can't dscribe it. The money worst spent in our lifes.
We will never stay at a Paradisus or a Melia hotel again.

reviews.author: Lisa C
reviews.title: Worst vacation
reviews.text: I’m trying to think of one good thing to say about this resort, but actually the only positive thing I can comment on is the housekeeping.I have stayed here before and had a good experience, but after this one I will never be returning here and neither will any of my family. We stayed for eight days and seven nights and was ready to go home by the fourth day. I came with four family members and a 2 1/2-year-old. It took forever checking in and there was nothing stocked in the room so I immediately had to call room service just to get a bottle of water. to my horror, half the beach was gone and what was left on it was covered with brown seaweed. It was also about 20 feet out from the shore and I was told that because of two recent hurricanes the beach was eroded. My daughter was scheduled to get married on the beach and they did not even tell us. She also had to pay a fee to rent the beach for the wedding and they did not return that money to her. The service was horrible at the restaurants and when we went to Fuego, we actually had to wait for 2 1/2 hours to get our food. I got so disgusted I just got up and left to go see the show. My granddaughter was constantly whining and crying because everything took so long and every single time we went to eat I had to get up and go look for a highchair because my request for one got ignored. I even complained to the manager about it twice. When getting up from the Buffay to go get another plate of food our table was actually occupied by another couple when we came back to sit down even though my purse was still there. The service was horrible down by poolside, because it was like pulling teeth to get someone there to get our drink order. The two days that we rented a cabana we got absolutely no service and I had to walk every 30 minutes to go get drinks for everyone. It was horrible I could’ve stayed home for this crap. I absolutely would not buy any excursion from otium travel. They have a booth set up inside the resort and we booked a sailboat adventure and paid $545. We went to go the next day and the weather was storming with thunder and lightning and terrible rain and they refuse to give our money back. We are still fighting them over this now. I am a club Malia member and I still can’t get help with this. May actually have to go to small claims court. I was actually told that if we would have paid by credit card they would have reversed the charge back to us, but because we paid cash they could not give us the money back. I have never heard of such nonsense in my life. This whole week was outrageous. Never ever again! Find another resort!

reviews.author: evisx21
reviews.title: Worst Cancun Experience
reviews.text: Not the same hotel as it use to be. Lack of service or no service at all. Maintenance of the hotel has been neglected over the last few years, black and white mold all over the walls, falling plaster, leaking pipes in numerous floors. The worst has to be safety, cigarette buds and condoms in the pool and on pool deck were left uncleaned for 3 days. Multiple guests quarantined at hotel from contracting Covid while staying there. Hotel hosts massive spring break type parties in the main pool, with hundreds of people in close proximity to each other. Overall this place is a dump!

reviews.author: Cisem Kaplan
reviews.title: Terrible Accommodations
reviews.text:
I booked this resort for a family reunion for a party of 8. I called and emailed the resort 3 times to make sure booking restaurants for dinners for our group wouldn’t be an issue. I was ensured via email and over the phone that their capacity was accommodated evenly w their guest count. Well guess what? it was all a lie!
Since we arrived booking a restaurant restaurant process has been a complete nightmare. You have to call in every morning because their app doesn’t work. We kept trying the app, good luck; if you select more than 2 people on the app there is no availability. Front desk has been rude and ladies pickup the phone to make reservations could care less! Also checkin / front desk workers were behind careless; we were given wrong rooms and keys twice. We had to go back and forth to our room after our travel to get keys reset… Come to find out, our bracelets were supposed to be the keys. After an hour at the checkin and 3 back & forths later we finally got to checkin. Besides all the negative experiences; there was one thing amazing about this resort: servers at the beach and pool side. These guys have been excellent at taking cate of us. Save your money and go somewhere else if you are more than 2 people traveling!

reviews.author: Zagorki
reviews.title: Second time here was terrible
reviews.text:
I'll start with what made our experience deserving of the one-star review. At checkout, well after checkout, my family loaded into a taxi and before we could leave the bellhop said I needed to settle a charge on my bill. This is after I paid my bill in full with Club Melia (receipt indicates such) and also visited a second checkout desk at the front lobby where I received a card indicating that I had indeed paid (yes, you get a disembarkation card from this hotel in order to depart). With my family and belongings waiting in the taxi and me re-waiting in a long line to re-pay I was told there was a $180MXN ($9USD) room tax that was left unpaid. For someone named "Matthew." I attempted to persuade the checkout gentleman that my name was not Matthew, nor was I staying with anyone by the name. That line of reasoning fell on deaf ears and I was told to go over to the Club Melia checkout and work with them. The Club area is a few buildings over and I was far more concerned about making my flight so I paid the $9, which for some reason required a photocopy of my ID (the previous checkout did not). What truly made this a sickening experience was that while attempting to prove (disprove?) my identity, my family and bags were held hostage in the taxi--they were explicitly told not to leave. I can't say I have ever been held captive at a resort before and I've backpacked through Venezuela.

As for the rest of the resort, there were some highlights during our week there--Kids Club for 5-10 year olds was awesome, the prices of food and drinks were reasonable (we did not do all-inclusive), and we had several good meals at Enso and Mole. The shows were mostly fun as well. Our concierge was able to get us some dinner reservations and other times we walked up to the restaurant and were seated. If you happen to be one of the few people in our boat not doing the all-inclusive, there is free coffee/pastries for breakfast but no cooking facilities other than a fridge and microwave. 

We also had several terrible meals, namely at Fuego. They had the service to match as well. My mother-in-law ordered crab and while the presentation was nice, we were told the restaurant did not have the hand crackers. We're still confused on how she was supposed to get the crab out of the shell. Maybe consider bringing a hammer if you want to order the crab.

In June 2021 the beach was pretty rough and full of seaweed but if you travel a few miles north or try out Isla Mujeres, the water is calm and free of debris. During our last trip here a few years ago I rented a car and I do recommend doing so (especially if being held hostage is not your thing on vacation). Parking is free. This time with the COVID aftermath, cars were scarce and expensive. 

Matthew, if you're reading this bud, you owe me $9.

reviews.author: jonze
reviews.title: Well below expectations
reviews.text:
We came to Cancun with our family for our friends 40th birthday celebration. When we arrived we were greeting by the hostess and escorted to the exclusive Reseve at Paradisus part of the resort. Our reservations were for 2 rooms on the reserve side of the hotel. When making the reservation we also requested to be in rooms near or other same floor as our friends. At checkin we were informed that they could not accommodate the request to close to our friends on the Reseve side of the resort. We would also have to be in rooms separate from our 4 children. Once in our rooms we were interested in excursions. Our butler informed us the there were discounts available if we willing to sit through an hour long presentation of the Melia Circle group, Melia's timeshare program.  My wife and I agreed to the presentation. We figured our kids could hangout with our friends for the hour and we could save some money on the Xcaret tickets for a family of 6. As you can probably guess the presentation was longer than 1 hour, more like 2 and half hours. That wasn't a big deal because we were told that the discount would be 2 for price of 1 and 20% discount on children tickets. So the 2 1/2 hours lost in the presentation would pay for itself in the huge discounts we were expecting.  Once we arrived at the Otium desk to purchase the Xcaret tickets we were then informed that discount was only 2 for 1 for presentation attendees and that our 15 year old daughters are considered adults and we would have to pay full price for their tickets. My wife and I were very upset by the misleading information. The Otium representative said this was possibly misunderstanding on our part because they has never been a discount for any person that did not attend the presentation. 

The day of the excursion everyone was in the lobby looking for there excursion group. Announcements for the busses was being made at the door of hotel lobby by people with very thick accents and no microphone. I found my tour representative showed her my name on her clipboard and she asked me if I had my receipt. I told that my wife had the piece of paper and was walking towards us the Xcaret bus driver said something the Otium representative and walked off. Shortly after driver walked off I realized that the Xcaret bus had left me and my family

reviews.author: Michelle H
reviews.title: Do not stay here! False advertisement, broken air conditioning and black mold!
reviews.text:
June 13-16 2021

Upon arrival, the check in process was very frustrating, taking well over an hour. We were told that our request for a king bed could not be accommodated. Instead, our room would have two queen/full beds. I heard at least three more couples in line being told the same thing. We were also told that we were not allowed to use the adult only pool unless we upgraded to “reserve”.  We paid a fee of $245 to do this. We were then told that there were no available rooms in the Reserve tower and that we would have to keep our initial room (3563) but that we would STILL have access to the adult pool AND the personal butler service. However, as the days went on we never once saw our butler. We questioned this every day to no avail. I find it highly unacceptable that we were duped into paying an extra $245 for a service we did not receive.  When I questioned guest services on this I was told the manager was not available and to send an email when I returned home as I am doing now. The reply email merely offered an upgrade should we return, which I can guarantee we will NOT. 
 
The air conditioner in our room did not work the first two nights. The room was so hot that we could not sleep. The third night it did start working, but to our shock we noticed black mold around the air conditioner. When we told guest services about this, they said there was nothing they could do. Pictures are attached.
 
The security lock box in the room was broken so we were forced to leave it open with no place to put our valuables. We never even received the card to access the lock and create a code. On the second day, after house cleaning had been in the room, we came upstairs to it being locked with our items inside. I’m not sure why they would have even needed to look inside. To get it unlocked, we were forced to waste over an hour of our vacation calling for help and waiting on security. He did open it, however he was not able to correct the issue so that it would properly lock with a code. 

The last night’s food at Fuego made me terribly ill. I have been home for three days now with continuing GI issues. 

We have stayed in Cancun 13 times now and this was by far our worst experience. Go somewhere else! There are so many more options out there where you actually get what you pay for.

reviews.author: tuyet l nguyen
reviews.title: ***Please read before you book!***
reviews.text:
My family and I stayed here during 05/23/21-05/28/21. While checking in, one of the front desk clerk offered an upgrade for premium services with an oceanview for $320. Upon arrival to our room, we noticed that the "oceanview" room that we were told is actually the lagoon room to which we initially had. We immediately realized that the extra payment was actually for premium services being offered specifically to people in the reserve class. Right away, we went to front desk to retract the upgrade, however, they refused. With such false advertising, this instantly left a bitter taste to the start of our vacation. 

The positive note of our stay is the attentiveness of several staffs around the hotel. We are quite the large group and it's nice to see that they are willing to accommodate everyone's needs. Booking reservations for restaurants is nearly impossible as most are hardly ever available. The melia app is complete trash as it gives an error for booking reservations every time. After reading some reviews through TripAdvisor which dates back to a few years ago, it seems as though this problem isn't new. We did get to try enso which has the same rotating menu between lunch and dinner and thought both meals offered very delicious food. Sunset grill and mole were also delicious and should not be missed. I did not try bana but I was told by family members that it's quite tasty. 

Pools are closed daily at 7:00pm (19:00) central time. Most bars are also closed around that same time. Be mindful that the buffet and some restaurants are closed by 7:00pm (19:00) while most are closed at 11:00pm (23:00). If you must order room service, it is free for reserves but an additional $5 each time for the regular guests. People in reserves are entitled to premium drinks, a poolside cabana, and a butler. 

Our family's butler/maid seemed helpful during the first couple of days but was later missing in action towards the last few days. We have never ordered any premium drinks with reserves as most bars had my preference of liquor. If this is important to you, I suggest finding out which premium brands of liquor the reserves has to offer.There is a daily and nightly schedule for some activities but most of us did not partake. 

The air conditioning in the reserves room 5701 and 5704, regular lagoon view 3537 and luxury oceanview 3564 seemed nonexistent. We had the thermostat down to 64.0F and even slept with sheets but rooms were just unbearable to sleep in. If you're a person who could sleep in 79-80F at home, you should be fine. Otherwise, I suggest asking for another room or look elsewhere. 

During our stay, we booked a three set excursion with Aquaworld located inside of the resort for $163-$230 with taxes included. Everything was available except for the underwater scooter due to a large booking made by another group. Some of us settled for the subsee, isla mujeres, and jetski while some chose the speed boat, scuba diving with lessons (+$45 totaling to $230), and jet ski. The subsee was meh, we did not see that many fishes as expected and being at the bottom of the boat can be quite nauseous. Isla mujeres felt more like a tour at the beginning but was self paced during our stop in the northern part of the island. Speed boat was fun but nothing memorable. 

On Friday, May 28, 2021, we noticed that $300 USD from one of our wallets and $220 USD from another wallet went missing. Prior to this realization, we ran into problems with opening the safe earlier in the morning. With such issue, we reached out to guest services to send someone to fix the safe. After our third attempt in the span of two hours, someone finally came to reset our safe. Not thinking much about it, we did not check our belongings. It wasn't until we ate at the buffet where we wanted to tip that I realized my money went missing. I immediately walked over to guest services to report theft. The two ladies at guest services noted everything down, even had security to go back to the room where the crime took place to inspect. After hours of inspection and filing a report, we were told that Paradisus would contact us after the decision of the pending investigation. 

As of May 29, 2021, the Paradisus personnel reached out to us with the decision that they will not refund or compensate money stolen as they did not inspect all rooms of our family. Prior to the pending investigation, we demanded proof of logs when staffs accessed the safe and room but they were so adamant with not providing them. This shows me that the staffs at the hotel are crooks and cannot be trusted. Theft is completely unacceptable and I have never felt so violated with someone going through my belongings. 

Management needs serious professional training. We had several questions regarding the safety of our belongings in the reserves and the person in charge along with guest services had zero answers for them. Management, if you are reading this, the community and myself will need answers regarding the missing cash.

reviews.author: Kimi H
reviews.title: Got rob!
reviews.text: Stay was horrible. Upgraded to the reserve for the amenities and a butler. Butler took forever to respond. It was faster for us to book and do everything ourselves. Our safe got hacked into while we was out on excursions. They showed us the time sheet of when it was open and close and on the day the family was out from 8-6. Someone open it at 12:40 pm. We notice the next morning that we was missing cash in two wallet. Made a report and even went to the local police. In the end they try to say that we took the money!!! The nerves!! I came for a vacation w my family. I didn’t come to waste my time and money!  Food was bland.  Pool closed at 6:30-7 every night. Pool had no music unless you brought your own speaker. We’ll  never come back and wouldn’t recommend to anyone.

reviews.author: AJ M
reviews.title: So many things went wrong for us
reviews.text:
Just had horrible luck at this resort and will never stay here again:
1.  For some reason the power was off for HOURS upon arrival and into our first night there, so the room and entire building (and check-in process) was agonizing.  It felt like we were lied to about when the power would be back on and rooms would cool off, so by evening when it was still hot we demanded a different room in different building.  
2. The AC never would get below 73 and I know there are plenty of us that like a chilly hotel room especially after sun, beach and outdoor activities.  And all we did was sweat at night and it was awful.  My boyfriend wanted to leave to come back home but I insisted we'd make it through.  We complained, asked for maintenance but nothing dropped the temp.
3.  We called several times for extra towels or supplies in the room only to have to call multiple times.
4.  Safe didn't work and it took hours to fix plus two different guys--one to confirm the battery worked fine and another to say don't use keypad cuz it's broken and to just use this special key card.  
5.  The bathroom door didn't shut so there was another call to maintenance. 
6.  The fridge didn't cool any beverages off.  We called and they told us we can't put more than what came with room in it cuz it's just not meant to cool THAT much at a time and to take out our own stuff that we bought at a store.

reviews.author: spiritfilled30
reviews.title: 14 NIGHT STAY
reviews.text:
First of all I would like to say that Alfredo Arcos and Cristhian Lovera were AMAZING!!!! They need to teach the other waiters how to serve because they were exemplary!  I think I tipped them well above and beyond what they ever received before possibly they were that good. They deserve a raise!!! 

Now onto the more bad things that I need to gripe about!  I was at this resort for 14 nights and I feel like I was intentionally not given what I wanted. My family does not consume alcohol at all. We are Christians and we do not drink.  We would only drink Seagrams Ginger Ale and VIRGIN daiquiris period.  Toward the end of our 14 night stay they started telling us they were out of ginger ale and bottled water?!?!?!  What kind of resorts runs out of ginger ale? or bottled water?   Nevertheless, my wife loves caramel in her ice cream or coffee and lo and behold they were out of that too real quick!!!  I was floored. We would repeatedly ask for ginger ales to no avail, or bottled water to no avail.  We finally gave up and started drinking the water they gave us not knowing if that would cause us to have explosive diarrhea or not! We took a risk.  

Anyway, another point that I know is that they nickel and dimed me completely, including at checkout.  They tried getting me for another 200 pesos and that was the last straw!  I also had to pay them a "FEDERAL TAX" upon checkout!  I thought an all inclusive was "ALL INCLUSIVE" including  "ROOM" and "MEALS", no other hidden fees or taxes etc.  I come back today and check out my credit card statement and I dropped an additional $1500 while I was there on top of my existing stay and on top of that they tell me that I need to pay extra for this and for that and they don't have ginger ale or caramel or they are out of all sorts of things.  I was very upset and I couldn't do anything about it.  And by the way I'm not one of these complainers I barely take any vacations so when I do take a vacation I don't have high expectations or I am not hard to please. On top of that the beach was full of sargassum (seaweed) and barely anyone was in the water.  The last time I was in Cancun to put it into perspective was back in 2010!  Anyway, the hotel has a lot of foliage or trees in the middle atrium and they had no AC in the public places it was very hot and humid and it felt like you couldn't breathe.  I loved our two waiters I cannot stop raving about them Alfredo Arcos and Cristhian Lovera were amazing!!!  They would hardly wait til we came down for lunch or dinner so they can wait on us.  Oh another thing is we would skip breakfast and only eat lunch and dinner. So I'm just overall flabbergasted as to why they would make us feel like they were out of caramel sauce or ginger ales or bottle waters because it made us feel like they were out of all that because of us?!?!

reviews.author: Annette O
reviews.title: Management has no customer service  interest
reviews.text:
Cancun

BEWARE OF MANAGEMENT

788481208

Management on this property was not even human.

My husband took me to this property for a Mother's Day gift and to CELEBRATE my 9th year healed from breast cancer.

We had visited this property before and was very pleased and wanted to come back to this location.

On Wednesday May 5, 2021 we arrived on the property checked in had lunch changed clothes went to the pool we were sitting at the pool in the lounge chair all of a sudden something popped and I heard my husband yell get my hand get my hand. Yes my husband was sitting in a defected chair that collapsed and crush his fingers had to have 12 stitches on one finger and the other hand he will loose one finger nail we were at the hospital in Cancun on our first night there all night.

That started our vacation first day crushed fingers. We missed dinner 2 nights and the other nights we just went to eat and came right back to the room at 8:30pm who does that on vacation(nobody) could not enjoy any activities because my husband was in so much pain and heavy medication.

That's just some of the story on what happen. What's a SLAP in the face is that Management did not have it in there hearts to talk or communicate with us face to face at all the whole entire time management sent messages to us on what they will do which was NOTHING!!!

What kind of business operates in customer service treats customers like that especially when their customer gets injured by a defected chair on their property no fault of ours and there's no compensation we were left on our own.

We thought Melia was much better than what was shown by MANAGEMENT in Cancun.

I'M SO DISAPPOINTED IN MANAGEMENT AT THIS MELIA LOCATION IN CANCUN. THE PROPERTY IS NICE BUT MANAGEMENT SUCKS.

reviews.author: missmikki1616
reviews.title: SAVE YOUR MONEY & GO SOMEWHERE ELSE!!!!
