- they were heavily promoting the World Cup - have set up with lots of TVs for their guests.  I am a die hard fan, so I show up excited to watch a game. But their service wasn’t working! So no one got to watch the game.

- time share sales are annoying.  People are nice, but i don’t like being aggressively sold time shares the second i check in. To top it off, what they offer doesn’t make any sense. They asked me to pay ~$13,000 USD upfront for their time share service. Ha!

- very low quality spa. The girl that gave me my massage was good and very nice. But the spa itself is terrible.  The entire time I was getting my massage, I could hear children screaming through the walls! Not pleasant while you are trying to get a relaxing massage.  The “hydrotherapy” is a scam... DO NOT do it. It is expensive, yet all it is is a shower, a steam room, a sauna, and a private pool with jets.  And the sauna didn’t even work, and half the jets in the pool didn’t work!  And the pool smelled really bad, like mold.

- food is generally TERRIBLE - breakfast and lunch are extremely low quality (especially lunch).  Food seems recycled and simply cheap. For dinner, stay away from the Brazilian option - Denny’s has better meats. Vento is 5/10, fuego is 7/10, sushi place is 7/10, and enso is 7/10.  Didn’t go to Mole (their Mexican place).

- speaking of their dinner restaurants, good luck getting a reservation.  We tried to get a reservation at Mole over and over, and they kept telling us there wasn’t availability.  So we had to speak to the manager and insist, and eventually got a reservation, at 8:30pm, 4 days from the day I called to make it (I didn’t make it to this reservation because my baby boy got sick... more on this below).

- final point about the food - I am Mexican, so I am used to the Mexican cuisine.  Nonetheless, my entire family got diarrhea (sorry for the directness, but it’s true) while being here. My baby boy got so sick we had to take him to the doctor. This is why I didn’t make it to Mole - because I was stuck in our room caring for my baby boy who was very sick.  

- in addition to getting stomach bugs while at the resort, my son got a nasty virus - hands foot and mouth disease.  (I have pictures and thought about uploading but they are graphic so I have elected not to). 

- maid service didn’t arrive my first full day. 

- mini bar in room wasn’t restocked first 2 days I was here.

- my key card to enter my room stopped working half way through the trip.

- drinks are TERRIBLE.  Everything is made with cheap syrups and everything is overly sweet.  They do have decent brand options, but, when you’re combining a good brand with cheap syrup, it destroys the drink.  This, I admit, is a common problem with most all-inclusives, but this resort takes the cake.

- WiFi is TERRIBLE - flat out doesn’t work in most parts of the resort.  select areas have good coverage, but overall, it is too spotty to be a good experience.  If you have to get work done, need WiFi to entertain kids, access news, etc, don’t count on it.

- the vast majority of the good areas near the pool are shaded beds that you must pay for. And they are very expensive.  Outside of these expensive shaded beds, if you want to be near the pool, given the limited number of chairs relative to the number of guests, my advice - set your alarm to 5:30am, go to the pool with your belongings, and place them on a chair to save them.  Otherwise, you will not be near the pool. For some this may not matter because you want to be near the ocean, and that is fine. But we like being next to the pool, which was a constant challenge...

- for me this was particularly a problem...  I have two young children, and both are very active. I have family in Cancun, so I asked them to help me find a local nanny that could come to the hotel with us to help us with our children.  And they found one.  I called the hotel in advance to confirm this was okay. They said I could purchase a day pass did the nanny. At first they said the day pass is from 9am - 6pm. I told them I was hoping the nanny could stay with us during dinner as well, until around 8pm or so. They said it would be fine, and even confirmed with their manager. So I booked it.  When I arrived at the hotel, they confirmed the same.  So all was good. Then my nanny arrived... and then they changed their mind. They said she needed to leave by 6, before dinner, or they would charge me a lot more per day.  I didn’t want to pay the additional fee so I explained the situation. They didn’t care, and so ultimately, my vacation was very different then planned.  I love my kids, but having a nanny help on your vacation is nice!  Too bad the hotel staff didn’t care, especially since I had already confirmed.

- if rained when I was there.  Many areas of the hotel started leaking, including next to my table when I was having dinner at the sushi restaurant! 

The service people at the hotel are extremely nice, and are not at fault for the issues I had.  That being said, the hotel facilities, and management, are the worst I have experienced.

And, as you will note from many of my comments, the hotel is generally dirty/broken... many areas smell like rot/mold, the food/drinks are low quality, and when it rained, I felt like the hotel was going to flood.  And apparently, this is the case to a degree that it may not be safe, given that we got sick.

If you want a family vacation, go to the Barceló.  If you want a couples vacation, go to a secrets property.

The paradicus Cancun, at least for me, was been a disaster.

reviews.author: Nilam
reviews.title: Worst ocean view with no view of the ocean...views of straw huts ONLY.
reviews.text: The staff was very rude and it took us 2 hours to check in. Then they Gabe’s us a room that has a obstructed view of only straw huts. The hugest guest manager did nothing for us And stole our money of pizza crab view

reviews.author: gitanjaliraghav
reviews.title: Horrible Experience!
reviews.text: Very poor room maintenance. Coffee machine in the room was not working, bathtub and washbasin were always clogged. During our stay, the last day AC in the room was also not working. It took the staff 8 hours to look into the matter. Finally at around 10 PM we were made to shift to other room which was not cleaned (dirt everywhere) & smelled like fresh paint . My 8 month old baby couldn't sleep all night due to the smell. I requested refund for my last day stay at the hotel and I haven't yet heard from the hotel manager. It was a complete waste of our time and money.

reviews.author: Melissa12340
reviews.title: Awful Service
reviews.text:
I came with 3 friends on a bachelorette stay at Paradisus. We were really excited to begin our adventure but at our check in the person at the front desk said that we needed to have the credit card which we had used (6 months ago) to pay our reservation with. Of course we didnt have this credit card since my friend’s fiance was the one who paid for her trip. 
The hotel said that it was hotel policy to show up with the exact credit card used 6 months ago and wouldnt let us do the check in even though it was paid for and we had other credit cards we could use for backup. 
In the end we had to give another credit card and the hotel charged the whole stay all over again! It is a really expensive hotel and they treat you like garbage; we asked them to show the terms and conditions where it stated that we had to give the exact credit card and they didnt have them. It was all a lie.
If a parent paid for their kids trip or you credit card was cancelled how can the hotel expect you to bring this exact credit card?

reviews.author: lillbit411
reviews.title: UNREASONABLE AND SHAMEFUL
reviews.text: My husband tried to do a nice thing and book this hotel for my 40th birthday as a surprise. Well, he booked it without realizing that our daughter had a medical procedure taking place on one of the days we would be away. I tried to call the hotel so that we could move the trip to the following weekend (NOTE: I DIDN'T WANT TO FLAT OUT CANCEL, I WANTED TO RE-BOOK FOR THE FOLLOWING WEEKEND!) and even provided the medical documents proving our dilemma. THIS HOTEL DENIED ME NUMEROUS TIMES. I CAN NOT BELIEVE THAT AN EXCEPTION CAN NOT BE MADE. It's just unethical. I don't care how gorgeous this hotel is or how many great reviews it has received. It is shameful that they aren't flexible. Even the airline is willing to change my flight! You may not care, Paradisus because in this messed up world it's all about the almighty dollar, but shame on you!

reviews.author: dbbritt2018
reviews.title: Spring Break w two 14 year olds
reviews.text: My first review ever.  We have stayed thruout the Caribbean and Mexico.  Currently staying in 3464 at Paradisus in Cancun.  This place is not as advertised.  Beach chairs are not available.  Beach or pool cabana beds are available at $180 USD per day.  Nothing for young teens to do.  No billiards, no x box, no pool games,etc. No available restaurant reservations!  Only buffet.  If you have stayed at other all inclusive resorts do not stay at this one.  You will be disappointed!! Less than 1 star!!

reviews.author: John G
reviews.title: Paradisus disappointment
reviews.text:
What a disappointing experience. First, we pull up to hotel and there eas absolutely no one to greet us or take luggage, but instead we get bombarded with people selling timeshare. 
Now it gets better......
We specifically paid full price for an upper floor suite and we get a standard room on ground floor. 
Things happen and I understand, but I don't appreciate being lied to.
After arguing with front desk they said they would give us what we paid for but they can't right now because they gave out room to someone else....and of course while I'm arguing here comes the timeshare people again. 
Dining staff lacking and very unattentive.
We visit Cancun every year and typically stay at Hard Rock but we thought it would be a good idea to mix it up this year, big mistake.
Nonetheless, we are still
 here and I will update as this worsens im sure.

reviews.author: Danny R
reviews.title: Stay away! Absolutely disgusting trust me!
reviews.text:
Where do I begin. We stayed at the paradisus playa del Carmen last yr and it was a truly amazing unlike this dump. I warn you this is nothing like that experience and I don’t understand why people give this place a 4 star rating. This place is sooo old and crusty. The start of the experience was supposed to be introductory but all they did was sell sell sell leaving us to try to find our room and the logistics of the hotel. 

The room: 

was above the market grille where all you heard was dishes clinging together all day long. Not the mention it was also above a night club in which all you heard was loud bass and people screaming until 3am. When we woke up the 1st day we realized they had given us blood stained sheets. After giving housekeeping a call they then brought us all new sheets with blood stained towels. (This is no joke) When we brought this up to a manager on staff she acted like it wasn’t a big deal and disregarded the fact that it was blood. 
Room service was unbelievable as they never would show up and when you call to ask about the order they would hang the phone up on you. After six phone calls it would finally come almost always wrong and missing something. The room is so dated you can tell it has seen its time. The electrical outlets/bathroom lights went out almost all the time along with our hot water (cold showers everyday)  The ac unit was so old it rattled all night. Although we actually didn’t mind the rattling as it took away a little from the night club action.

Food:
We were not able to get a reservation for dinner for the first two days because the place is so big. We ended up eating at the buffet the first day and from that point on we became deathly sick where it ruined our entire vacation. I have stayed at many all inclusive resorts in the past and I have to tell you I have never seen or tasted food anything like it in my life. 

For management you are some of the rudest people I ever seen and you could care less about your guest’s comfort. So please save your auto generated response as it is a lie. 

Please LISTEN and stay far away from this place!!! So many better places in Mexico. What a waste of a week of complete sickness. Can’t believe we paid for that nightmare. Literally felt like a ant in a ant farm and we tried to go home on day number 2 it was so bad. They shouldn’t even be allowed to carry the name “paradisus” as it is not even close to a Melia resort.

reviews.author: 335tracyt
reviews.title: Horrible place to stay!
reviews.text: So many reasons why to pick a different place to stay!  Poor food quality, poor service... our room flooded from a blocked drain on the deck... poor clean up and did not offer anything for our inconvenience  Gourmet coffee bar not open until noon!  What!?  Wanted to exchange $100 for $20's.. We were told "no".  The language barrier was so bad that even when they could speak English you good not understand what they were saying.  Will NEVER go back and NEVER recommend!

reviews.author: Alicia T
reviews.title: Could Careless About Their Customers
reviews.text: I received the worst customer service possible from this hotel. My flight leaving JFK was canceled and had to be rescheduled for another time due to weather conditions. As soon as I knew I would not be able to fly to Cancun, I contacted the hotel to explain the situation. I was told to contact them via email, which I did immediately. I also made sure to provide proof from the airline, that my flight was canceled. When I did not receive a response back from the hotel regarding canceling, or re-scheduling my booking, I called them the next day. Once again, they directed me to an email address that I should send my inquiry to. I went back and forth with hotel staff regarding re-scheduling my booking, and they came back with the solution for me to pay $800+ to book at a later date (mind you they already charged my credit card $432 for my booking). This did not seem fair or reasonable, so I also inquired about canceling my reservation, to which they flat out said no. My last email to them, asking them if there were any other options that they were willing to work out with me, has gone unanswered. This hotel claims to be 5 star, but it can barely provide proper customer service to be given any stars. Such as disappointment, as I was actually looking forward to staying here. Now I will never go near it, and I will tell anyone I know to stay away.

reviews.author: OK_Traveling2014
reviews.title: Poor hotel
reviews.text:
Exceedingly poor hotel for the money.

I booked a lagoon view suite only to have a view of a wall. The light switches are cracked and broken, there is only one working power point, the floor is dirty, the safe in the room was locked when I arrived, etc. 

Additionally, the staff couldn’t seem to care less about issues. When I went to check in, they insisted my company had not paid for the room despite my having a confirmation number. They said they would take an imprint of my credit card but wouldn’t charge it until we could sort it out in the morning. They of course charged it immediately.

Additionally, when I went back with the booking confirmation form showing the credit card imprint from the travel agent, they insisted on seeing the bank statement to confirm the payment had gone through. 

My EA emailed them 4 times without response, and I have been to reception 6 times now without resolution.

reviews.author: Lilia S
reviews.title: Grimes old Rooms with cockroaches!
reviews.text:
AVOID THIS HOTEL!  

I’m just going to leave these photos for you to enjoy and judge for your self - would you pay $$$ to stay at a place like this? 

This is Room 3210 by the way,if the hotel management wants to reach out to me.

reviews.author: elar9
reviews.title: Ripped off
reviews.text:
My number one issue was that my mom came down with a bad cold, she went to the hotel  doctor, which we've have has to do in the past, the bill was $600! They had told her it would be apx. $140 for the consultation and medication and ended up gouging her at the end! 
Aside from that terrible experience,  the food was just not good at all! & you have to call every morning for dinner reservations. So annoying! The drinks at the beach and pool are horrible! The juices are disgusting. Ended just drinking water the whole time with an occasional beer. Loud blaring music ever morning by 9am. But the view and beach are incredibly beautiful

reviews.author: P_1015
reviews.title: Badly managed, poor facilities and terrible food.
reviews.text:
This is a massive hotel but the amenities and facilities don’t match up to the number of people it hosts. We were hoping for a relaxed stay but we found ourselves constantly fighting for space - at the breakfast buffet where there were no seats available to accommodate even half the population of the hotel, same story for other restaurant reservations and even in the swimming pools and pool beds which are woefully insufficient for the number of people in the hotel. 

The restaurant reservation system is very badly managed - bookings have to be made over a day in advance, else you’ll pay an all-inclusive price and end up eating the buffet daily. We had to literally fight for a dinner table because the entire restaurant was empty and yet the concierge kept insisting that all tables are reserved. The tables stayed empty for most of our stay. The reservation system is a complete mess. We asked for some drinks to the room and were told that to drink, you have to go to the bar. Very stressful and not the least bit relaxing if one has to fight for food in an all-inclusive resort. When we finally did get a reservation, the things we wanted to order on the menu were not available or had sold out, and the rest of the food was terrible.  We left our meal and walked out halfway through it. 

We were trying to have a relaxed nap but a concert in the lobby made that impossible too - very loud music and extremely noisy so we couldn’t sleep during the day either. Room cleaning was average and on one of the days, there were no fresh towels in the room. 

You have to pretty much pay extra for everything - cabanas at the beach/pool, late check out etc. Again, all-inclusive in name only. While requesting a late check out, we were told that the charge would be $10 per person. What they didn’t tell us was that this was an hourly rate and then hit us with a $40 bill for two hours. Absolutely ridiculous. 

It’s better to stay in a bed and breakfast because that’s what this hotel is. 
We have been to several all-inclusive places, and this has been the worst experience for us so far - noisy, crowded, poor amenities, bad food and badly managed. Wonder what all-inclusive means If you can’t even get a table for dinner at restaurants that are empty anyway or space in the pools. 

At every point during our stay, we felt that we were being fleeced. We felt very unwelcome and we certainly will not be coming back. 

Totally avoid!

reviews.author: Yolanda D
reviews.title: Worse hotel ever!! A motel looks cleaner!
reviews.text: So first of all I am mexican and I’ve been in Cancun plenty of times so you can trust my advice when it comes to hotels, so I did my reservation 2 months ago and asked for 1 bed! I got here and they give me a room with 2 beds and asked Arturo Prieto who was the one to inform me that they cannot guarantee rooms with 1 bed or 2 beds that they only give you whatever is available (so whats the point of doing a reservation with so many information!).. I paid around 600 dls per night since I had an ocean view and I did not pay that amount of money for “whatever they have available at the moment” then he tells me that maybe they can change my room the next day but he tells me that I have to go to the reception and confirm! Seriously??!! So I ask him if I have to sign something! And he said no you just need to confirm it here... So what he means is that he just wants me to spend my time and go downstairs and remind them to do their job!! Ok and thats not it.. here are some pictures of the room.. I think a motel looks cleaner!! Good thing I’m only staying 3 days! I’m seriously grossed out! I think the westin is a little bit more expensive but so much cleaner and prettier and smaller than this huge cruise hotel!

reviews.author: Avideh S
reviews.title: Charged us TWICE for 7 nights stay and did not give our money back!!!
reviews.text:
We stayed at Paradisus Cancun for 7 nights through Christmas and New Years this year (2017), we were content and comfortable for the most part expect for the mediocre food and TERRIBLE service we received at the front desk on our last day during checkout!! The front desk staff charged our credit card twice for our stay and has yet to reimburse us the money!!
We had originally pre-paid a few weeks earlier for the full amount via Melia Reservations. At checkout on our last day, they claimed that no payment has been made and they demanded us to pay again and would not let us leave the hotel until we do so! We kept telling them that we had already made the full payments a few weeks prior and showed them the email confirmation, but they kept saying no payment was processed and they do not have it on record. They demanded that we must pay (AGAIN) until we could leave the hotel. At this point, we were running late for our flight as they kept us at the checkout desk for over 40 minutes going back and forth. We finally gave them our credit card to process the payment thinking that maybe they were telling the truth and we had to leave or we would miss our flight.
After we were on our way and checked our credit card transactions, we saw that they DID infact charge us TWICE! We then phoned the hotel back within 10 minutes of leaving, asking for a refund and they kept saying to send an email to the supervisor, or that they didn’t understand English, or kept making excuses to not reimburse us our money. We emailed the reservations and have YET to hear back from them so we were forced to call our credit card company to have them get involved!! We still HAVE NOT gotten our money back!! Be very careful when you are paying as they will make you pay twice and when you do ask for a refund for THEIR mistake, they are unresponsive!!!

reviews.author: jtst95
reviews.title: Winter break vacation - never again in this place
reviews.text:
After reading all reviews and visiting Paradisus in Playa de Carmen, we were very excited to come to Paradisus Cancun. And we were disappointed on the first day.
But lets do it in order
Pros:
-	Resort is in the middle of resort area in Cancun – 25 min drive from airport.
-	Resort itself is very pretty and large, was nicely decorated for Xmas
-	We stayed in pyramid 3 (center one) on 7th floor, facing ocean – view was spectacular
-	Beach – probably should start with that – is breathtaking – sand, water, palm leaves umbrellas with lounge chair – this was the best part of whole vacation. New definition of happiness is when you are in the ocean up to you shoulders and can see your toes.
-	Have to give credit to Market Grill restaurant – the only decent place in the resort – food was OK and staff was professional.
Well, this is it
Cons:
-	Rooms are very old and need Major renovation, some furniture is broken (please see pics).
-	Food is blunt, there is no variety, no decent selection (did not see hard boiled eggs, for example), not even fruit carving decoration.
-	Tables for dinner were not set even with tablecloth, same old place mats from breakfast.
-	Service in restaurants is slow and not up to standards, and I mean SLOW. We were not in a hurry, but with 2 hungry teenagers it was difficult to wait for 2 hours. 
-	Bana restaurant – was the worst – waiter forgot about our teenagers and their food and they just got up and went to buffet.
-	Small cafeteria with espresso opens at 11:30. Yes, not 7am, not 9am, but 11:30 – outrageous
-	Resort did not have a ping pong table, there is tennis court, but rackets were very old and at some point they were out of balls.
-	Overall waiters are not professional and looked like did not care what so ever.
-	Waiters by the pool and beach were better but could disappear for hours and people would just help themselves by the bar. Not a bad thing – to move around – but it is not what you expect from 5-stars resort.
-	Bali beds were only for reservations (USD 50/day)– and of course they were almost all unoccupied. Not a smart way to do business.
-	Nightly shows…….what can I say ……..there is no stage, so people sat on stairs and performance was done on a small concrete space on the way to the beach
I can go on and on. It was an experience, we still had a very good time, but I will never ever go to this resort again

reviews.author: 657narinei
reviews.title: Horrible experience, it looks fancy yet its so cheap and low quality with an awful service
reviews.text: I wish i could mention what was satisfying about our stay! As every experience i had at your facility was nothing but a nightmare. I chose this hotel based on my past experience with Melia as i stayed at Me couple of years ago. We paid a lot to be simply eating frozen chicken wings and guacamole all day since those were the only edible things after a horrible experience at your restaurants, buffet and room service. The food only looks like a food no taste, no flavor and 0 quality. We stayed at Royal Paradisus yet not only the room was not royal nor was the service. Our butler Giraldo was incompetent and could not even reserve our pool side beds that we were promised we would get for 2 days. What was astonishing was the level of poor service and poor quality food at every single facility let alone the quality of your alcoholic beverages. What a waste of $$$! If you are reading this, i would like to escalate this issue to the management in the hopes that you would compensate me for such terrible experience!

reviews.author: louisu499
reviews.title: Dont stay here
reviews.text: We had family concierge and our bulter was horrible. Not so kid friendly as it should be. Kids pool was freezing. Kids zone was disgustingly dirty. Spa is over priced. Our room was not kid friendly. We had to ask the front desk to take our garbage out after asking our bulter for three days. We requested a king size bed and was put into a full size bed.  Overall was a horrible stay not worth the money. It was my wifes birthday i asked our butler if we can do something he said he will decorate the room, that never happened. For our trouble they comped us a bali bed at the freezing kid pool.  They preach kid friendly and at the restaurant you have to wait 10 to 15 miwait10high chair. Very few fun kids activities. Babysitting was 25$ an hour i thought that was expensive. Our butler would not answer us back when we were trying to fiqure out were our kids were. Our bulter said she will have the bell boy at our door in the am to take our bags well once again we had to call because the bulter didnt. They have dishes for kids at the restaurant spaghetti, chicken nuggets, hot dog, all my kids didnt like. We were traveling with a one year old and they didnt have american milk and both kids didnt like the milk they had we had to get formula for my boy.

reviews.author: Amita P
reviews.title: Scouting for wedding venue
reviews.text: Service is terrible, quality of the room is ok, lighting throughout the property & room is poor. Restaurants not available as per being all inclusive & wedding well pick another location, you will get better service elsewhere.

reviews.author: rsa831
reviews.title: Will never stay there again
reviews.text: Due to their own Melia website error, they charged me 2.5 times more upon arrival. I was able to get the first half of my payment refunded. Its been 2 weeks and their customer service still has not replied back to me for my other refund. They allowed us to leave after 3 nights, instead of 6, because the room was not clean. There was a nail near the balcony, an open water bottle from previous guest, and the iron did not work. The food and drinks at the resort are sub-par. We left and went to LiveAqua (5 minutes away). That place was heaven compared to Paradisus. My BEST and ONLY advice. Spend $100-200 extra and go to liveaqua. I wont go anywhere else.

reviews.author: Sharif K
reviews.title: 2nd Visit
reviews.text:
It was a terrible from the get go. We reserved a ocean view suite and was told suite didn't mean a 2nd living area as we are used to in the US and like we had the first time. I said I would pay for an upgrade but they only available room they could give us didn't have ocean view but the view of a pool (first floor). Anyway upon entering the room my wife goes into the bathroom and finds a lizard, screams and locks the door. I call front door someone comes after an hour and sprays something I don't know but then I go into the bathroom find the lizard again. I put a towel over it and stomp it to death. Took me a while but I got it. 

Maria the our royal service attendant was nice but the rest of the crew that I initially dealt with was flat out rude. Anyway We went back to this place because the first time around was fantastic but 2nd time around was a bust. Obviously won't return there are plenty of other resorts.

reviews.author: Chris H
reviews.title: I've tried to call and email them numerous times and I'm getting no help.
reviews.text: Lack of communication is an issue.  They need to respond to emails and phone calls and make it easier for customers to contact them.  I'm a pretty patient person but when emails go unanswered for over a week that is unacceptable.

reviews.author: minjung16
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun 09/2017 waist of money
reviews.text:
We just got back from cancun and stayed 3 nights at paradisus cancun. I do not understand why they get good reviews from others, but my experience was horrible. Do not go there unless you want to ruin your vacation. 

1. service
Person who checked us in was rude with rigid face, did not have any intention to help. She lied us they are out of bracelet pass(they give you a bracelet that can be used as pass to all the restaurant) when we asked to change it because there were ruff spot on metal part. She had bunch of bracelet right next to her.   
After 30 min check in, a lady held us for another 30 min for timeshare presentation. We paid full price to book this resort. I did not expect that coming. After we said multiple times "no" she let us go, next morning she ignores me multiple times when we met in the lobby. 
Asked for house keeping in the morning, they came 8pm after we called 3 more times. 
They do not know what restaurant is open/close because it changes so much.
Kids club was good except they need to change their floor. My feet turned black after staying couple hours there. 
So, we had so much issues, I decide to address this, all they did was saying "I am sorry" without eye contact. 

2. property
No air-conditioning except rooms. Its true I felt like I am in sauna every night at restaurants. very limited restaurant. They rotate restaurants to close diff days, so we ended up eating lunch at the same place for 3 days. Servers they do not know about Menu so you need to keep track what is coming or not. Portion was very small but often times they eliminate couple orders themselves and then say "it was not in order." last night we stayed, I figured I should wrote down my own order and kept track if everything is there. Sure enough, they missed couple dishes, I showed my writing, only thing they do is "sorry" and move on. 
Pool area was under construction.(Close to kids swimming pool). They sprayed paint around the pool while people are swimming right next to.     

3. management 
Best part was I felt like no one was listening. I addressed issues, but all they could do was saying " I am very sorry." It was less than two star hotel service. 

I really hoping someone see this type of review serious and apply on their upcoming trip because they are overrated for sure as of now.

reviews.author: tammyopera
reviews.title: NEVER AGAIN
reviews.text:
This was the 3rd time that we stayed at the Paradisus Cancun. I am writing this review to express how going forward we will look else ware as a hotel choice for Cancun due to the total lack of consideration from the hotel for our security as guests. I will say however before I give the details, that the grounds, the food, and the main areas of the hotel were clean and up to par.  We checked in on Saturday night By Monday, we noticed that our room door was not locking. No card was needed to enter the room, all we had to do was push on the door. My husband went to the front desk and maintenance was dispatched to come to the room to fix it.  The man came and it appeared as if it was fixed, but we noticed that we would have to slam the door quite firmly to get it to lock. About a day and a half later, upon coming back from the beach, again, we did not need the key to get access to our room. There happened to be a worker from the hotel coming up the hall, and I showed him the problem. Again, maintenance came and supposedly fixed it. That night we went down to the reception to request a late check out, as our flight was leaving late on Saturday.  We were told that they could accommodate that, but there would be extra charge. No problem I said. While she was on the computer arranging for our late check out, I mentioned to her about our room door not locking, and out concerns and she said that she could see that it has been reported and that actually, that’s why I was able to get the late check out because they were not going to put anyone in the room, because they needed the issue fixed. I was upset at this. I could believe that they realized the problem was severe enough to not put someone in the room the next week, but it was ok for us to stay in there this week! So stupid. When I told her this, she said that we could change rooms. And this in the most stupid part!  We were told that we would have to get up in the morning, pack our stuff, come downstairs with it, put our stuff there until 3:00 pm, until “another room would be available”! I told her that this was not acceptable, that why should we, on our vacation, have all the inconvenience placed on us when it was the hotels door lock and security that was the issue. This was completely unfair. We decided to not be inconvenienced by this so all that we asked was that if we could be assured that when the maid left our room after cleaning it that she would make sure the door was secure when she left. The lady at the front desk told us that this was no problem, that she would make a note, and call the housekeeping  to assure this. WELL guess what! The very  next day, we come in from the beach at around 5:00pm, and found our door was not locked!!! I was so angry.  I called down to the reception and got the usual, “we are so sorry” and “this is unacceptable”. They sent the maintenance guy ( by this time its Thursday) and finally, it was fixed totally. 
SO! I’m normally a pretty calm person, so when it came to the check out, I was pretty calm. The man at the desk told me that for out late check out (we stayed until 2:00) it was going to be $20 usd. I held it in my hand and calmly told him that If the hotel really thought it was important…that if the hotel really needed the 20 dollars then he could ask me for it BUT!!!! And then I proceeded to give him a recap of the week I had with the constant worry of my security…the security of my things and us sleeping in there at night worried that drunk guests would walk in. He asked why didn’t we change rooms! Grrrrrr!!! Then asked if we had made management aware, my husband said yes, And then, and here is the best part, HE TOOK THE 20 DOLLARS! I guess the hotel is suffering for the need of 20 dollars. Anyway I gave it to him and told him that this hotel would never see my face again, and that that is what social media is for. 

reviews.author: davrak81
reviews.title: horrible. I would not recommend it to anyone
reviews.text:
My experience there was horrible from the time we got there until the time we left. We always book with family concierge. Upon our arrival, we have called ahead of time and requested that our room be ready upon our arrival, we were assured that It would be taken care Of. When we got there we were told we had to wait three hours, after arguing with them for 20 minutes they finally gave us a room, which had  unsafe conditions because broken doors.  I asked the butler to call maintenance to have the door fixed, four hours later when I called him to see if it was fixed he said that he was only going to call them now! as we were going back to a room we were denied access because they shattered the glass door  in our room, so they decided to change your room without our consent. Our butler was so horrible in an experience he even forget to make reservations for dinner,  which I had to remind him to do again. With exception to want to restaurant, the food there at the restaurants was  horrible. And one of the restaurants for dinner I decided to order a duck, the chef had no idea or clue on how to properly prepare that dish. It came out overcooked and dry inedible. They really take it off the menu of they don't know how to properly prepare that dish.  Another thing about the restaurants is that I don't thing that they turn on air-conditioning in the restaurants because it was very hot and humid I literally had to step out of the restaurant  several times and go to a concierge lounge to cool off. 
At the pool and beach area, be prepared to pay extra if you want to use the beds which were over $100 per day.
House keeping room service was ok for the most part until they forgot/neglected to clean my room.  Unacceptable!

reviews.author: Ting Ting W
reviews.title: Paradisus is not Paradise
reviews.text:
This is my 3rd time to Cancun and I was not impressed with my stay here at the Paradisus. I booked online because of the beautiful pictures that I saw and the good reviews that came up. We booked the trip for 4 days. When we arrived to the hotel, it was beautiful, looked exactly like the pictures, but as we walked around and went into our room, we started to see that the hotel was super run down. There is also no central AC throughout the entire main hotel. We decided to upgrade to an ocean view room, but I do not think that it was worth it. The way the balcony is structured, you don't get a good view from your room. There's a huge planter that covers the view and the concrete siding, blocks the view as well. 

We had the all inclusive package but every time we ordered our drinks there was hardly any alcohol in the drinks at all. As for all the restaurants, you have to make a reservation a day in advance. When you call, they immediately tell you that all the restaurants are full and they only have the buffet and the blue agave open. I did not spend all of this money to not be able to eat at any restaurants. When I started to complain, they all of a sudden had every restaurant available for whatever times I needed it for. Are you kidding me??? Every time we went by the restaurants, they were all empty. 
Make sure to not get tricked by them telling you their restaurants are full! All the restaurants were not good at all compared to the other all inclusive s I have been to, and it was such a difficult process to book. The only restaurant that was edible was buffet. We tried Fuego, Bansa, Enso, the Buffet. 

Honestly the food as drinks were not good at all. There are plenty other resorts that would be way better for the same price. Try the Dreams properties. 

Overall, I wouldn't return to this hotel and do not recommend it. They are super pushy with their time share presentations, but instead should spend their energy on their service, food and quality of their hotel.

reviews.author: elliegrassia
reviews.title: EG751
reviews.text: My thoughts of this hotel is equal to having Root Canal !! The whole experience has left such a bad taste in my mouth that I have NO future desire to ever go back to Mexico. The only thing that was decent was the drinks & AC in our rooms. Food was average to other places I've been, the things that really upset me the most was we couldn't go in the Ocean due to the under currents( which I understand ) but also the seed weed was over the top, so if you decided to go into the pool to cool off your body guess what!  IT was like going into a Hot Tub the water never cooled you off so now what's the point of enjoying the sun. The other thing was the restaurants had minimal air conditioning & no restrooms in area, you had to walk a good distance to get there when I brought my concerns to the front desk they gave me a respond that was so upsetting that I told them I would never return again & they responded that's of my choice" WHAT KIND OF A RESPOND IS THAT " it was not acceptable to me . So in ending this review let me just say because something says its 5 STAR doesn't mean anything !!!!!

reviews.author: monilee16
reviews.text: Take care of the problems reported by the customer as soon as possible. I reported that the air conditioning to the room was not working and nothing was done about it. Price was too high for the service provided

reviews.author: Mai N
reviews.title: Distisfied customer
reviews.text: Water leak into my room from the balcony. I had to put towels by the doors to stop the flooding. Water leaking from the from above into my bathroom. Two charges made on my credit that I did not authorize for.

reviews.author: Majdi S
reviews.title: DISASTER
reviews.text:
Air conditioning non existent in common restaurants and areas including Avenue Bar.
The ballroom where we attended a wedding reception had no air conditioning  prompting staff to distribute cold wet towels to put around our necks .  Re family pool, although service was very good, however overall pool depth is  5-8 to  6 feet.It reduced our interaction with our grandkids.

reviews.author: tempest s
reviews.title: BED BUGs!!!!!!!!!!
reviews.text: On May 17, 2017 I took my two daughters on their first trip to a carribean island and we stayed at Pardisus Resorts in Cancun, MX.  The first night we stayed, I woke up with 12 bites on my right side. I didn't notice until I got in the shower around 8am on May 18th that I felt my side  itching and burning when the water hit it.  When I got out the shower I was shock to see 12 large bed bug bite. Now you may ask, how did you know it was bed bugs? 1. I'm an RN so I see many bedbug bites on people and two I pulled back the mattress and found them scattering. I immediately packed our belongings and went to front desk. Unfortunately, staff was none caring stating the "rash" came from the algae in the ocean. I NEVER STEP FOOT ON THE BEACH  I told them but they didn't seem to care and put us in another room.  I ask if they could dry clean our clothes because some were on the bed and they said no, not without a fee.  The service was horrible and I still today have the bed bug marks as a reminder of how nasty the hotel was.  PLEASE PLEASE DO NOT STAY AT THIS HOTEL!!!!! Though it looks beautiful, the hotel is not clean and customer service is horrible!!!! I will never stay at any of Grand Melia resorts (the mother company for Paradisus). You have been warned, please doe not stay here.

reviews.author: Brad P
reviews.title: Don't waste your money.  Move on down the road.
reviews.text:
Ok let's start with the background information.  We booked this trip back in April with two other couples and all got the same package which was a bottom of the barrel lagoon view.  The trip was from July 17, through July 24 for a 7 night stay.

The first big problem we had was at check in.  The other two couples checked in with no problems and it was finally our turn.  My wife and I approached the counter and the person at check in went on break and a younger male switched in to take care of us.  We checked in and were immediately told by our friends that we got screwed.  They had gold bracelets while we had black.  Which means they got Royal Service and we did not.  They had put our friends in building 5 which is the royal service building and put us in building 1 which is on the other side of the resort.

Upon further investigation the girl that was checking them in told them she was out of black bracelets therefore they would get royal service and a royal service room for free.  So we went back to talk to the manager on duty and it was the same male, his name was Mario.  We explained to Mario that this was a couples trip and our anniversary on top of that and that we wanted to be with our friends and by them getting royal service for free that would not happen as they would have access to things we would not.  

We were then told that there was nothing they could do for us and sometimes if your "lucky" they will give you a "complimentary" upgrade.  I asked Mario if we could be "lucky" and  a free complimentary upgrade as well.  

He then proceeded to tell us that his accounting department would not approve and that we could pay a hefty price to upgrade if we wanted...  WHAT??????  I asked to speak to his manager and he said he was the manager.  At this point my wife had it and started to cry because this was supposed to be an awesome trip with our friends and we were being forced to pay a premium to be able to be with them.

So after all this we were showered with other surprises which you will read about below.  Make sure you check out the attached picture.  So for the next 7 days we were treated to construction going on outside our hotel room that ended at midnight and would resume the next morning at 6:00.  We would get random power washings and sometimes even saws cutting the concrete right outside of our room.  

We did ask for a room change twice and were told that was the best they could do.  So if that's not enough for you read below about the shock therapy included with the royal service.

The royal service pool is a much tamer pool and no kids are allowed... Thank God because of what I'm about to tell you.  During our stay we did use the royal service pool but about 4 days in we were all hanging out at the edge of the pool with our elbows up on the concrete part used for walking.  They turned on the lights in the pool and we all were received a pretty decent shock.  There was another group on the other side of the pool that felt it too and at that point the pool cleared out.

You say you want more Rest and Relaxation well read on and find out about Paradisus Cancun's special Cancun Cleanse package.  

Most people visiting Cancun know not to drink the water however this place will swear up and down that their water is filtered and purified.  There are several restaurants that if you ask for bottled water the servers will get annoyed and scold you because the water comes from a "jug" that is just fine for drinking.  You practically have to beg for bottled water at the restaurants.

Saturday night I gave in and didn't feel like arguing so I drank the water they poured from the "jug".  All Sunday I was in the restroom throwing up and had diarrhea to go with it.  Then when I asked for more toilet paper from the royal service desk because I was sick they said they'd bring it right away.  4 hours later I received one roll of toilet paper.  

Seriously people, look further down the road.  This place is not worth it.  Read my other reviews for better places for the money.  We couldn't wait to get back home and now, finally the "Cancun cleanse" is starting to wear off.

reviews.author: Mena Mo
reviews.title: Don't judge a book by its cover!
reviews.text:
This is my fourth time coming to Cancun and this time my family of 13 and I came to the Paradisus for vacation. Upon arrive we were impressed by the facility and all the amenities, however this would gradually change everyday. 

First of all the front desk explained that everyday you must reserve dinner for the next day starting at 7am, which is not the case because I woke up every morning at 7 and somehow they could not accommodate us at the time requested or our first choice of restaurant. Which as you might imagine is frustrating when you are trying to relax on your vacation. Then they offer you to go to the buffet because there is no reservation required. 

After our first night the front desk tried to contact us but we were not in the rooms, so they deactivated our cards so can go to the front desk. There we were informed that the front desk clerk could not do math and charged us the incorrect amount and we owed an additional $300, which is extremely petty considering we paid $12,000 when we checked in. 

First day we went to the pool after breakfast at their buffet restaurant, Naos, we then ventured to the pool where we were denied alcoholic drinks because the bar was not set up yet. The staff was kind enough to offer beer and any non-alcoholic drinks. Then when they finally started serving the drinks are water down and flavorless. Then the pool staff tried to play some music but the sound system wasn't working and neither was the DJ booth so they gave up and performed without any music.

The next day we wanted to do an activity so myself and 4 of my family members wanted to try the 9 hole golf course on the resort. The starter is located in the resorts convenience store, which you would never know unless you ask a staff member. Then it will take you about 15 minutes to locate because the building is very confusing and the staff inside barely speak English. Then we get our rental clubs which we're a 20+ year old set with a mix of lefty and righty clubs without telling you, and we were all righties. They also charge $4 per ball for a used golf ball. Then we carelessly meandered around the hotel grounds trying to figure out where the first hole was and we asked several staff on the way and no one offered to help, they all just told us the course was outside. 

The next day several of us went to the resorts YHI spa, where we were told they don't have some of the services that are listed on their website and brochure because they are discontinued. Those who stayed did enjoy the massage provided but it was pricey $175 for a hour.

Then at dinner later that night, we were 20 minutes late and the hostess would not sit us because they only hold the table for 15 minutes. And she would not let us explain that we had a family member who got ill and that delayed us.

Overall, I have mixed feelings about the staff. Basically anyone who we have tip to prior completing their service was excellent and vice-versa. But there are a couple of outliers that did an excellent job.

All in all, avoid this resort if you can because it is not what it seems. This establishment is the true definition of do not judge a book by its cover. My previous stays at the RUI and the RUI palace were much more enjoyable because you knew what you were going to get. 

Good luck travelers!

reviews.author: Paulette A
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: Just got back from Cancun, Mexico and honestly what a disappointing trip. This resort has no A/C in the lobby or in the common areas...the restaurant are hot with fans everywhere cuz the A/C system is HORRIBLE...there was construction going on 2 floors below us so we were awake by 7 am...complained to 3 different people including our butler, family concierge and management but nothing was done. Hotel is very dated and looks nothing like it does on their website. Would not recommend this hotel at all.

reviews.author: lewisy718
reviews.title: WHAT A DISAPPOINTMENT !
reviews.text:
My mom has cancer and is going through chemo so we decided to have a girls trip which I expected my mom to be pampered in since trip advisor had only good things to say boy was I wrong. I wish we had stayed home for what my mom had to endure. 
First day we arrived around noon there was no early check in and said our rooms wouldn't be ready till 3ish. They assigned use a “concierge” which is really somebody who try to sell you on  coming to a breakfast for a time share. He acted like he could help us with dinner reservations and if we wanted to take trips that is a straight up lie never herd from him again! it was raining When we arrived so we couldn't go by the pool or beach their weren't any activities Was absolutely nothing to do but sit and wait  around When we finally got into our room it was a dump something you would get at a cheap motel.  the door to the terrace was leaking my mom fell within being five minutes in the room  door to the slippery floors I was horrified when I notified front desk I was asked to walk to the main desk which was prymaid three and I was in one  my mom just fell but I went any way  I was able to get the room changed but honestly I left the states not to haggle and argue and I really had to go there just to get a room change  they know they gave us a crap room and that it was nothing like advertised at all and we here all the way in the first building which is a world  away and a real walk so they changed use to the main building the room they switched us to was nice I ended up carrying the luggage half way to the new room because the bell boy took more than an hour and I was getting tired of waiting 
Now when I booked through travel agency  It said a junior suite. It was a  REGULAR HOTEL ROOM. THAT IS IT!  for three people it was small and no matter how much I talked to the main desk. They weren't going to do anything about it ( booth rooms we where in was not what we originally were sold on )
I also expected the family concierge that my travel agency raved about and since I made clear many times I was bring my daughter that I would receive that 
NOPE IT'S AN extra upgrade.  if you book through travel agency or online and they say its included, it's not and the hotel will not honor what you were sold.  they will actual charge you more if you ask for it once your there 
So I decided to let it go I wasn't going to win that battle 
I got the exact  opposite of customer service I realized if you aren't in royal service or family concierge you might as well be the help because thats how they are going to treat you 

The entertainment when raining is held inside in the bar  area with little seating  once we showed up after dinner there was no room  for us to see so we just went to our room the night after that when it wasn't raining the entertainment was held outside  on the steps not comfortable seating at all they put cushions down but not what you would expect from a luxury hotel I've had better seating at baseball games 

DON'T LEAVE YOUR KIDS ALONE AT THE KID ZONE as nice as the kid zone staff is they aren't any real supervision  I visited the play area  but once I saw how they let the kids treat each other and run around and get physical with each other it was just best that we only came down for the art activities which I stayed with and defiantly had to be helicopter mom 

Now to the second issue when we ate at the Market Grill, my mom cut her toe on the bottom of the table it was a little raised off the ground we initial just went back to the room and figured it was a light cut once we saw how deep the cut was I asked for first aid or a doctor to come up the lady told me I could get band aids at the gift shop and the doctor was a 100 dollars just for him to take a look and he had gone home for the night .

Which caused me once again having to bring an ugly side out. I was able to get someone to check out her foot and bandage it.  

Now I was really pissed how we been treated here I never felt treated like such garage i asked for the manager  I think she said her name was Yolanda  she was so concerned about having my moms insurance and only my moms insurance pay for a trip to the hospital  which we ended up not going to after speaking to our travel insurance how far the nearest hospital is and explaining how it outside Cancun at night and we are three women who speak no Spanish and the hotel wasn't offering cab service not a person to come with us nothing they offered my mom nothing  now after this being the second incident happening at this hotel  they offered obsoletely nothing to my mom not a freaking water every times needed a changed bandaged changed  I had to hound them down and they would take over an hour to get a response 

This s injury at the hotel kept her inside the hotel room she couldn't go in the water and it hurt her foot to walk long periods of time this incident ruined our trip and the hotel and everyone in it and Yolanda or whatever her name did absolutely nothing 

I cant believe they would treat someone so cruel.  Don’t stay at this hotel,  that kind of meanness doesn't deserve business 

I hope karma gets everyone we asked helped from and received none and don't dare message this review back with some bs response acting like you care because I tried multiple times to contact the hotel for help and got none .

reviews.author: shitzu4
reviews.title: The WORST everything hotel ......
reviews.text: I realize that reviews can be interpreted as "objective" to some people who read them BUT we are NOT novice travelers and am currently on our second day of our week family vacation and am EXTREMELY disappointed with the Paradisus Cancun Hotel. If you go on their website, they are MISREPRESENTING their rooms , the image of their hotel states as " LUXURY,  ELEGANCE, MODERN rooms...." I don't mean to sound snobby as I am not that kind of person if you knew me first hand but if anyone reading my review and have a certain image of "LUXURY, UPSCALE, and ELEGANCE," then do NOT waste your hard earn money on this hotel or you will be VERY disappointed and feel ripped off and you will NOT enjoy your vacation! We are on our second day and had to put out a review now rather than wait to do it after our trip so we can save others who were thinking of booking here. This hotel is over 20 years old and we have 3 ocean view junior suites, not the highest category BUT not considered the worst so we expected at LEAST a luxury room but what we have are old unrenovated rooms, there are cracks on the walls and ceilings, the faucets in our bathroom have rust and chipped metal, the tile on the bathroom walls have orange stain running down the about 10 inches long, the faucet in the shower is partially out of the wall so you can see where the pipe goes into the wall from an angle. Hence the caulking on the side of the tub and wall does NOT stay on as if the glue did not stick so it is falling off. These are just some examples of what these rooms look like, like I said, we have 3 ocean view category rooms currently. Now my ONLY question to the CEO of this hotel and Melia Company which oversees many Paradisus properties is...would they stay in something like this AND they call this "LUXURY, ELEGANCE, and MODERN," THEN I would hate to see what they consider " low tier?" I have voiced our concerns to so many employees at the check in counter, even to the manager, Mario and the worst thing he said to me was, we can switch you to another room or you can go to another hotel. He showed me another room and I was able to point out to him the bathroom issues at another room and all he kept saying was you bought this category room so this is what you get unless you want better room, you will have to pay $125.00 more per room per night. I told him that their direct website had misrepresented by advertising how they have luxury, elegant, and modern rooms, so does he consider these issues in their rooms based on the CATEGORY of rooms they have because it is evident that he is missing the point OR he could just NOT care as he said I have to discuss this with Apple Vacation as that was who we booked it from. Isn't good customer service their up most priority?  Isn't being a Manager suppose to take care of business, especially when a customer is dissatisfied, to try to turn a negative into a positive instead of just shutting out the customer by pawning the problem off to someone else, in this case to Apple Vacation? A customer is only looking for a "Manager"  to step up and solve and make it right to a customer, we DON'T want to hear excuses! So now, we are left hanging as I feel like we are stuck in this old, gross, NON luxury ocean view rooms. In addition, these are NOT our only issues about this place, there is SOO much loud noise where we our walls and floor vibrates from the loud music coming from the lobby area. I don't want to go on and on as I am NOT a complainer and don't want to sound snobby or difficult BUT when one goes on vacation and expects a nice luxury hotel, it is VERY disheartening to experience what we currently have endured so I'm just trying to help others out there who has in mind the "image" of  upscale, luxury, elegance living type of caliber....then the Paradisus Cancun is NOT for you! It is NOT what it says it is! Stay tune for my next review as we are on our second day of this horrible experience.....to be continued! I took all these pictures of the 3 rooms and it is all consistent that these rooms definitely need and MUST be renovated to keep up with their competition, especially being on the hotel zone here in Cancun as we have stayed at the Ritz Carlton, Le Blanc, the Hyatt Ziva and the JW properties. Spend your hard earned money there as you will NOT be dissappointed as you will NOT be living under these conditions where the bidet and toilets look dirty do to stainless steel looking old and dirty. Seriously, if you don't live like this at your own home, then wouldn't you expect to stay at a hotel comparable if not better than what you currently live in??? I definitely expected that, I realize some who are reading this can view my opinion as it's all "relative," and believe me, I get that but this is NOT relative issues, they are real problems here, I am  just trying to save anyone from wasting their money and frustrations, aggravation, etc., there is too much competition out there, I wished I would of known about this hotel but of course they would NEVER advertise their bathrooms on their website because if they did, NO one, who expects nice, luxury, modern, upscale rooms would  book at the Paradisus Cancun! Unfortunately, we made a BIG mistake!👎😢

reviews.author: 967mah
reviews.title: Don't waste your vacation and money here
reviews.text: Over priced, Unfriendly staff and unavailable managers to resolve the issues and have $500 in singles  for constant tipping otherwise you get no service!  We were locked out of  our room and it took us 20 minutes before we got some help.

reviews.author: Eden B
reviews.title: Wedding Nightmare!
reviews.text:
Disclaimer: This review is focused on the Romance Department at Paradisus. The hotel stay was wonderful! 

We just got back from our wedding at the hotel - it was amazing to have all of our family and friends in one place, celebrating our love! The one bummer was Melina, our "planner" from the hotel. We started planning this wedding about a year ago, and Melina had an absolutely disgusting attitude from the beginning. I had been a wedding planner for three years when we started our conversation with her, so it's safe to say I had a pretty good idea of what I wanted. We signed on the "Tailor Made Package" which was supposed to be all inclusive - food, alcohol, decor, etc. but everything we discussed was an extra charge or a problem to do. Not to mention that TWO HOURS before my wedding Melina came up to me and said we don't have any flowers!!! I was extremely stressed so she put some cheap looking flowers in the vases I bought. We spent about $2,000 on vases for the flowers and the next day Melina said she had no idea where any of them were. At 10 pm of the wedding reception Melina unplugged our music and demanded we pay her cash to keep the party going. 

These are just the highlights of my experience with the awful woman who thinks she can call herself a wedding planner. I would never ever want another bride to feel the way I felt throughout the process and wedding day.

reviews.author: ofra5
reviews.title: Wedding
reviews.text:
We have been planning a wedding at the Paradisus Hotel in Cancun for about a year. The wedding took place on May 28, 2017.  120 people came from all over the world to celebrate with us. We had 50 rooms at the hotel.
The person from the Romance department that worked with us was Melina [--]. She was horrible!!!!! Words can not describe the aggravation we had all this year and especially the weekend of the wedding. Melina [--] is unprofessional, does not have a clue how to organize a wedding, we don't understand how she got to this position. She did NOTHING we asked for. Melina [--] over charged us for things she didn't do!!!! We paid $3500 for flowers, and two hours before the wedding Melina tells us that she did not order the flowers and ended up just putting some ugly flower arrangements throughout the wedding area not the flowers that we paid for.
Melina [--] came in the middle of the ceremony and asked us to sign papers for extras putting us in a tight spot where we couldn't even look at what the terms and conditions of those extras were, forcing us to sign minutes before the ceremony under stress and committing to payments that we were not aware of. Melina [--] pulled out the plug of our music in the middle of the reception and asked for extra $2000usd if we wanted to continue for another hour, when asking her to show the contract where the time was stated she pulled out a paper that had the time in very small print without our signature on it, our signature was on all the other pages except that one surprisingly!!!  Worst experience ever!!!!! She made the bride and groom very upset!!!! If that wasn't enough we had so many problems with the rooms. Many of our guests had to switch rooms including the bride and groom. Some rooms did not have air conditioning for three days in a row, one room had a leaky air conditioning causing the floor to get wet causing the groom to slip and hurt his arm. The hotel itself has no air conditioning in the lobby at all, or in any of the restaurants in the hotel, the hotel is built with an open top so that they can have airflow but in Cancun with 100% humidity that's just not enough.
Finally after the horrific ordeal with Melina, when we requested to have the centerpieces (valued over $3000) that we provided returned to us, Melina claimed that it's in the contract that we need to pick up the centerpieces immediately as soon as the wedding is over, and now they are lost, (you really expect a bride and groom or family members to start collecting centerpieces in the midst of their celebration?). A day later when we came into Melina's office to discuss the ordeal she had a bunch of our centerpieces sitting in her office, she never bothered to call us and let us know that she found some of them, not even 10% of what we provided.
Finally after being told by Melina that she does not have a supervisor and there is nobody above her that we can talk too we got to one of the hotel managers Mario and after we presented to Mario a bunch of the emails that support all of our claims and all of our complaints including the flowers that we have paid for and ordered, his resolution to all this BS that we had to deal with, was to offer the bride and groom two nights stay at the hotel. The condition was that they would accept this as satisfactory, sign away any rights to future claims and not place any bad reviews about what has happened. Refusing to offer a refund for the stuff that was not provided per our contract. Obviously we refused 
So if you are planning a wedding in Paradisus Cancun I would recommend to think again, and definitely for sure not to work with Melina [--]!!!!!!

In all honesty there are some excellent staff members at the hotel namely Tabata Who is in charge of the pool area and the Coco club beach cabanas and her amazing staff such as Manuel who treated us like royalty. 

Devastated mother of the bride.

reviews.author: Bessie M
reviews.title: If u want activities and variety of restratuants this is not the place.
reviews.text: Would not stay here again. Front desk staff not friendly. Did nothing to accommodate for room mix up. Maids never left enough wash clothes or towels. Not enough space for most guest to attend shows had to sit on steps outside.

reviews.author: Leslie E
reviews.title: Not Customer Friendly - BEWARE!
reviews.text: Very disappointing experience. Upon Check-In we were told that we did not have reservations. I showed them our confirmation email from TripAdvisor. Then I logged into TripAdvisor to check the status of our reservation; it still showed as a valid reservation. The check-in person kept telling me that they aren't responsible for reservations made on TripAdvisor. They also kept asking me if I was a rewards member; this was our first trip to Cancun we have no reason to be rewards members. We asked them to honor the reservation since we had the printed confirmation and could show them a current, valid reservation on TripAdvisor; they said "no". They said we could use one of our devices (iPhone) to rebook at the current rate on THEIR website (I can only assume this cuts TripAdvisor out of their compensation). At this point, I was crying and terrified that we were stuck in Cancun with no hotel for 4 days. We used our device to rebook at $200 more (for 3 nights). Beware of staying at this hotel!!!!!

reviews.author: Kenneth K
reviews.title: Don't be fooled by their lobby
reviews.text: Lobby is beautiful it's like a rain forest.  Food is poor, cleanliness of restaurants that I was able to actually eat at was poor, reservations of the nicer restaurants says one day not true but plenty of open tables.  Maybe this is how they save money on the all inclusive. Many restaurants listed in their property but seating in some is few except for buffet restaurants.  You literally can walk in one restaurant and exit thru another.    Bathroom with a fiberglass tub/ shower and a bidet that needed updated made me want to run out of their "resort".   Seating around pool is nuts definitely not enough seating and crowded.  lounge chair was broken

reviews.author: hayek1962
reviews.title: Nonstop Assault by Awful Music on the Beach
reviews.text:
Almost everything is so good. The staff is wonderful, the hotel is beautiful and well-maintained, and the food is very good. The steakhouse is particularly excellent. Both the pool and beach are beautiful.

But unfortunately my ability to enjoy all of that was limited by the fact that every day I was at the hotel I found myself having to retire to my room early every afternoon with a splitting headache to escape the nonstop assault of the awful music that they blast on the beach. It starts in the morning and goes all day. So if you want to just relax and enjoy peace and quiet, or still better just enjoy the sounds of the waves at the beach, it is impossible to do so. It is just repetitive, bass-thumping, awful music, over and over, for hours on end. I didn't notice anyone listening to or enjoying the music--how could they, it is not even music really, just awful, repetitive noise.

Do you remember when they were trying to get the Branch Davidians to surrender in Waco awhile back and they blasted bad music at that 24 hours a day? Apparently that's what this is. I finally had to surrender and just go back to my room and take Advil.

It is all a shame because it is an easy problem to fix--simply turn off the music or at least just turn it down so that those who want to have some peace and quiet can find a spot just to relax and enjoy the sounds of the beach and those who want to listen to the "music" can do otherwise. At least ask your customers whether they want to have that terrible music assaulting them all day. But they just won't do it. And it is otherwise a great hotel--expensive but worth it, in my opinion.

Otherwise, this is a really great property and I would come back. But its no fun to have spend every afternoon in your room with a headache because they won't turn off their awful music. So I can't in good conscience recommend this hotel to other travelers who want to have a nice family vacation with some relaxing peach and quiet. Somewhere on their website they should disclose that there are no quiet places on the beach or by the pool where people can relax and just listen to the sounds of the ocean. I've never been at a hotel before where the music is so bad and it is also impossible to escape it--usually there are at least quiet sections on the beach and quiet pools. Especially for the high rates that they charge. Don't stay here until they get rid of the awful music.

reviews.author: BurneyNYC
reviews.title: Checked into a broken room - 2 hours of struggle
reviews.text:
Checked into the hotel with a family of 8 in rooms 3428/29 ( see attached pictures ). The room I am staying has a broken sofa bed, broken bathroom knob and a warehouse style AC vent. The rooms are dated - I asked the front desk about these issues - 

And here the interesting facts - they kept presenting me rooms which I didn't booked initially. Asked Duty Manager to help - she first showed me a room which is good for 2 ppl only despite I am family of 4 and further starting making me responsible for  the room I staying in rather offer me something as a makeup for the struggle - 
More interestingly this all is happening just an hour before mid night and finish unresolved past mid night. 

Let me continue to add my perspective and keep the upcoming guest help make a better choice. 

This by any means is not a 5star hotel mindset. What I have experienced today is a battle between customer who has paid for a 5 star hotel and a hotel staff who is not experienced to handle guest with justified issues. 

I also felt that the front desk staff here is tough - they wanted to show muscles by telling the customer he is expecting upgrades for free rather my perspective is - I didn't pay for a broken room: 

Hope TripAdvisor won't edit anything here.

reviews.author: Deric T
reviews.title: Worst customer service ever
reviews.text: We just checked in yesterday, somehow our reservation got mixed up at the hotel and they booked us for 1 person instead of 2. the price difference was $50 online and we were ok with paying it but at the counter they demanded $386 instead. We spent 2 hours at the front desk to get it resolved when they would not help us, we finally had to call the US and rebook it through a 3rd party and get the proper rate. Truly a nightmare experience, worst customer service ever.

reviews.author: TheRosses2014
reviews.title: Poor Service, Quaility and Follow thru
reviews.text:
I've been reluctant to post a bad review, thinking someone from the hotel would be willing to make the issues I had while working with them right.  Apparently that is no the case.  I host retreats around the world for women entrepreneurs, and am always looking for great service and willing to pay extra for it.  I contracted with the Paradisus not once, but twice to bring my group there.  The first time I visited with my group there was some mix up with the contract and the hotel ended up charging me an extra $5,000 Dollars, so to make it right the next time I brought a group the credited me $2,500.  I reluctantly said yes, as the service I received was not great.  This last trip was the worst.  

As the host of the group you would expect the hotel to be interested in taking care of you, they did the opposite.  I paid for a larger room, with Family Concierge and needed to be near my group.  I was put in a smaller room with my toddler (which DID NOT work) and when I requested them to make it right was given an OLD room with a roach problem in 4 pyramids over (it was a hike to say the least).  See the photo.  Per our contract the hotel still

reviews.author: Fearless432512
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: On Our 4th trip to Mexico we stayed at the Paradisus  Cancun, our first night in our room was directly over the red lounge disco, booming music coming through the floor till 2 AM requested room change next night much better. Did not like the food we had 1 reservation for Supper and they did not seat us even though the whole place was almost empty  stay somewhere else paradisus not worth the price

reviews.author: fitorenovaj
reviews.title: UNREASONABLE !
reviews.text: I checked in March 13th, 2017 with 5 people total under one reservation. Two other cousins checked in the same time as I, however, they had their own separate reservation. The same night an incident took place which resulted into getting kicked out of the hotel....The next day, we all had to meet with two "managers" to discuss the situation. I, who was asleep and not part of the situation was kicked out for an unknown reason! Just because the guest who did something has the same last name as myself resulted in ALL OF US getting kicked out. When addressed the "managers", they were TEXTING their boss and when asked to directly speak to the boss, they would say 'he is not here". I am highly baffled by the customer service and the fact that the "managers" had NO REAL REASON as to why they are kicking out the reservation that had NOTHING to do with the incident out! They rather let their guest get kicked out with no back-up plan and only care about their money instead of citizens! Upon arrival, there was no papers to sign stating anything about hotel policy. To this day, I still have no idea as to why I and the guest under my reservation were kicked out since we were not the people who were part of the incident. Just because we have the same last name and are relatives to the person who got into a situation, they decided to kick us out as group which technically they cannot do. ONLY GOOD THING ABOUT THIS HOTEL is Ernesto and Gulliermo, without them, we would have been stranded. MAKE THEM THE MANAGERS and fire the other two no power, brainless men. The AMSTAR guys were beyond helpful and super kind enough to help us find a motel for the night and help us reserve rooms in a different hotel through CheapCaribbean. Rock on to them because without them, we would have literally been stranded in the street considering we did not bring enough money since we did not anticipate any issues. SAVE YOUR MONEY AND GO TO IBEROSTAR! GREAT HOTEL, SERVICE, AND STAFF ARE WAY MORE PROFESSIONAL. In addition, upon arrival, IBEROSTAR makes their guests sign a letter stating their policy so incase an incident does occur, you were informed. WAY TO GO IBEROSTAR!! P.S. I STILL NEED AN ANSWER AS TO WHY MY RESERVATION WAS KICKED OUT WHEN WE HAD NOTHING TO DO WITH THE INCIDENT THAT OCCURRED. HAVING THE SAME LAST NAME AND BEING RELATED TO THE OTHER PERSON SHOULD NOT HAVE AFFECTED EVERYONE!

reviews.author: Ryan C
reviews.title: Booking Beware!
reviews.text:
I haven't even had my stay and already having a terrible experience! I am extremely disappointed by the service provided by this organization! 

When trying to book on the Melia website for a 4 day vacation in Cancun in the coming weeks, the confirmation I received had incorrectly booked us for only 1 night on completely different dates. When I immediately consulted the phone service about this, I was able to book the correct dates over the phone, but was advised that I could only submit an email to try to claim for the faulty booking, which was a non-fundable ticket. I did this.
