In over 2 weeks I have received no resolution to this issue despite multiple enquiries online and a highly uncooperative phone call. This is all leaving a very bad taste in my mouth and overall I am now dreading my visit to the hotel. 

I'm now looking to escalate this issue with Consumer Affairs. This is simply not fair or acceptable. Trying to change an incorrect booking (due technical issues on their website) from 1 night to the correct booking for 4 nights (a longer stay!) should be simple!!!

reviews.author: Alberto G
reviews.title: Charge for extra service, as Royal service, and deliver worst service than a motel
reviews.text:
As soon as you get there they push to sell this special program, that basically does not add any benefit.

What you end up getting is rudeness from the staff, specially manager and people from the help desk staff.

When you ask for something there is no one able to help and redirect to somewhere else.

Once we called the help desk over the phone to check something and they end up transferring  over 5 times until they hangout.

Basically it is the worst service I have ever stayed, mostly for being and all inclusive. 
It advertised it has multiple restaurants. But there is no way to eat in them, they ask for reservation and when you call they tell you they are full, however they are empty.

In the end, we tried to speak with the general manager, who is always busy or does not care.

It was without a doubt the worst experience in Cancun.

In the pro side the installation are good, but not word a dime for the terrible service you received.

reviews.author: Kruti B
reviews.title: This place is absolutely HORRIBLE!!!  Do NOT stay here, so many better places!
reviews.text: I would never stay at the at the Paradisus Cancun again nor would I ever recommend this hotel to anyone.  I have been to Cancun/Playa De Carmen about 9 times and have stayed in other Melia properties.  This one is the worst one by far.  First of all the hotel itself is outdated and dirty.  It did not seem well maintained or cleaned.  The pictures of the rooms on the website are not accurate.  I can get over that part but the worst part was the service.  This place is very expensive compared to other nice properties on the strip in Cancun, so you would think people were coming here for something, if it is not the rooms maybe it is the service?  Not in my experience.  The tipping culture at this hotel is unbelieveable not like anywhere else I have experienced.  I have traveled to the world and have been to many countries and I have never been treated as unwelcomed and unaccommodating as the staff and management in this hotel.  If you do not tip them generously they will not even look at you!  So I am not against tipping – but this is an all inclusive resort, I paid a lot of money to come here and the whole point is not to walk around with my wallet.  At any other all inclusive or Melia property I have not experienced this only this hotel.  The tipping thing was a challenge all around the cleaning and housekeeping staff would not  clean your room if you did not tip, the bar tenders and waiters would not acknowledge you or take your orders, even the front desk would barely acknowledge you.  We had to repeatedly call to have them clean our room.  I was not going to tip out of principle for the fact that I should be treated with respect regardless of tipping as I paid thousands of dollars to stay in the hotel!  One day our room wasn’t cleaned after 5 follows ups – we ended up seeing the turn down service housekeeping cart and grabbing our own towels and stuff to tidy our room and the maid had the nerve to give us a tipping envelope! I will be letting Melia know about this hotel, it does not meet Melia standards, I know Melia itself has high standards and I would recommend they look into the practices of this hotel.  There is some serious issues and mis management going on!

reviews.author: DJO
reviews.title: First room had electrical problems, had a front door that didn't close properly and was badly outdated.
reviews.text:
We then attempted to upgrade to royal service, but were informed none were available. We requested another room, but nothing comparable to our booked room was available - so we had to pay for an upgrade - but not royal service.  

2nd room had air conditioner problems, and after waiting 8 hours for "repairs" the room was still uncomfortable.  And the fridge didn't work either.  These things can be repaired, & resolved but being told they are fixed, when staff know this is untrue is what we call a lie where I come from.  

After waiting this long, and calling back the front desk (after a supervisor checked that the air conditioning was working), I asked to speak to the general manager, but they were gone for the day.  The acting manager for the night was to call back to discuss, but never did.  

I'll be reaching out to the general manager in the morning - stay tuned (have 7 more days here).  

Bar and restaurant & entertainment staff are excellent, food great, common facilities great, beach fantastic.  

Dave Johnson

reviews.author: Wanda K
reviews.title: The worst EVER
reviews.text: Really, its the worst hotel I've ever been. The immediate response for all the employees was "NO" . It was really annoying. We ask for jam and they tell us its only for breakfast. We asked for a table for 6 and they told us NO . They had the worst attitude . It is really the worst experience ever . The employees have no training . They want to charge extra for everything and it's all inclusive !! Please , take my advice and go to Secreta The Vine or Hard Rock . Depending on your type of trip . It's a bit expensive but trust me , it's worthwhile.

reviews.author: Inesa T
reviews.title: Overbooked, understaffed, poor service
reviews.text:
We have been to this hotel before and where very satisfied, however not this time.  

We talked up the hotel so much that we had 3 other couples join us.  Well what a mistake that was.  Hotel was overbooked, staff could not handle all the guests.  

Check in line was out the door.  Waited for 1 hr to get checked in.  No offer of water or drinks while we waited.   

Tried to make dinner at restaurant since we only came for 3 days - well that was out the door.  Everything was booked first night, 2nd night Brazilian was closed, 3 Rd night was only 9pm open.  Mind you we went by the restaurants and they had lot of open tables.  

Buffet constantly had empty plates of food.  Requested Food and it took 3 more requests and 30 min.  Dinner at the restaurant you had to ask for more food and if desert was coming.  It seemed like we where requesting too much. 

Overall horrible experience.

reviews.author: STraveller22
reviews.title: Worst experience ever - do not stay
reviews.text: I truly just joined TripAdvisor so I could warn everyone about staying here. The staff are inefficient, unhelpful, and rude. The rooms are terrible, food mediocre, and beach full of hustlers. Don't go.

reviews.author: webbsyght
reviews.title: Never again
reviews.text: We have been there three times and this was the worst and will not come back. The lobby staff were rude and pushy about making sure you were escorted every where before you checked in so you could not explore the hotel in peace.

reviews.author: ana K
reviews.title: Worst all inclusive. They charge everything
reviews.text: By far the worst experience in any all inclusive ive been in. The moment you check in they try to sell you a VIP status where you can have a "full" all inclusive experience. Everything we ordered wasnt included in the all inclusive meaning national drinks like beer and vodkas. Room service to bring thise drinks in the inclusive had extra charges. Want a lounge on the beach? Well you have to pay an extra $150usd for it a day. Towels were limited. Just awful. Dont waste your money on this place.

reviews.author: chriswebb02
reviews.title: better when it was the gran melia
reviews.text: the lobby staff were too lazy to do their job of customer service because they were always socializing with each other, the property needs to be updated because the signs were faded and pealing off, big disappointment and will never come back

reviews.author: lori_drex
reviews.title: Don't plan on relaxing unless ou order a cabanca
reviews.text: Unless you pay for a cabana, plan on fetching everything on your own.  drinks, food, etc.  There is not relaxing and the hotel is hard to get around.  Steps everywhere. We go to Cancun a lot and will not be returning.  There is not bars on the inside of the hotel that open before 4:00 should it rain, unless you want to go to the buffet and order something.  There are ZERO family activities unless you pay for an upgrade.  the Kids Zone is nice, but there was no place for me and my kids to play inside when it rains or they were tired of the sun.  Also the pool options are 2 ft or 5 ft.  As a girl that is 5'6", that made it difficult to have 2 kids hanging on me and trying to walk on my tip toes.  And heaven forbid I might want to actually sip a drink in the pool, not happening.  Just don't plan on relaxing at this place.

reviews.author: jamietravels2017
reviews.title: Zero Customer Service
reviews.text:
Horrible experience checking in!!! Had to stand in a line over an hour for check in... no water even offered. Then was told I had to pay more money for my daughter, who is 13. Reservation was for 2 adults - not my fault!! He said my credit card wouldn't go through. Again, not my fault. I was treated as though I was trying to cheat them of something. After all of this, we had to wait in a second line to get our room key. Everyone in the long line was complaining about this. They had workers all over just standing around and one slow person doing more paperwork to provide a key! 45 minutes in this line and I was now being harassed about owing money, credit card not working and they were withholding my room key! She demanded that I call my bank, which I had already done. It was Christmas Eve. They were closed for the next 3 days. The nasty woman who was extremely rude took my card and called the number on the back, spoke to someone and then handed me the phone worth am attitude of "see, I told you I could get your bank to answer, you liar." She had called the stolen/lost card service. My card was not lost or stolen! She couldn't make my card work! 

We had been up since 4am, traveled 4.5 hours, stood in lines... we needed to get to a room! Did she expect me to hand over my daughter until I could reach someone at my bank?! 

I have never been treated with such blatant disrespect or experience such an inefficient check in system in any place throughout the world! No one seems to be in charge here.

There are good things at this hotel. Good food. Beautiful restaurants. But the service is ridiculously slow and the people don't remember things. I order 3 drinks and 1 comes. Never given enough towels. No water in the room. Fridge not filled. Smoke detector in hall outside our room going beep, beep beep... 3 times requested they put in a battery - a simple request. NEVER HAPPENED! On and on... 

But the absolute worst was how I was treated at check in. This place needs some serious customer service training! I will NEVER EVER return here or to any Melia operated hotel!

reviews.author: pauldB5201VH
reviews.title: Horrible Place
reviews.text: I stayed here from the day after Thanksgiving until December 3rd and while the staff was friendly and very nice overall when i ran into a incident on my last day there the service and resolution was HORRIBLE and left a bad taste in my mouth. They planned a remodel above my room with no notice ? and when i went downstairs and asked that they delay it until i check out the next day they said yes and right after lunch the construction started again.i ended up having to move and my room was downgraded with a measly offer of a 20 minute welcome massage when i had already spent about $ 500 US dollars at the Spa during my stay. having a lot of knowledge of the hospitality industry i know that this was planned and the lack of consideration of PUTTING THE GUEST FIRST is beyond me. I would not stay here again or suggest to anyone else.i filed a formal complaint in writing to management on December 3rd and and as of December 31st have not gotten a reply.

reviews.author: hanee e
reviews.title: The hotel is old and staff are the worst
reviews.text: I have visited 3 other hotel in cancun and I never had any problem with hotel and the staff. But this hotel is old and dirty and lack of service. The staff is the worst part. I will never in my life will return to this hotel. Check in took me an hour to check-in.

reviews.author: roz000
reviews.title: False Advertising
reviews.text:
We have just comeback from Visiting Cancun. I booked Paradisus Cancun  Concerige Service Junior suite lagoon view. On their Melia Website it was flashing 1500 resort credits and kids stay free which was very appealing, I was lucky because I booked a rate that I could cancel. I confirmed the facts with the reservationist and awaited my email confirmation, When I did not receive it I called back and spoke with another agent, confirmed the kids free again and awaited my email. When I received the email it had charged me an additional $684 for my 12 year old. I called back the agent and she told me she could not see that promotion on the screen. I took photos from my screen and emailed them to her. When she called back She said that the dates I was booking were not included in that promotion. I said there was no disclaimer on the pronation We went back and forth and then she said well you booked a rate that could cancel so just cancel. I wrote to their customer care department and the response said that the dates I was going to book were not included.
So why is the promotion on the website and once I put my dates in are still flashing free kids and 1500 resort credits if booked through Melia. We went to Cancun and stayed elsewhere.  We took that rude agent's advice and canceled.  Beware and review your confirmation if you are booking with Melis.

reviews.author: serenachow
reviews.title: Getting worse every day
reviews.text:
1) Checking in was terrible, priority line is much slower than not priority lines  even there were only 2 groups in front of me. It was an hour waiting 
2) while checking in, I was asked to pay even I have the receipt. They went in the system and said I haven't pay. So I gave them my credit card and let them charge on it. Soon enough I checked my credit card on my phone and the transaction went through 2 weeks ago. I had to wait another 30 minutes to get the payment return. 
3) finally got my room key card and nothing else.  No one told us which way to go, where to eat, what time the restaurants open, password for wifi, who to call for dinner reservations Nothing at all
4) went to Fuego for dinner, took forever to get something to eat. Bring the desert was a joke, my kid literally took a nap about 20 minutes  to wait the desert.

5) room card didn't work! I went down to front desk and they "fixed" it. Of course it didnt work, went down 2nd time to have a new card key
6) market grill burger is very good but again took too long to get 

7) no hand towels after the housekeeping cleaned the room, also we need some dry towels too. We called  room service 3 hours ago, and now I am still in this room waiting for a dry towel 

This is our 2nd day here and it is Xmas eve,   What a terrible experience , especially during this time of year. There are something actually good: coffee shop, beach, kids club and the weather .

reviews.author: Emilio G
reviews.title: Horrible experience
reviews.text: The resort is beautiful. We came here last year and fell in love with the resort and the service. This year we decided to come back for more. First of all, our whole complaint had to do with the cleaning people, the people who service the rooms and the operator in charge of pyramid one. They weren't restocking our refrigerators and when we asked for beer they limit us to four beers per day when it's supposed to be all you can drink. Then everyday the cleaning people would sabotage something in our room. From shutting off all the power breakers in the room one day to the entrance cards to the room not working the next. When confronted they got defensive and started lying to our face about the situation. The bottom line is we will take our business elsewhere next year. We will tell all our friends and family not to book with Paradisus.

reviews.author: Boniouk
reviews.title: Noise noise and more noise
reviews.text: Building work in pyramid 4 meant a very unrelaxing week. Every morning from 6am through to around 11pm. Banging and hammering. Reported 7 times in the week and nobody cared, or they agreed and said it has to be done, or from their office 200 yards the other way said they couldn't hear it so it wasn't happening.

reviews.author: billgreene14
reviews.title: Aweful.
reviews.text: The food was all inclusive, but we ended up having to spend more of our money on local food because the food at the Paradisus was so awful. Soggy, unflavored, raw, we even had bone in our chicken quesadillas one night at the resort. This was a aweful expirence. The hotel had all kinds of different smells just walking down the hall. And not the good smells either. I wish I had just saved my money and stayed home. Once in a life time trip for me, will not be forgotten because of the pleasurable expirences we had. Thanks for waisting my money and my once in a life time expirence, Paradisus

reviews.author: Dollyd321
reviews.title: Stairs everywhere! Dimly lit. Very dangerous! Constant pumping of insence everywhere and no washrooms easily found!
reviews.text: Pools are too deep for children.  Not family friendly.  Too many stairs to beach. Two full flights! Biggest problem is lighting. So dark. Very scary. There will surely be accidents from anyone falling!  Beds in lounges rather than chairs. Again not comfortable! Do you want to lie down with strangers? That's the bottom line.

reviews.author: Bjetttttt
reviews.title: Disappointing - and this is our FOURTH trip to this resort!
reviews.text:
Let me /begin with CHECK-IN.  Arrived at noon.. our room was not ready until 3  - fine, but arrived at 3:30 - was given keys to a room with NO AIR CONDITIONING!  We were tired from the flight, and it would have been considerate when checking in for the front desk to let us know that the A/C was out throughout the entire property until approx 8pm!!  We would have left the resort and went to somewhere else with A/C if we had known!   What did they do?  "don't worry we will compensate you'.. So they gave us keys to another room in tower 1 - long walk to the other side of the property - to the same type room but still with NO A/C!  Then offered another room (same as our ocean view) - which was the SAME - NO A/C.  The blower was even broken in this room - so no air flow at all.  The supervisor Veronica came to the room and told us the blower was working.  She didn't believe me until I stood on a chair and showed her what we meant.   Seriously?  She was the one who said we would be 'compensated', -- why in the world would you not accommodate a guest who had to stand on a chair to prove the blower was not working?  Why would you not compensate a guest who you knowingly handed keys to a HOT room that would remain HOT for 5 more hours??  All she could say was that this was the best they could do and the manager was in the next day.   We expected to hear something from the manager, but never a word-- and this is day 6!

So we stayed in the room we had our luggage in - and did not have a cool room until 9pm.   Compensation?  No - nothing.  They called to see if our a/c was working later that night, that's it. 

I noted we have been to this resort 4x in past two years and loved it.  This time is different.  We wonder if the management has changed because things were NOT the same and we were just here in February on our honeymoon!  This trip was an anniversary of my husband proposing to me last September, so it is sentimental to both of us - and we had planned on returning every year to celebrate.  Now we are thinking about looking elsewhere.  We spend a LOT of money when we come here and we have other choices, but we chose Paradisus to stay. 

Bana:  The food was subpar.  That is the restaurant where he proposed to me, so it was kind of special to return there, but we were not happy.  The food was sooo much better in February and the other two times we visited!!!  

I wrote a review on day 2 here at Tripadvisor and it told me it was 'under review' and I have not seen it posted.. so let me recap our 7 day trip. 

Today is day 6 of our stay and in addition to the lack of caring on check-in problems with no a/c -- here are other things that happened. 
1.  Had to call for soda and ice delivery 3x each time we made a request. 
2. Had to call for toilet paper -- did not receive it until late afternoon when they made up the room. 
3. Room keys.. during this stay - had to have the keys re-keyed 3x .. so far. 
4. The room mattress was completely broken down -- my husband's back is bad and on day 2 - had to have this replaced.  That did happen.. but took a couple of hours. 
5.  Pictures.  Oh the pictures.  We ALWAYS commemorate our trip with pictures taken by Outdoor photography, an company on-site.  We have been so pleased always with these photos, until, of course, this time.  I do NOT recommend the photographer we had Enrique -- as the photos turned out terrible.  He didn't seem to know the basic fundamentals of being a photographer.  Which is really truly sad because the water was amazing and the day was perfect for photos.  We were excited to see the 50+ shots until we viewed them.  Oh my gosh.. only two were acceptable which we reluctantly purchased. 

It is ridiculous to book a trip like this 6 months in advance in anticipation of greatness that you had the other 3 trips before and then have these things happen.  We feel like it really doesn't matter that we are patrons who keep coming here and recommend this place to EVERYONE we know!  The lack of response from management speaks loud and clear that we do not matter to them. 

I had seen on facebook that a lady wrote a review for Paradisus and said that she was complimentary upgraded to Royal Service for FREE upon checking in as well as other people in the lobby.   I wrote a letter to Paradisus last month, not asking for Royal Service, but an upgrade to a bigger room.  They wrote back and said no- but for $75/night I could have royal service lagoon view.  We do NOT like lagoon view as we always pay extra for the ocean view.   I thought being 4x patrons, asking for a bigger room was not really asking for much, but apparently it was.  I wanted to surprise my husband, but was not able to.  We spent $2800 to visit Paradissus -- spent over $600 in tips/gifts throughout the week.  Spent a lot of money shopping in Cancun.  All of this -- for a week.. to have a less than acceptable visit.  

 If the management of this establishment cares about their repeat patrons, they should really fix all of this!  That will determine whether we ever visit Paradisus Cancun EVER again.   We were actually going to plan a family trip next year for us and our 3 daughters; however, seeing the cost that would be involved, we want the trip to be memorable for our kids -- soooo glad we did not bring them this time!  We always RAVE about this resort and if they came with us during this stay - we would have looked like liars to them.

reviews.author: Diana D
reviews.title: Terrible Experience!
reviews.text: My family and I ran into multiple issues with room 3501. We had to go to the concierge at least 1-2 times a day (we stayed 5 nights) to get our room cards re-keyed. They said it was because we held it close to our phones and tech devices. That was proven not to be true. They key would work as soon as they were re-keyed but within 1-2 hours of sitting at table near NO tech devices, it would not read. The concierge was aware and had sent someone to check but it continued to be an issue throughout our trip. (This was very annoying having to visit the concierge twice a day.) The last night we were here, a terrible accident happened where the restroom mirror in our room fell over on my dad. Luckily he caught it and held it so it wouldn't fall on his feet. There were shattered glass everywhere! I dialed "0" the concierge and explained the situation, and stressed that someone needs to go to our room immediately as my dad was still holding the glass mirror! I called twice and waited in the hallway for just anyone to come by and saw no one. I was getting anxious and scared since I didn't know if my dad was hurt or cut in anyway, so I went down 4 floors to the concierge. I was very upset then, since no one still had come up and it took faster for me to go to them then to us. I had to explain how serious this situation was so the girl at the front called someone to make sure someone came by. This could have been fatal if my dad had not caught the mirror. This is very disappointing coming from a 4.5 star hotel. There was no sense of urgency! All in all, the way the hotel handled the situation ruined my perception of the Paradisus Hotel.

reviews.author: Andrew Bloch
reviews.title: Don't be fooled by the nice photos on the website!
reviews.text:
The website looks lovely.  When you walk in, the reception is pretty cool.  A bit dark, but nice and modern and a lively atmosphere.  From there on in, that's where the positives end.  I checked in with my family for what was due to be a one week stay.  I'd stayed at lots of Melia hotels in Spain and they have always been great.  This one, however, was nothing short of a disgrace.

The check in process took over an hour - two different receptions, numerous forms to fill out, wrist bands, voucher books, a phone to reach your butler...it went on and on, to the point where I had lost the will to live.

 Eventually, we got to the room - a family suite, and apparently the best room in the hotel.  What a dump.  Old fashioned, basic, dirty, no storage, a balcony with high concrete walls you couldn't see over.  The photos on their website must have been twenty years old. It was like looking at a different hotel (it wasn't...I double-checked!)

By this point, we were tired and hungry, so we left the bags in the room without unpacking and went downstairs to get something to eat.  The buffet was a health hazard.  Food and mess everywhere.  No one to show you to your table, no waiters.  The food was inedible. It was like being in a prison canteen. 

With that, I had seen all I needed to see.  After spending literally a couple of hours at the hotel (mainly at the check-in desk!) we told the reception we would like to check out.  He implied that he wasn't surprised and he would arrange a full refund via our travel agent the next day (we paid in advance).  We left and booked into a different hotel.

Needless to say, no one contacted our travel agent, and nearly three weeks later and after numerous unanswered  phone calls and emails, we are still trying to get our money back.  

A very disappointing experience.  

There are lots of nice hotels in Cancun.  The Paradisus isn't one of them.

reviews.author: Karlene A
reviews.title: Terrible - from check in to check out!
reviews.text:
Made requests before arriving at the hotel and none of it was registered, at check in the staff seemed clueless. Not a place for teenage kids, my two kids were absolutely bored. The bar service at Avenue bar was horrible, the night time activities were sorely lacking. The menu at the buffet was repetitive, some days the restaurant was dirty. I requested a wheelchair for my son and was never told I had to pay a daily rental for this service. Had to pay additional for the beds both beach and poolside, not a true all-inclusive experience! I stayed 5 nights and enjoyed none of it! 

When we couldn't take the boredom at the resort and decided to rent a car and go out to the cenotes, on arriving back to the boulevard, we were pulled over by the police and asked to pay, "off the records" for speeding. The officers told us the fine is USD300 and if we paid USD150 we did not have to go to the police station. We later found out that the fine for speeding is USD80 bucks.

Cancun is a beautiful place, outside the resort the Mexicans are great people.

reviews.author: Grisel M
reviews.title: DO NOT TRUST AT ALL THIS REVIEWS, YOU BEEN ADVICE.
reviews.text: Let me start by i made the reservatio beliving on the reviews when i book this hotels food in the hotel buffet is horrible,hotel is very tired,so as the rooms ,the hotels is a quarter of a mile from the main road so you have to walk from the main road everyday if you do excursions or go outsite the hotel,after that walk,be ready for 60 steps(my family call it the chichen itza) every single day 60 steps ,there is no golf car for the guess to provide that service,we went with my parents 75 and 71 year old with a mild disability and a 7 year old child that after been out the whole day that child was exhausted,the golf car is only available in the morning to "sell you" a vacation plan .       the pool was horrible, if you check the bar by the pool is falling apart and has mold really discusting .the front of the hotel is nicely painted "the back" hasen't been paint in years .only went to the pool one .the beaches in cancun are "not good"actually it can be dangerous, a lot of waves and very very deep .the specialties restaurants are ok,you have to make reservations at 7:00 am the night before bc it gets pack very quickly. PARADISUS CANCUN  the scents in the lobby give you a head acheT NEVER NEVER AGAIN.

reviews.author: Fletcher3233
reviews.title: Horrible Experience!!
reviews.text:
Let me first off start with Ive honestly never written any kind of negative survey in any sort including yelp etc. 
My son and I arrive late Sunday night and they did not have my reservation. I explained to the front desk manager I did not bring my confirmation since all the correspondence was through my work email etc and I did not bring my work phone or laptop. However I was able to look up my billing statement through my credit card and calling my credit card company of the charge to the hotel. Didn't matter! The manager stated that it didn't matter because in their system they did not have any reservation under my name.  At one point he basically stated that there was no possible way they made the mistake and sincerely became down ride rude. Because it was Sunday they night they said their reservation offices were closed and they could not verify till the morning. I ended up having to pay $380 for Sunday night on a separate credit card. I talked first thing to the reservations office on Monday and they greatly apologized for the mistake and they would refund the $380 and everything was taken care of. Since I'm running out of space I wish I could continue about the rest of the week and horrible service as well its now been over 2 months and Ive never received the refund of $380 and had to report the issue to the credit card company. There are tons of beautiful hotels and resorts in Cancun and I would kindly plea for you to stay anywhere else!!

reviews.author: Ktwa2
reviews.title: false advertisement horrible customer service
reviews.text:
Our family booked our trip because this was our 15th wedding anniversary and my husband and I were going to renew our vows.  Trip was booked over a year via a travel agent.  We booked an 8day/7night family concierge ocean view room because the hotel offered a Wish Package for weddings and such.  We had a very hard time getting our vow renewal finalized because people wouldn't return our emails and were sending us peoples personal information about a wedding in February to our email.  After trying to work with each dept that we had to after getting a manager involved.  During our stay at the hotel our "butler" Fernanda and the rest of the butler staff were horrible.  We were supposed to get certain things in our room for the family concierge services and we didn't.  Kids size items ex bath soaps, bath robes, kid size pillows, kids welcome bag with sand toys, nightly milk and cookies, parents pillow menu.  
Well needless to say the kids size bath soaps are baby soap baby lotion and baby shampoo not for a 10yr old.  Kids welcome bag we had to ask for since our daughters were excited and looking for it when we walked in the room.  They got a Barbie tooth brush and tooth paste and a toddler size tee shirt.  (Our youngest child is 10)
Milk and cookies yeah that happened 2 nights only.  Pillows for kids never saw them at all kids bathrobe had 1st day and house keeping took it and never got it back.  parents pillow menu when we asked about it no one knew what it was.  Dinner reservations were a joke as well.  Had to beg for a restaurant for 6 even though we should get a confirmed reservation according to the concierge info.  They put us in a restaurant that both my dad and husband had allergies to the food and gave us a hard time to get reservations at a different location.  
Wedding coordinator was supposed to meet with us and confirm all the details for the renewal.  Melina sent an email to me confirming to meet us at 3:00pm to go over details for our renewal.  Well she NEVER showed up no one knew where she was nor could they find her. After 2 attempts we meet with someone else whom had not a clue about our renewal and offered little input as to what we would be doing.  Spoke with the manager of Concierge because of us not being able to get the coordinator and the fact that we still didn't have confirmation on restaurant changes. She was rude and said I will confirm them.  Next day our Butler told us she couldn't get the dinner locations we requested there was no availability. (even though the manger the day prior said she will get them).  Her answer was No Ma'am there are no tables available at Market Grill for your family tonight.  I later got a call from the manager scolding me like I was 2yrs old telling me I told you I confirmed the table you have a reservation. I tried to explain what Fernanda had told us and her response was I don't care I told you this yesterday and you shouldn't have asked the butler about it.  When I told her that Fernanda came to me about it she said I don't care.  After having an issue after issue at the hotel we asked to speak with the hotel manager.  The concierge manager came to us (same lady that we had been speaking to) we were trying to explain what was going on.  When we were speaking our 10yr old had started to say something and the manager stops her and said Im speaking to your mother not you as she grabbed her arm and squeezed it.  At that point I told her she was out of line and don't ever speak to my child in that manner and DONT ever place a finger on her.  I went and spoke with the Hotel Manager at that point. He apologized for everything and told me he would get to the bottom of the issue and help us make our stay (which was just one day) nice.  He would do something special for our family especially our kids.  He agreed with us that the kids amenities are geared towards babies and toddlers that his 11yr old son makes the same comments about the baby style things he gets when he stays there.  He asked that I forward him some of the emails and he would be in touch with me.  I forwarded him an email that evening after our vow renewal because once again things weren't done.  As part of the wish package you get special things one was a bottle of wine the night of the ceremony.  When we went to open the bottle we couldn't cause the cork was one that needed an opener nothing was provided called down to room service and the concierge office and we were told someone would be right up no one came.  Our license and our sand we did during the ceremony was to come to our room that night.  Nope had to fight with them the next day as we are packing to leave.  We got the items with in 15 mins before we were to leave the room.  After all this we were to get our refund to our card for the vow renewal it is a deposit and refund with in 2 weeks home 3 weeks and refund is still not received.  The special stuff the manager said he would do for the kids resulted in absolutely NOTHING.  I would not at all recommend this hotel for the family concierge services.  It is a scam and falsely advertised to us.  The details I have written here are just some of the problems.  Will add this note BE CAUTIONS WHEN WALKING INTO THE POOL  THE TILE IS VERY SLIPPERY AND I ALONG WITH MULTIPLE GUEST FELL GETTING INTO THE POOL.

reviews.author: Sonny D
reviews.title: Don't stay here
reviews.text: Pool staff were awesome, most staff work really hard. Some (very few) are lazy. Painting during stay. Very pushy timeshare. Reservation screw ups, lack of towels. No communication about activities. Hot hot hot, some restaurants not so good. Mole and Market Grill were awesome. Poor quality of breakfast. Two of us were sick after we got home from travelers diarrhea...

reviews.author: sean P
reviews.title: Hardly a 3 star hotel
reviews.text:
- Most of the advertised amenities on the website are only for Royal packages so if you purchase a regular all inclusive package, be ready to be rejected at the pool table, some restaurants, Jacuzzi, beach benches, etc ...
- This hotel (not resort) is hardly 3 stars. This hotel is more of a giant arboretum than a resort and it is only air conditioned in the rooms and couple of the restaurants so prepare for sweating after dinner for any activities.
- Room check in: Disaster. We got our room at 4pm. No one gives you an straight answer specially for big groups.
- Food: same mediocre food minus good seafood every day and nights.
- Activities for kids: unlike what the website says, there are non except one sand volley ball court for the whole hotel guest. Pool table are only for Royal members. So is the Jacuzzi. So much for ALL INCLUSIVE.
- The rooms: the ocean view rooms have a good view of the ocean but the A/C sounds like a truck all night.
- The beach is very choppy and deep so no playing for small kids. 
- Pools: clean but the water is boiling hot after 10am.
- My friend dented the corner of the outdated TV in the room by accident and the security took his luggage hostage until he paid $1500 US dollars. 
- Last but not the least, part of the restaurant ceiling fell down and almost injured the guests due to old building and poor maintenance. (Photos attached)

reviews.author: vallarta76
reviews.title: Terrible Experience / Very disappointed as I've been a loyal Paradisus guest
reviews.text:
My husband and I have stayed at Paradisus La Esmeralda in PDC for 6 years straight.  This time around we decided to stay at Paradisus Cancun in hopes we would experience the same exceptional service and wonderful vacation as we have at La Esmeralda, Boy was I wrong.  My husband, 3 year old, 8 month old and I (party of 4) stayed from June 24, 2016 thru July 1, 2016

1) We arrive at PC at 4pm and it took about 40 minutes to check in, mind you there was only 1 person ahead of us to check in, so I am not sure why the delay.  Geovanny was the desk agent who was helping us.  Very unfriendly and dry, not a way to make an impression when you first arrive and you are so excited to start your vacation. 

2) We go up to our room and as we enter our Key and open the door, we discover this room is occupied! The guest who were in the room and my family of 4 were completely in shock, humiliated and embarrassed to say the least.  We went back to check in desk and advised Geovanny of the embarrassing situation and the big mistake he had just made. At the time he was helping another guest, whom by this time was very upset at the long check in process.  30 minutes later he hands me new keys to a different room.

3) 2nd room AC doesn't work, it was super hot and settings were at their lowest.  This was unacceptable.  My husband went back to front desk and Geovanny told us he couldn't do anything because all rooms were booked for the night and to return the next morning. Of course that was unacceptable, so therefore we asked to speak to a manager and was directed to Guadalupe.  Guadalupe apologizes for the inconvenience and tells us she will upgrade our room and give her about 1 hour so they can clean it. She suggested we go have dinner and when done our room should be done, Wrong!!!

3) 7pm and still no room, 3 hours later with 1 crying baby, 1 restless toddler and 2 adults who are tired from a 5 hour flight and due to the above circumstances we still don't have a room.  We go have dinner as suggested and on our return at 8pm, we see Guadalupe to tell us that our room is still not ready. At this point, I've had it and give her a piece of my mind in a calm way as I don't believe yelling gets you anywhere.  Of course, at this point she suggest we go have dinner and come back. Ugghhh, Excuse me you suggested that 1 hour ago did you forget?  I bluntly told her that her lies were unacceptable and that I was very sure that the room wasn't ready because they forgot about it and now they were going to have housekeeping have it ready.  She did acknowledge that they screwed up again but rest assure this time would be ready and give her 40 minutes. I was very clear that I wanted a room that had no issues because I was not putting my kids thru hell a 4th time. She said this room was perfect and she gave her word we wouldn't have any problems.

4) Finally we check in at 9:30pm, yes 5 1/2 hours later!!!! Room looks great.  Not too soon, Our bed is broken and  we wake up at 6 am to find our bathroom flooded and a broken toilet. Called in front desk and we were evacuated at 9 am and were let back in around 1 pm once they fixed the problem but of course their was a possibility that they would change us to another room.  I was not looking forward to it since our first day was a day from hell and now into our second day we didn't start off on a good note either. Bathroom was eventually fixed and we opted to stay in the room as we didn't want to move our kids for the 4th time.

5) Dinner reservations were set for Enso at 7:30pm for Saturday 25th, I called to confirm our reservation of 8 as we were traveling with another family and they tell me my reservation was cancelled.  Of course they couldn't tell me who cancelled it, other than all restaurants were booked and they couldn't offer any other seatings but Naos the buffet.  I was very clear that they had to figure it out and I wanted my reservation back.  In the meantime the whole reservation process was a nightmare because you can only reserve for next day and if you don't do it by 9 am they tell you they are book and they can't guarantee the restaurant you want.  Mariana was the gal who helped me and I was very upset and told her that our vacation had already started off rocky and thats the last thing I needed.  I made it clear that I would write a bad review.  She then tells me she would talk to the captain and call me back in 20, she was going to try and fix the error and investigate as to who could've canceled my reservation.  Mariana calls me back as promised, to tell me that they were able to make an exception and give me back my reservation and she filled in my request for the following days.

6) Service all around was Hot & Cold. One waiter would be so nice and happy to service you and the next would provide crappy service.  I did tip those that provided great service and went on and beyond.

7) Dinner at Fuego was the best all other restaurants food was okay nothing to ride about.  Naos breakfast buffet was not great but not bad either and they had a big selection of items to choose from.

All in all I wont be returning.  Definitely does not meet my expectations of a 4.5 star hotel from a run down hotel, to the inconsistency of their service.

PS, please tone down the incense.  It's so overpowering, it just makes you feel dizzy and spikes up your allergies.

reviews.author: mviseh
reviews.title: Don’t waste your money
reviews.text:
•	Wrong information about the rooms on their website.
•	I couldn't find any manager to complain about the rude staff. The hotel runs without manager. 
•	The Hotel was Hot because the both sides doors were wide open.
•	We had hard time to find a room with a decent AC. The technical staff had no idea of fixing the stuff at hotel.
•	We had to call several times for fixing the TV.
•	We couldn't get an appointment from any hotels' restaurant even there was no people at the restaurants. Basically, they push people to the buffet.
•	We could leave the Hotel at 12 noon and we let them know as well, but they turn of the AC and cable around of 10:00 am.
•	This was one of the worst vacations I ever had and we picked this hotel because of their 5 stars and best reviews. I don’t know how they got these reviews and who gave them. 
•	Don’t waste your money.

reviews.author: N Belcher
reviews.title: Seriously dead plants on the balcony
reviews.text:
Ok, I am currently at Paradisus Cancun and all I can say is please update your rooms and your service.  Here is my list
1. Outdated rooms 
2. Dead plants on the balcony 
3. Mold on the ceil 
4. Nasty toilets bleach is awesome

Being dirt must be common here.
