reviews.author: Nick A
reviews.title: TV was not working in room 3528 breaker was going of line, maintenance came for 3 straight night and they did not offer.
reviews.text: bad service for room 3528 the TV was not working and the breaker was going of line. Maintenance personal were called for 3 straight night. They didn't really fix the problem and they did not offer to upgrade my room or give me a discount at the end.

reviews.author: Michelle S
reviews.title: My heart will not go on.
reviews.text: I'm in my room right now trying to relax which is impossible because they are BLASTING god dam Celine Dion my heart will go on. Oh wait now we've moved on to Toni Braxton unbreak my heart. Is this supposed to be relaxing? I've never experienced anything like this in any of my 11 trips to cancun. It's totally ridiculous.

reviews.author: jendelosreyes
reviews.title: Worst vacation
reviews.text:
My husband and I and my cousin and her husband decided to take a trip to cancun and stay in paradisus because of all the hype, even our travel agent recommened it. However, from the moment we stepped into the hotel the experience was mediocre at best. First of all, our room wasnt ready at the promised time. On our second day, my cousins roof in her room started to crumble and fall on her head. About 40 minutes later maintenace get there. By this time we had already wasted half a day. Understandably so we were very upset; so they promised to move our rooms and UPGRADE both rooms. My cousin got an upgrade but my husband and I got 2 separate beds in the same room type we had before. When we went to inquire, they said they were out of the room they had promised us. At this point we were furious so they promised us 4 free massages. The massages were anything but free... we had to sit through a 90 min presentation and then they only wanted to give us 2 massages. We asked for them call manager and they said they had none on campus. What kind of hotel doesnt have a manager?

Another issue- In order to eat at any of their restaurants you need to reserve 1 day in advance, forget about walkin they never have space. 

The last straw was we took pictures paid for them and when we went to pick them up they said they werent ready and would ship them to us. When we paid for the pictures we were clear and told them we would be leaving they said no problem they would be ready, that obviously wasnt the case. 

Then to try to"fix it" they gave us a voucher for a "free vacation"  which is far from free, its actually 180 pp per night. 

I have never been more dissatisfied with a vacation, I will not be coming here again.

reviews.author: A1574HVRyan
reviews.title: Poor Customer Service
reviews.text: I was charged twice, it took almost 2 weeks to resolve the issue. Our butler almost never answered the phone, when he did, he never did anything we asked him to do. We did not have enough towels in our room. We requested towels 2 days in a row and never received them. Water leaked from the ceiling in the bathroom, we were told to "just turn the air conditioning off!" It was 95 degrees outside! Hostess was rude at the Market Grill. Our waitress at the Bali Beds only came to check on us once. Our friends waiter came like every 20 minutes! Very Poor Customer Service, the resort is nice minus the people.

reviews.author: Maria R
reviews.title: STAY AWAY FROM LETICIA ROYAL SERVICE
reviews.text:
"We stayed from January 20 to January 24 the acting honestly and found amazing staff , warmth and kindness, and to say our Rodrigo butler! It was very funny and made ​​us laugh all the time, he recommended restaurants and food and became good friends , plus we kept in touch with him and he told us is Dad !!! Every day you were leaving an envelope with $ 50 for the baby from the first day , and when we said we never got NOTHING we feel angry !!! Every day the concierge LETICIA received the envelopes. And now Rodrigo tells us not to receive anything ! LETICIA STOLE A BABY !!! WE FEEL VERY ANGRY WITH THAT !!! Rodrigo work so hard and so well, and she stole it! Do not trust her, just trying to fool people in a sexist way! I hope to do something about it, there are many butlers who are in Royal Service and surely it also robs them ! For her NEVER be back! Please do not leave your money or belongings near her !
I want her to be fired !!!!, She does not deserve to be surrounded by such great people."

reviews.author: cjmspcun
reviews.title: Not worth the money
reviews.text:
My daughter and I stayed at the Paradisus Cancun over Spring break this year and from the first moment we arrived it was a pain! We arrived at 6:00 pm and were told we would have to wait for an hour for our room. We were given over to a Concierge who proceeded to sell us hard on every adventure she could think of as well as trying to get us to sign up for an hour and a half breakfast the next morning at 7:30 am to see the condos that were for sale. We signed up just to get away from her. 

When we arrived in our room we were given one King bed and not the two double beds we had booked. For the next three days we were told we would need to come to the front desk and check to see if any other rooms were available. The problem was that every morning no matter what time we stopped we were required to wait in the check in reception line for nearly an hour- we never did get a different room and after several days gave up!

To cut to the chase, room was not as described, room was never cleaned before 3:00 in the afternoon, no pool chairs or beach chairs even at 7:00 am in the morning, towels ran out every day and you couldn't get a clean towel, general helpfulness of the room service staff and front desk borderline RUDE!! 

I will NEVER go back to this hotel or ANY of its properties. Not four stars. I wouldn't give it more than two at best and not worth the expense. 

Hotel rooms need to be updated. Linens and towels (when available) were old and threadbare.

Worst vacation we have ever had and we have been to Mexico and Cancun 6 times over the years. Couldn't wait to leave!!!

reviews.author: Nikola B
reviews.title: Would definitely not recommend it!
reviews.text:
Well. Were to start? 
Room: it looked as if it never has been refurbished since 1988, when the hotel was first built. Bathroom-disaster -sink so dirty my wife was not able to brush her teeth without wishing to vomit. 
We paid extra for "family concierge" they told us teh room will be spacious etc. yes it was spacious. And....NOISY funnily the family room for small kids etc was situated next to the pool, where all the fun was. So everyday at exactly 14:00 when obviously is the time for kid to sleep the music starts with such power that frankly nobody could even hear  her/his thoughts. We asked several times for our room to be exchanged ... No way. Usual explanation: the hotel is fully booked. The next time they promised that there will be no more music at the pool. Well. The music went on and on :-( 
Another really important point: food. Well there are plenty of options. But they are not for human beings. No fantasy. No taste. Full with all kind of artificial tastes and addidtives. We tried to get booking for Tempo" restaurant-where you have to pay extra. For 4 days no one returned us call they put us on some imaginary "waiting list" but no one ever bothered to inform us. I could add many more points. I have also pictures but prefer not to waste anymore time even with memories for that joke of a hotel... There are so many better and surely cheaper options in Cancun and zone na Hotelera. 
Probably the only good thing there was the care from the kids corner... But that faded so fast...

reviews.author: tkastner60
reviews.title: Hot as hell where is the air!
reviews.text: I am a very cold natured person. I am dying here!! The air conditioning is horrible!!! This resort has gone downhill in the last year! Miserable vacation! Just want a little comfort! 👹 hot has hell!!! Don't waste your money on Royal service it is a sweat box too!

reviews.author: Anna D
reviews.title: Horrible Wedding Location
reviews.text:
If you're thinking of doing your wedding at Paradisus Cancun, please consider another location.  First off just a brief description, I had my destination wedding for 61 guests in February.  There were so many things that went wrong so I broke up the review into wedding details and the hotel itself.  

The wedding details:
I would have looked away for many of the issues, however on the day of the wedding, the wedding coordinator, Cynthia, was cold, rude and completely inflexible, literally holding our wedding hostage!   We had our ceremony on the beach and it was beautiful until it all of a sudden rained.  I understood that this was a change in plans, however the manner in which she approached things was not right.  She asked if we would want to wait and see if the rain would stop or if we should just move inside.  Given that it was raining really hard and suddenly the tables were already soaked so we decided to move inside right away.  She stated it would take her about an hour to set up the inside "ballroom" location (looks more like a crappy convention center). We agreed that this would be best and we waited in the avenue B lounge with other hotel guests, which was ok.  However my guests did not get any of the cocktail hour snacks, which I had paid for.  Then the unprofessionalism started, after over an hour I went to get an update from Cynthia and she was extremely rude.  I asked if the wedding was going to be extended to make up for the lost time and she said the rain was not her fault and she can cancel the wedding if she wanted.  She didn't allow us to start the reception until my husband went to the office and paid for the extra hour on the spot since we did not want a 1.5 hour reception.  Besides for being so unaccommodating and unfriendly, first off, she was late at the start of the wedding also.  She brought my bouquet, my bridesmaid's bouquets and my mother's corsage to the room late so we couldn’t even take photos and worst of all she was late picking us up to start the wedding.  So right away we were starting off on the wrong foot.  She didn't know which side the guys were supposed to go vs the girls when they were walking down the aisle. 
 Even despite this I would have been ok, except for the fact that they are thieves too.  We were supposed to receive credits which we did not receive, in fact they were charging us for the credits.  We had over 30 rooms booked at the resort and were supposed to get some money back from that but they did not give us any of the incentives that were promised to us.  Basically if your friends booked through other websites like hotels.com or expedia, etc.  They did not count as a guest.  They required you to book in a group rate, which is significantly more expensive than other websites.  So I didn't want my guests to get ripped off.  They told me we can get up to 3 free rooms based on our size and in the end they did not honor it, even though they initially stated they would honor the other guests’ bookings. (We only received credit for one room)  We were also supposed to receive $500 credit based on the amount of money we spent during the wedding and they only have us a portion of that.  In addition to the extra hour that they charged us which was out of our control, they charged us for decorations we didn't use and food we didn't get to eat as well as welcome bags that were never delivered.  After the wedding they ignored all requests to discuss these payments.  We paid for all these extra things just to be able to move on and we thought we can work it out later.  After about 50 emails back and forth and escalations to the regional manager, Marilyn Cairo- with no response, I stated that I will be putting in my review and then I finally got a response.  Ester stated that they were so sorry and that Cynthia was no longer at the organization (likely for being a poor coordinator) and she would help me out and I never heard from her again.  All I have wanted is to get my money back and the credits that were promised to us.  Essentially they are holding just under $2000 hostage and that does not include the credit of 2 rooms, which they are not crediting us for even though I have email confirmations that say they would.  Likely in total we are looking at close to $5000 loss for no reason.   So that is why it has taken me 2 months to write my review because of all the back and forth.  The issue is still not resolved, however I didn't want other people to book their wedding here and having such a bad experience.  
During the planning process, it was also very difficult.  Again I would not have even mentioned these things if they didn't steal our money and hold our wedding hostage.  They want you to use their decorators, photographers, DJ etc, and if you find someone else w better reviews and want to bring them in, they charge $500 per outside vendor.  We wound up using all their vendors to avoid fees, except the DJ since the one we found was much more highly rated and much, much cheaper even despite the $500 fee.  The decorators did a good job but coordinating the wedding with them was extremely difficult and both the decorator and the wedding coordinator were not always responsive.  The wedding coordinator was also responsible for setting up dinner reservations for us and she did not do it for 2 of the nights despite putting it on our itinerary.  

Hotel Review:
The resort is nice and seems impressive when you come into the lobby, however the check in process was much to be desired.  We came in with a few of our guests as the first to arrive.  The wedding coordinator insisted we send our picture to have great service, well that did not happen.  The reception desk had no idea that we were the bride and groom and that there was a wedding going on.  As the bride and groom, we were supposed to receive an upgrade and they did not have that available to us until the following night.   We were checking in with a couple of our guests and they had to wait several hours to get their rooms and weren't able to access their luggage.   Once we finally sorted out the check in business we wanted to grab a bite and all the restaurants were closed.  So we needed to wait 30 minutes to even get anything to eat.  Once we got to the rooms, they were ok.  A bit outdated, but clean.  The food was mediocre and it was very difficult coordinating dinners.  I wanted to have some dinners with a large group and they only accommodate 15 people at a time.  You need to make your restaurant reservations in advance to make it to the smaller ones.  The Bana restaurant was not very good, with average sushi.  The Mexican restaurant is mediocre which I would have expected more.  However the biggest disappointment is 6 star Michelin rated restaurant Tempo.  The service was excellent, however there was nothing significantly impressive about the food.  I’ve dined in  Michelin rated restaurants in NYC and around the world, this restaurant was good and it was definitely fine dining, but nothing special.   The staff didn’t even know the cost of the wine and the dinner.  Vento was the only restaurant that was accommodating to fit my guests however they offered wine to my guests that was not all inclusive and didn’t let us know and we were charged $500 for that dinner because of their deceit.   The beach was nice however there was significant seaweed on certain days making it disgusting to go in the water.   So we went to the pool most of the days and the floor of the pool is so broken down that you need to be really careful walking on it or you'll definitely get hurt.  There were huge pot holes essentially on the pool grounds that are in desperate need of repair. 

Overall, I would never recommend this resort given their lack of integrity, professionalism, mediocre food and drinks.

reviews.author: Gaetania
reviews.title: Paradisus
reviews.text: This was our second year of staying at the Paradisus    We very much enjoyed the first visit   Service was great as well as the staff   Our concierge did a fantastic job!  Even though it was in need of quite a bit of renovations and updating they were working on some of the problems so we assumed all would have been completed by the time we arrived this year.  Big mistake on my part!   It was in worse condition!!   We stayed in room 4305 both times   Nothing was improved upon at all    This could be a really nice room as it is a one bedroom suite with 2 bathrooms   Also has 3 balconies   Unfortunately none had outdoor furniture!   We asked our concierge Gabriel 3 times for that and never got it    We were supposed to have 12 noon room cleaning and 6 pm turn down service    Most days we had to call for the room to be cleaned and very rarely did the whole suite get cleaned   Turn down service happened 3 times   Just a note we stayed almost 2 weeks!!   The first 3 nights we received evening snacks which consisted of champagne & berries,  wine & cheese twice  all tasted like vinegar   So disappointing!!   Constantly had to call for restocking of mini bar and water    Also had to call quite a bit to get dinner reservations that the concierge was also supposed to take care of   When you're paying for concierge services you expect them at the very least to just do their jobs!   The high point of this resort was that the food was really good   Wait staff was excellent   This will be my last trip to Paradisus or any of the Melia resorts even though I am a member!   This vacation was so bad that I've booked a trip to St Martin in a few weeks for a do-over!!

reviews.author: douglas l
reviews.title: Black Cloud Over 50th Birthday Vacation
reviews.text: We stayed at the Paradisus Cancun Resort for 6 nights.  Upon arrival at 9pm, the desk said our travel arrangements setup online with BookIt.com had not yet paid for our rooms. they explained that "this is common and to give us your credit card so they could have reassurance that they will get paid" and "check with us in the morning and Bookit should have paid for it by then".  It was late so I agreed.  I checked back the next morning and still no payment, they told me to call Bookit and maybe they will expedite the payment which I did that afternoon.  Bookit claimed they paid for the room, again the hotel said they had not.  This went on my entire stay with a lot of time on phone calls and at the desk until finally the night before my checkout, the hotel said that Bookit paid for the rooms at 330pm of that day.  Basically, the entire trip I had the sinking feeling that I might have to pay for the room twice!.  My issue with Paradisus is they knew and have been having problems with Bookit.com for sometime. They continued to tell me that "I'm not the only one" and "this has been happening with Bookit a lot".  My response was "why are you allowing Bookit to book your hotel if you know this has been a problem".  It's a shame that they would allow this company to put their guests through this.  I'm extremely disappointed in how they handled our situation and hope this sheds light on others so they do not get "trapped" in this scenario.

reviews.author: Egle J
reviews.title: Horrible
reviews.text:
The hotel feels like 2.5 stars and definitely not 4.5 as they claim. It lacks in all aspects. Upon check-in they gave us an old ugly room in the basement of the hotel facing the main street, after I complained they gave us another ugly outdated room with dirty sofa and broken cabinets, very ugly. Then after I screamed on them that their rooms are nothing like displayed in Expedia pictures, they gave me a third room, supposedly "nicer". We didn't want to adventure through more rooms so we stayed there. The room was outdated, bathroom (with one sink) old, bathroom door broken with no lock at all, light switches broken, dirty towel, no bathrobes or slippers... Also the room was in the main pyramid, we (with 2 kids) couldn't sleep half of the night due to noise, loud music and drunk people screaming in hallways. 
The buffet was the worst I've ever experienced (we've been to Mexico 15+ times), food for lunch and dinner cold and really really bad, with very little options.
Pools cold and very old. Service OK. We are experienced Travelers who travel to Cancun, Rviera Maya 2-3 times a year and stay only at 4/4.5/5 star hotels. We know how 4.5 star hotel feels like, and this was a total dump, 2.5 stars at most. 
Total disaster, I wish I could get my money back.

reviews.author: Dee M
reviews.title: Lovely hotel disappointing experience
reviews.text: We are currently staying at Paradisus, the resort and all inclusive has been a wonderful experience. However, we have booked couple months in advance for a King size room which hotel management could not accomodate us but instead they put us in double bed room on the top floor which we were pleased with. 2nd night, our hotel room had no water and maintenance came up and told us to have front desk take care of us..and when we spoke to KAREN at front desk she simply asked why we had no water in our room and told us why bother coming down stairs (as she laughed in our face). Then we asked for management if they could provide us with any assistance and she told us a simple no, and that she could stick us in double bed room (again) on the ground floor. She did not offer us with any inconvenience services which we were very disappointed in after the way we were treated by KAREN. But eveything from the beach, amenities, hotel, and staff was a pleasant stay here at Paradisus.

reviews.author: paradisusinjustice
reviews.title: Hotel from Hell
reviews.text:
Trip advisor, you really failed me this time.  I was at the Paradisus, cancun (a Melia hotel) for less than 24 hours.  We ate at their buffet which was mediocre at best.  We get to the room and the balcony light needs to be fixed, the safe needs to be fixed, there are no reservations for ANY, I repeat ANY restaurants in their "all inclusive" offer for the duration of our stay, there were no available pool cabanas for purchase.  

Then this happens.......One of their guests actually grabbed my neck and tried to push me in to the pool.  Mind you, I'm a 30 something female with my 4 year old and 2 year old in the kids pool....OVER CHAIRS!!!!!  He assumed since the chairs that had been brought to me in the same location as his were that I had "stolen" his chairs.  Are we in third grade here?  I told him the name of the gentleman who had brought me the chairs and he starts cussing me out and goes to throw my cell phone and bag in to the pool. I stopped him from throwing it and he says, well then I'll throw you in - and grabs my neck.  Who knows what stopped him...maybe his hysterical wife calling to him in the background.  What did the hotel do?  Not a thing.  6 of their employees were standing there watching, security took over 10 min to arrive.  At this point the man had left with his family and was walking far down the beach away from the hotel.  I literally could not believe that they let him walk away.  Of course at this point I don't know what other trash they let stay at the hotel, so we checked out and found a nearby hotel (Definitely splurge for the Ritz when you go).  At check out, I find that they questioned him and he said that I had hit his daughter first, and they left it at that.  Did they ask any of the staff?  How about the other guests who came to say they witnessed the whole situation?  NOPE...so..stay away, if not because the hotel has crappy service and is half falling apart then because they will let their trashy guests get away with anything and they don't give a crap what your stay is actually like.

reviews.author: Raigreene
reviews.title: Don't waste your money or your time!!!!
reviews.text: It was horrible from day one.  Arrived to a large drunken group that had rented out most of the resort. They were very loud and rude...we didn't sleep at all the first night with all of the noise.  Also, the 1 bedroom that they say sleeps 4 is laughable!  I will only accommodate 2.  The other 2 will sleep on a 4' long pull out cushion think that can't even accommodate a 5'2" petite female balled into a fetal position.  Oh, and it is actually on the floor... a floor with spiders.  The pool guy that you are suppose to make reservations with is NEVER at the pool.  You'd be lucky to find anyone to assist you with anything. They will not help with any concerns.  I sat to speak with the front desk and watched as they helped people in front of me to not deal with my concerns.  Completely ignored.  Staff not very friendly at all.  Will never go back!!! NEVER!!!

reviews.author: MonicaUSA12345
reviews.title: NIGHTMARE !!! Don't even think about this resort ...
reviews.text: We spent one week in Paradisus Cancun. In simple words: very packed with people, very poor quality food, loooong lines if you want eat a breakfast or lunch, impossible to get decaf coffee after 6PM, very basic desserts, very loud noise every afternoon in main building makes impossible to take a nap or watch TV in every room, personal jokes instead of being helpful from some service people, empty balcony with no chairs or table, free WiFi practically is not working etc. etc.

reviews.author: Dee C
reviews.title: Could've been better
reviews.text: Paradisus resort was ok. My husband and I did Royal service, our butler Antiono wasn't the greatest. We asked to reserved a Bali bed and he never follow up with us. He would make reservations for us at a restaurant and when we show up, the hostess informed us, "they are no reservations made under that name." We had a jr deluxe room with twin beds, they push them to together but was extremely uncomfortable. When it's night fall, I would expect the hotel to light up but the hotel was dark, very dangerous, especially in the hallways. They spray the hotel with to many scents, it becomes to overpowering. Our toilet flooded one night, we barely got any sleep, because neighbors kept moving furniture around. The food was ok, only restaurant my husband and I enjoyed was Mole, our sever was superb! We ate at la Palap, our server Moises was awesome! He check on us, kept drinks coming. When I told him I was gluten free, he made sure to pass my allergen on to the other restaurants. Market Grill was ok, they did not understand my allergen and kept bringing me foods with wheat in it. The beach was nice, the only thing that was bothersome was the people that were selling all sorts of merchandise. If you looking for great show, go the Michael Jackson show, it was great! If we were to go back to a Paradisus hotel it would be the one in Playa de la Carmen, they definitely know what Royal service means.

reviews.author: slgsm
reviews.title: Horrible!!
reviews.text:
We are currently staying at the Paradisus Cancun and from the moment we got here it's been a horrible experience! Our first room had a horrible toxic smell that would not dissipate even with opening the patio doors. Not until the THIRD time we went to the front desk did they move us to another room. Our first room was very nice, a true suite with a bedroom, separate living room and two bathrooms. It also included robes and other nice amenities. We paid for a Jr. Suite with a king bed so we thought this was the suite. Knowing we could not sleep in a room with such a toxic smell, we didn't question the room we were moved to. We were so tired and just wanted to sleep. Upon arriving in the new room it was a definite down grade! It was a single standard room with two very small  double beds that were actually like an oversized twin bed. It was also near the main lobby and extremely noisy! Even with the air running I had to put in ear plugs to minimize the noise in order to sleep. I was also freezing because I had to keep the air on to help minimize the noise coming from the hallway. And of course there was no extra blanket in the room. Nor did it have the robes or other extras that the other room had or as nice of furnishings. The next day we spoke to a supervisor and they once again moved us to another room. This room is still a standard room in the club melia part of the resort. Again, extremely disappointing!! Oh, they did upgrade us from a lagoon view to an ocean view, which we appreciate, but still not nearly as spacious and as nice as the first room which apparently isn't the Jr suite, but a one bedroom suite. We only got that because it was a fluke upgrade due to availability. The standard hotel room they call a Jr suite which isn't a suite at all! Just an extremely basic room with a tiny bathroom. If the room we are in now is the standard club melia room I'm glad we're not members as it sucks!! Old and tired room! Nothing nice about it at all except for the ocean view.And to top it off when I went to take a shower the water was cold and wouldn't get hot! Also, we can't get internet access in our room! We have to sit on the balcony to connect to the Wifi. 
The other huge negative is you have to make reservations to eat dinner at most of the hotel restaurants. We arrived yesterday at 6:30ish pm. The were all booked for the evening. And when we tried to book a reservation for tonight, again, they were all booked!! So, what, you have to wake up at 7:00 am the day before to make reservations for the next night?!?! And people like us who arrive in the evening are then screwed for two nights of dinner in a restaurant other than the buffet. Horrible, horrible way to run a hotel!!! The other issue we encountered was not enough pool chairs, all were full when we arrived at the pool. And NO pool towels!! Then the two we did get were full of nasty stains including obvious blood stains. YUCK!!! I really didn't know if they had even been washed or just refolded from earlier that day! We've stayed in other cancun all inclusives and never encountered an issue like this! Needless to say, we find this hotel extremely disappointing and would never come here again and wouldn't recommend it to anyone else!

reviews.author: MiamiBeach2002
reviews.title: Complete disaster
reviews.text:
I just returned from Paradisus Cancun.   I had the worst experience of my life.   The food was awful, my whole family was sick from it most of the time.   I found the facility to be filthy, and the staff to be rude and incompetent.  
I found the hotel to be completely inflexible when it came to any accommodation or requests we had.  
Please do not spend a penny in this establishment, you will regret it.   There are 100 better places to stay in Cancun.

reviews.author: Kym S
reviews.title: Please Stay away from this hotel... Employee Thief
reviews.text:
STAY AWAY FROM THIS HOTEL...  HOTEL THIEF

We stayed at Paradius Cancun from September 29th to October 4th, 2015.  Since it was our Anniversary, we decided to upgrade to Royal Service were we were given our own Personal Buter.  Although the hotel is absolutely beautiful, our experience was horrible.

Our personal Butler, Juan, broke into our room while we were at the Spa and stole money from our safe.  We had a confirmed reservation for massages at the Spa, and while we were at the Spa the Butler broke into our room.   

I came back to the room to get money for a tip, and I actually walked in on the Butler in the middle of the act.  I was scared out of my mind. He was standing in the darkened bathroom when I walked in.  All I could do was grab my purse and my personal belongings and run out the room as fast as I could. 

The butler took all of of our clothes out my suitcase, and hid my wallet in the suitcase.   Our safe was opened when I walked in.  After a thorough investigation, Security reports showed that the Butler entered our room 3 times that day without permission while we were at the Spa and at the pool.

To make matters worse, after I reported the incident to the Royal Service Manager, Lazaro Asencio, and to the head of Security, and they did nothing!  They kept asking us not the share our experience with any of the other guests or employees.

After hotel Security verified that the thief took place at the hotel, they did nothing.  They promised that they would terminate the Butler, but he is still working there.

In addition, the Security team and Management promised to email us a formal report about the incident which we never received.

Please be careful if you choose to stay at Paradius Cancun.  The hotel Butler who we trusted when we checked into the hotel could have panicked when I walked in on him in our room, and he could have killed me in that room.  Please, please, please be careful if you decide to stay at Paradius Cancun in Mexico.

reviews.author: HonestCanuck
reviews.title: If this is Paradise, please give me Hell
reviews.text: Never having been to an all-inclusive, this first foray is reason enough to never again repeat.  The hotel is dated.  Burning inscence is understandable from time to time, but can't help but wonder if the inscence was used to cover up the odor of college co-eds and on-the-cheap snow birds.  My partner and I booked last minute and paid a bundle - $10 000 Canadian for one week.  A complete joke from beginning to end.  I love Cancun, and the people, but this hotel is a disaster.  I couldn't help but think it was born out of a sad fantasy hybrid of The Love Boat and Fantasy Island. The food is mediocre at best.  The service is little better.  Kids abound.  Cancun has so many great resorts...this isn't one of them.

reviews.author: Justice666
reviews.title: Terrible experience. Super disappointed and regret. Waste money and time.
reviews.text:
DO NOT STAY at Paradisus Cancun! You will be wasting you money and time while receiving disappointment. It is a lot worse than a 4.5 star hotel.

Here are the reasons:

1. Super Bad Service: The hotel staff are showing very unwelcoming and impatient attitude, unless you tipping them. The dinner restaurants were hard to book, so mostly of the time we had to eat at the buffet or outside the hotel. This is not convenient for ppl who want to relax and enjoy their vacation.

2. Slow Check-in: It took us at least 1.5 hours to do the check-in and get the room key. The staff pushed us to accept a room near the noisy restaurants, otherwise we had to wait another 30 mins for the other room to be cleaned.

3. Aggressive Sales of the Hotel Membership: We were invited to so-called 'a tour of the hotel', but it was totally a lie, which wasted us almost 4 hours in the morning. In fact, they were trying to sell a $43K USD membership to us. When we refused to buy it, they still kept pushing. They even said that we were giving excuses to them and joked that they will kick us out from the hotel. 

4. Money Gone: One day, we left $5USD on our bed to thank the maid for cleaning up the room. When we went back at 3pm, the room was still uncleaned, but the money was gone!!! Obviously, someone other than the maid had come to our room and took the money. It was so ridiculous and unacceptable.

5. Food is tasteless and low quality. Drinks are watery.

My husband and I went to Paradisus Cancun to celebrate our 1st Anniversary. Our trip got ruined by this hotel. We will never return and won't recommend our friends and family to come.

This is not our first time visiting Cancun. With this price, you deserve a hotel with much better ocean view, facilities, service and food.

Hope my review can help you avoid mistake.

reviews.author: misterkeene
reviews.title: Don't get hurt at this resort.  Your on your own
reviews.text:
We have traveled extensively internationally especial in the Caribbean.  We have never thought about the consequences about being injured at one of these resorts until now.  A member of our family broke their wrist at this resort and we received no help from any of the staff members or resort officials. We literally had to call a cab to transport the injured family member to the hospital because the resort refused to do so.

The resort never made any inquire as to how this person was doing (she had to fly back to the states the next day to receive adequate care)  There all smiles though when you order a drink.  Just don't have anything serious that's need attending to.

One other thing about an injury or illness when travelling internationally.  Your health insurance does not cover you.  You will have to pay all fees out of pocket and then attempt to be reimbursed from your insurance company.

Unfortunately given this experience we certainly will never visit this resort chain again and probably will not travel outside the U.S. again.

reviews.author: Vidabr
reviews.title: No shower , etc,...
reviews.text:
We arrived  28 of August 2015 
The Check in was slow but , fine can give 3 stars.
Time To have  our Rooms get in this line,.. On other line ,... Wait, No , no, that other line and just get true line again ,...again

reviews.author: samira s
reviews.title: Terrible experience , very disappointed !
reviews.text: Nothing good I can say about this hotel . Hotel is very dark , rooms are terrible and nothing works(plugs, AC, shower ,...) and the biggest problem was the noise .. Our room was too noisy at night so non of us could get a sleep and that ruined our all next day with kids being so tired ... Even after we changed our room it was the same . NO RELAXATION ... I'm very disappointed .... Service is terrible . I told all my friends about this worst experience at Paradisus and don't want any of my loved ones go through what we went . It was supposed to be a relax and fun vacation .

reviews.author: ExpertLuxuryTraveler
reviews.title: Disapointing!
reviews.text:
Poor!  Dirty room, very old, bad food quality, VERY BAD SERVICE, very rude staff. 
Not friendly with strollers or wheel chairs. 
Not a five star hotel like they say. Not worth to pay, there are much more better hotels in Cancun for the price. 
Have to fight to get something even that its all inclusive. 
Good quality of alcohol.

reviews.author: ARTURO G
reviews.title: Horrible Air Conditioning
reviews.text:
Im still ay the hotel. The simple fact that the A.C hasnt Been working since se got here a week ago makes this stay one Of our worst ones. It really clouds all the good service they have. It is imposible to have a good nights sleep like this. 
We have tired ourselves Of reporting it and though they try to fix it. They havent been able to.

reviews.author: pjgbb
reviews.title: Don't Get Fooled By "Royal Service"
reviews.text: My husband and I wanted to go back to Cancun since we hadn't been in 10 years.  I researched and booked an "all inclusive" room with Royal service (Butler), ocean view luxury junior suite.  One would have assumed this would be an amazing experience and beautiful view of the gorgeous ocean, but that was not the case and had to take a smaller room for the view.  We had the rudest, most unpleasant concierge named Ludicia.  We do not speak Spanish and asked for staff that could understand us, especially our butler.  Galdino, our butler was very sweet, but the language barrier proved to be too large for asking for services.  We stayed continually lost on the property and continued to tell the concierge that we were lost, but were not assisted or given any kind of tour.  There is one pool with a bar and it is the family pool and the water is filthy.  The adult pool is clean, but very warm.  We did get bar service in the pool, but remember to tip in cash so they keep coming back.  The "resort credit" offered is a joke since we were only able to use 2 coupons equal to $60.00 total out of the $550.00 promised to us and were told by this same concierge that is just the way it is.  We were in the all adult section and given coupons for children's services!  We wanted wine in our room instead of liquor and were told also that it was not an option, but after pushing it and asking for the manager were told that we could have up to 4 bottles of house wine (not all at one time mind you) and that all liquor would be removed out of our room first.  Ice machines never had ice and we couldn't seem to have it in our room as asked so that we didn't have to go hunting for it.  The spa put me in a room with their room with "special waters" and just left me, no instructions or communication as to where my husband was since we were waiting to get our couples massage.   When we went to dinner at La Palapa we were told that we had to purchase wine by the bottle and that it was not included in the all inclusive.  After talking to the manager and explaining we were all inclusive and just wanted the house wine by the glass, were we able to have a drink.  The guest that spoke Spanish were treated so much better than those of us who do not.  We were relieved when the trip was over and we didn't have to be so upset and stressed out every day.

reviews.author: Ramirez, Juan R
reviews.title: Lies
reviews.text:
Very dessapointed, was quoted  91.00 per person for the all inclusive trough rci and they charged me $159.00 pp. when asked why.??? They just blame each other and neither one fixed it. Also had a very small room with a view o the parking lot, the only way someone would have listen to me is if I would have committed myself to one of their sale presentations, which Mi did not want to waste my time for.
It is ashamed because I have been here before and everything was great,
It just seems that they are getting greedy 
Won't be back to this hotel again !!!!!!!!!

reviews.author: Kim C
reviews.title: a NIGHTMARE
reviews.text: This mammoth hotel should have been great. It was a nightmare. I was ripped off multiple times, talked about in Spanish by staff thinking I didn't understand. My room had a leak. I was robbed again for a towel deposit that end of day the hotel denied knowing. I asked for a shot at the bar and bartender didn't understand. Cancun has become too touristy attracting scammers like Rome. I finally understood kissing the ground arriving home. Luckily I found tulum, my new favorite place close to how much I loved Maui but I can't do 14 hours on a plane now. So tulum it is. Not only is it easy communicating since they speak English, but it's all about the beauty of paradise , serenity, tranquility, and value. I did a retreat all inclusive called life source retreats and can't rave enough. It opened mexico back up to me.

reviews.author: Rajesh J
reviews.title: Biting more than they can chew
reviews.text: Staying here , place is really cool . But they have too many guests and aren't able to handle it . It's become to mechanical and doesn't relax you . Disparity in services and access to common areas for normal and royal service guest is not cool . The staff tries very hard to accommodate the guest . The management should make a note of this , as it should give value for the money as propagated on the marketing peripherals .

reviews.author: lauraH7111IG
reviews.title: horrible check-in process.
reviews.text:
Traveled with my spouse.  Our check-in process was so bad it colored our entire stay.  Told there were no more rooms with king beds, only rooms with 2 double beds. They wouldn't refund any of our money. Talking to the manager resulted in the same apathy. No attempt was made to provide quality customer service. Other couples in our group had the same issue.  The worst example was a couple refused the handicap accessible room they had requested 6 months in advance of our visit.  
Those first few hours were so unnecessarily stressful and disappointing that we will never come back.  
Pros: The property is gorgeous.  The Mexican restaurant in the hotel is great, but it took us 3 days to get in due to the inefficient reservation process others have already explained in detail.

reviews.author: Shrutishah75
reviews.title: Horrible time and regret staying here!
reviews.text:
I had the worst time at this hotel. Terrible experience and would recommend a no no for anyone looking to unwind and relax. 
First and foremost I had confirmed reservation for an ocean view room. When I walked in I was totally shocked at my so called ocean view as I could only see the facade of the hotel's other block.I called up my agent to check on this. After sometime I get a message saying that I was wrongly allocated the room and would shift me to another room next day. 
Next day to my good luck I had a tour and I was out from this chaotic hotel the whole day. Before checking out I confirmed my room change and they allocated me a room which has better view but would only give it to me by late afternoon. That was fine with me as I was out the whole day. Upon arrival at night 11pm I went to the concierge for the new keys and i was surprised to know that they have given another room and not the one confirmed in the morning. They said it's a better view room. Oh ya before I forget the first room had torn curtains too! When I went to my so called new room I was frustrated with the loud music that came from one of the restaurants and upon inquiring i was informed that the music will be on till 2pm!! I just couldn't sleep at all with the loud irritating party music. 
Next day I had again an early morning tour and returned back by 5.15pm. Wanted to dine at one of the restaurants which needs reservation. So I called up the concierge to connect me to the restaurant as I wanted to make a reservation. After 5mins of hold i was connected to the restaurant and to my surprise I was told that they only take reservation till 5pm ! I requested them if they could manage one booking however they coldly replied that their system shuts at 5pm and they can't do anything about it. It's ridiculous and their cold and unwelcoming attitude really put me off. This is definitely not what is expected from the hospitality industry.
I have travelled a lot and for me a place where the customer is not treated with warmth and care is definitely in my bad books. 
So my personal recommendation is no for this place. The place is crowded with loud lobby music which I could hear on 4th floor.
The picture is of my so called ocean view room!

reviews.author: daniel d
reviews.title: This hotel leaks like a rusty submarine when it rains.
reviews.text:
Unfortunately it rained throughout our stay and we understand the hotel has not control over the weather; however, this hotel leaks like a rusty submarine out of every window, door, roof, ceiling and air vent when it rains. Each of the five buildings leaked. Every hallway, bar, restaurant and common area had water leaking all over the floors that were covers in wet smelly towels and so did our room.  Our room flooded multiple days in a row and there was water leaking into the restaurants and lounges. 
We just came back (June 2015) and our room kept flooding throughout our stay. Despite reporting the issue over 10 times there was no proactive repair or monitoring of the problem and we had to keep calling for water to be shoveled out of our room. Five times (including at 1am) on my 40th birthday and 4 times the next day. Awful stay, awful experience. 
All they would do for us would be to replace the wet towels on the floors to soak up water leaking through our 4th floor balcony doors, our air vents and coming in from the hallway. 
At the buffet, the ground floor of an 8-9 floor building, water was leaking out of the ceiling onto the food and our plates as we walked though. The hotel made it seem like this was the first time this happened but we found reviews from 2013 and 2014 regarding this same issue. There is no way we would rate this hotel a 4 star. This stay was awful.  One cannot help think that mold may be an issue in this hotel with all of this water damage and leaks (especially in such a tropical climate). 
The only accommodation they made for us was a bottle of tequila that was not included on the top shelf all inclusive.  Tequila in Mexico, what a stretch. 
I would avoid this place like the plague. 
The hotel also has a bunch of activities daily outside; however, since it rained during our stay there was nothing to do during the day. And at night we walked onto wet towels at every bar and lounge with water dripping off the ceiling onto us and into our drinks.
We paid for the “Royal Service” treatment and our room was flooded, the elevator in the building was broken for days, every other place in the hotel had we slippery floors with wet smelly towels on the floor, there were no indoor activities to do during the day, the Royal Service only lounge is outdoors so it was rained out and the staff seemed ill equipped for the rain despite multiple reviews about this problem over the years.
I was totally grossed out and I am attaching videos and pictures to show how awful this truly was.  If the hotel reads this, you ruined my 40th birthday.

reviews.author: Graham O
reviews.title: This is a 3*hotel at best and only because of its wonderful location, pool and beach. Both of us got food poisoning the
reviews.text:
This is a 3*hotel at best and only because of its wonderful location, pool and beach. Both of us got food poisoning the first week and we had to resort to take away pizza after day 3 even though we had to pay extortionate prices for all-inclusive.I would NEVER EVER Return to this nightmare hotel even if my flights and everything else was paid for! We got hassled for at least 4 hours by Club Melia to buy into their 50 year holiday offers even though we had already purchased one in Teneriffe last year.Their message was very clear. European Club Melia Members were second class citizens, and i certainly believe it the way we were treated by them here in Cancun.Unfortunately this hotel and Club Melia  has put us off ever travelling to Cancun or the Carribean again. At present our room is flooded in both 
bathrooms, sitting room and bedroom and their are no maids available to dry or sort out. All windows in hotel leak water in very heavily and there are buckets /towels (in their thousands) scattered throughout restaurants bars, lobbies, hallways etc. Disaster Holiday (meant to be a dream). Thank you Club Melia NOT!!!

reviews.author: Ted S
reviews.title: Be Treated Like You Didn't Spend $300+ a Night
reviews.text: Absolutely horrific service. Nice Rooms, Pool and Beach, but the common areas are terribly hot and service is so bad. If you are a male, expect to be ignored by bartenders unless you tip every single time (not so all inclusive).

reviews.author: Walter M
reviews.title: False Advertising
reviews.text: My girlfriend and I spent 5 nights at the Paradisus Cancun, although it was a beautiful resort with friendly staff, the restaurants and hotel manager receive a thumbs down. One of the reasons we chose the Paradisus Cancun was because of the numerous restaurants and bars that they offer. Upon our arrival and meeting with the concierge we were informed that there were 2 restaurants already closed for the week and another one that is not included in the all inclusive. On the second day a 3rd  restaurant was closed for the week. Every morning we would wake up early and make our dinner reservations for the day only to find out that the only options available were usually 6pm and 10pm for most restaurants. Even though a majority of the restaurants had seating available we were still unable to sit down. On the second day we made reservations and when we arrived we were told that we were not on the list and could not get a table. The following night we sat down at Bana for dinner at 7:30pm and ordered drinks and appetizers, 9:30 quickly approached and dinner was still not served, we ended up leaving and going to the Buffett. The restaurants at the Paradisus Cancun are not accommodating at all. I decided to speak with the hotel manager and see if something could be done only to find out she was extremely uncooperative, and bordering the inappropriate line for customer service. She offered no solutions to the problem and told us to have a nice day. Since we had such a negative experience with the restaurants and the Managers lack of concern for our issue we will not be returning to the Paradisus Cancun. This resort is not worth the price of an all inclusive. We also will not be recommending this resort to anyone. We travel quite frequently and all over the world and this resort does not stand up to the reputation and image that they try to portray.

reviews.author: Daniel R
reviews.title: Awful for children!
reviews.text: This hotel was horrible.  We needed to switch hotels because it was so bad.  We couldn't even get patio furniture.  I wanted to sit outside on the balcony when my kids were sleeping and they said they couldn't get us furniture because it was there busy season.  That was the icing on the cake.  Of course, once we said we wanted to leave, they brought furniture.  The restaurants are not kid friendly, nor is the facility.  You need to go down a ton of stairs to the pool and even more to the beach.  We did family concierge which was a big waste.  They had no toys except some cars.  We were also supposed to have turn down service with cookies and milk for the kids, but that never happened.  The food we got from room service was disgusting.  The staff would just say we will look into it about our complaints.  We left after one night and went to Club Med which was amazing and so great for our kids.

reviews.author: Kina G
reviews.title: Not the same Paradisus
reviews.text: Let me start by saying this is our 5th year staying at this resort, we actually considered buying a timeshare at on one point, which is no longer the case after this past stay. It all started at check in when we got our room and the air conditioner wasn't working not to mention the extremely long amount of time it took them to check us in. They said our reservation number wasn't correct and they couldn't find us, gave us a room where the keys did not work and then had the wrong names on our room which made it impossible to make dinner reservations. After about 2 days we go the room name and number situated but after multiple reports of the broken air conditioner and random men walking in and out of our room they NEVER fixed it so we went without the entire stay. Their solution was we could upgrade for $500 and get a new room which we decided not to do. Then to make matters worse we had to go outside before sunrise to even get a spot at the pool because they didn't have enough chairs for the guests staying there.We had to set our alarm for 6am every morning just to get a spot.  We were then told that if we left our towels on the chair for more than 30 minutes they would take our stuff which they did to multiple guests! They took towels, their lotions and whatever else they had and dumped them into a rolling bin. Needless to say my  husband and I could not eat together for breakfast because they would take our chairs away form us at the pool. This brings me to the next problem that breakfast took so  long because no one would bring you anything to drink, they made you sit and wait for 15-20 minutes before they even asked about coffee. The next issue was making dinner reservations, they would put you on hold and never come back and then you couldn't get reservations because they were booked. I didn't spend almost $3000 to eat at a buffet with screaming kids and cockroaches on the floor, yes cockroaches. We finally just showed up at a restaurant and told them we wanted to be seated. Then 15 minutes after that they started spraying for bugs a few feet away fro where we were having dinner.  We went out to eat in cancun just to get a break from trying to get a reservation etc. at the hotel.  It was almost impossible to even get toilet paper and kleenex for our room, so much so that my husband would hide the toilet paper in the safe with hopes they would give us a new roll because if there was one square left they wouldn't replace it. I have never had to beg for toilet paper on vacation in my life!! Then the last day the maid was outside of our room waiting at 11:50 am to clean since checkout was at noon, they wouldn't give us another minute in the room because they over booked

reviews.author: Denise W
reviews.title: Wouldn't return
reviews.text: For the money not worth the hassle.  Too much work on my part staying there.  Had to track down towels and get chairs by the crack of dawn.  Staff were all friendly and Paola was amazing.  Just felt like a lot of work and not enough relaxing.  Booked through Expedia and although they were located in the hotel it was just too hard to get anything done without having to keep going back and back when they weren't busy.  Not how I want to spend a vacation.  Would stay elsewhere.

reviews.author: Alexander S
reviews.title: Do not go to Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
The Air Conditionar doesn't work, and the beds are not good. 
The beach is very nice, but my kids wanted to be in the pool all the time, and there are never pool chairs available, and for the Bali Chairs you have to pay $50 extra per day. Come on!!!

reviews.author: MChNY
reviews.title: Horrendous! Go to Riu if you want luxury with nice staff.
reviews.text: Let me start by saying ive come to cancun many many times, and im not overly picky but i like to get at least some nice service when i come to stay in a hotel that has such great reviews. I was beyond dissapointed, i dragged my whole family to stay in this hotel to "try something new" boy was i wrong. The rooms were dingy and small, the ac didnt work right it kept blowing right on our heads so we had to switch rooms, its not much better but whatever. Theres NEVER ANY CHAIRS AND BEDS available, i mean we have to get up at 5am to get a seat and even then, theres nothing available. The food is tasteless no matter where u go here. And lastly the staff is nasty!!! They dont care, neither do they ever offer any assistance or anything that has to do with service. Just an example, my sister asked for a certain smoothie at breakfast and the girl told her oh no no thats not gonna be good and refused to make it, like what? Who does that. Stay at ANY RIU HOTELS, they are so sweet there and the food is amazing, and the beach beds are always available because they stock up knowing no guest should be inconvenienced like that on their vacation. I regret bringing my family here to this pathetic, overly huge and humid jungled lobby, bad service hotel.

reviews.author: Samantha M
reviews.title: Bad Birthday
reviews.text: When I arrived at the paradisus I was so excited to be there I did not notice the lack of champagne, my room was not ready so we had to wait over a hour to get in, i was told i was upgraded to a ocean view! When we finally got to the room i took my show of to relax. I noticed my feet were black after on dirty marble floor.... Clearly my room  was not clean. I was expecting royal service... I wasn't even in  royal service pyramid!!! I was told on my birthday i was receiving a surprise (cake and balloons) my surprise was dirty makeup brushes that looked like the maid cleaned with them. We had my birthday dinner in the "fancy" dress code required restaurant and there was no code enforced, there was a man with sandals and sorts! I do not want to see feet when I'm wearing a gown! The best part is our last day we were at the Royal service pool on our Bali bed, we went to the tanning pool for 10 minutes and someone stole $$ and beach trinquets from our bed...classless... Not expected in royal service! The reception told us they couldn't call security for 15 minutes. I gross waste of money and a awful way to spend a birthday!!!

reviews.author: Kim C
reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.text:
We came here for a family vacation and upgraded to the family concierge service. The hotel itself was disappointing and the extra service package was a complete waste of money.  

To start, our room had a sliding glass door and a good size patio (presumably to make up for the tiny room) but there was no furniture on the patio which rendered it useless. When we inquired we were told that most of the furniture was being used by the pool because it was high season and even if our patio had furniture, the furniture would consist of only one chair. What good is a patio without furniture?

Our minibar was supposed to be restocked everyday and we had to call several times to make that happen. Getting towels was another ordeal. We had two rooms next to each other and the hotel staff couldn't seem to get the service straight for either room.  We killed a cockroach in one of the rooms. As far as food, the buffet was good but the other restaurants were terrible. Other than the buffet, we didn't have a good meal here. 

There are several other complaints (including lack of service even though we paid to have a family butler) but suffice it to say that I would not recommend this hotel and we won't be staying here again. There are far better resorts willing to take your money.

reviews.author: kerenbd
reviews.title: Not satisfied
reviews.text: The to stay at this hotel wasn't pleasant at all. Service was bad food was bad, very loud, we were having dinner at the sushi place couldn't hear each other that was music there that was so loud with the sender that was so bad it just ruined  the all evening. We had to walk to the restaurant for every meal we needed very uncomfortable. Don't recommend this hotel

reviews.author: drvlaan
reviews.title: Disappointment Around Every Corner
reviews.text:
The first of many disappointments started when we were overbooked at our original resort, Paradisus Playa del Carmen, and relocated to the Cancun Paradisus resort.

Check In: Front desk staff was less than helpful with compensating us for our problems with relocating, as we had to travel a round trip from Cancun Airport to Playa del Carmen (50 minutes) and back to Cancun with a 14 month old. And then on top of everything, we were overcharged by $4,000 and took all week to get answers for a refund...again taking up ALOT of our time. 

Accommodations: Basic room/furnishings as you would expect to see in a Holiday Inn. 'Stocked' minibar includes canned beer/soda/water and junk food snacks. Room service was exceptionally slow, even for simple orders of yogurt and soy mild for our toddler. There was no furniture on the balcony and when asked at the front desk, they responded, "we ran out". So yes, we had a wonderful balcony all week that we could not make use of. Housekeeping: no turn down service, towels were not replaced, 3 washcloths for a one bedroom unit with 3 adults & a toddler, and rooms not left clean. The pull out couch into a bed had a mattress as thin as a sleeping bag. We ended up getting a roll away bed and adding the couch cushion on top of it...still terribly uncomfortable for the week. Highly disappointed with the 1-bedroom unit, not worth the extra money as you get no 'extras'. Would have been better off, and cheaper, with a basic/studio room with 2 beds. The 'personal concierge' service was a ridiculous waste of time. 

Restaurants: All food choices were far from 'kid friendly'. No food choices/menu for children. We asked for chicken strips & fries most nights, which came 45 minutes later. Yes, 45 minutes for a few chicken strips and french fries. Restaurant food was par, but the meal was ruined once we had to wait 45 minutes for our child's food. Drinks were usually pretty good. Buffets were terrible and repetitive.

Beach/pool: The one and only enjoyable part of the stay was the beach/pool. Although, there was limited areas of pool space for a toddler (no splash pad or wadding pool), we made due. 

Free Wi-Fi was available, but with limited accessibility. It only worked in the rooms and restaurants and lost service once you stepped outside the resort walls (no service at the pools/beach). 

Unfortunately the staff has to work at such a disappointing resort, as they were friendly and attentive. Not sure how this resort has received the accreditations is has. As being an RCI member, it is far below their standards. We could not be paid enough to return to this resort. We will not be returning or recommending it to anyone.

reviews.author: Walker14
reviews.title: Don’t get fooled by the Paradisus corporate name as the hotel standards are very different from one to another.
reviews.text:
Having been last year at the Paradisus Playa del Carmen, Mexico, for a couple of weeks we decided this year to try the Paradisus in Cancun. After all it is the same hotel brand name so we expected the same quality of installations, services and food. The results were the extreme opposite, from the check-in time to the check-out. The hotel mainly catered to people between 20 to 40 years of age while we were there, mostly South Americans (Brazilian, Argentinian and Colombian), few Americans and Mexicans and fewer Canadians and Russians. All in all, a nice mixture of cultures. 
The following are the great and poor observations:
The great
We were in Mexico.
We got the superb service from the Mexican workers and with a smile.
The poor
At check-in we were told that it makes no difference whether you’re at the hotel 1 day or 2 weeks. Once the room has been assigned to you, if you don’t like it that’s too bad. That response is contrary to what happened at Paradisus Playa del Carmen (or any other hotel when you go for that length of time) where we were given a great room for the two weeks. At this time we were told that the hotel had very strict rules and that the other Paradisus might have more relaxed rules.
The hotel is divided in 5 sections with section 3 being the largest (about 200 rooms). If you’re assigned to this building be prepared to be discomfort from about 7 PM to 3 AM. Most of the restaurants, disco, bars and nightly performances are in the middle of this hollow building. The music is very loud as so are the guests shouting on the corridors. I am providing a tip picture on how to insulate the door from the noise generated during the mentioned times.
The hotel building is very large taking most of the property ground. The recreational areas are very limited perhaps less than 150 ft wide between the building and beach. This area has two large pools and a bar leaving very small room for chairs and walk ways.
There are many stairs to go to the pool or beach that I would not recommend for younger children or older adults.
The beach is perfect for a picture as it is beautiful. The problem is that a red flag is up every day due to ocean roughness along with a very strong undertow. Few people go on the water. The life guards had a big job rescuing guests while we were there.
Cabanas (or palapas as called there) are very few for such a huge hotel, about 60 of them for a hotel with over 1700 guess. What that means is that either you get up at 7 AM to reserve one or you will be on the sun all day. Due to the shortage of shade, it prompted other guests to occupy unattended cabanas creating tension in paradise.
Food quality at the restaurants was nothing to brag about, just ok, as it was with the buffet. The buffet area was also very small and crowded. During our first 4 days the quality of the food was far superior than the remaining days. Perhaps it was due to the extra money we had to pay in comparison to the following weeks in January. Drinks quality was excellent.
Room cleaning was done after 4 PM for our area and we thought it was too late since we were at the beach from 7 AM. Half the time the cleaning would not be done as we were already back in the room by 4 PM and we did not feel to go out for another 45 minutes. A request to have the room done earlier was not in their cards. 
Music at the pool and beach was “head banger” type that kept going for hours. Between the poor music and some cigar smokers it made the outdoor time quite unpleasant.
Restaurant reservations, was a challenge. We were told at check-in to go to the service desk on a daily basis or to phone call to reserve the restaurant time for the next day. The problem is that most of the time the service rep would not be at the desk and no notice was provided. If you tried to call the number provided, many times nobody would answer.
An annoying thing is that the hotel management did not really care whether you were happy during your stay or not, since we got numerous calls during our two weeks trying to sell us their Club Melia timeshare vacations. It seems that if we e.g. (join Club Melia) and spend more money with them the problems we were having would go away immediately.
Conclusion. It seems that the Melia group of hotels, have major issues when branding their hotels names. If I would’ve known that the Paradisus Cancun was going to be so different than from the Playa del Carmen, I would have never reserved it. I also think that logistically the Melia group has major problems that need resolved to better care for their guests.
If you feel like an evening stroll there is nothing in the vicinity. You may take the bus R1 or R2 and go to Plaza La Isla or Plaza Caracol, both have nice ambiance either during the day or late evening. Bus is 10.5 pesos or $1 US.
My special thanks to Sofonia for his great service and conversation, making our staying more enjoyable.
I rated this hotel a 1 due to the misleading corporate name Paradisus that does not keep consistent standards and I feel I wasted a lot of money for little enjoyment, otherwise I would have rated it a 3.

reviews.author: k h
reviews.title: What a disappointment!
reviews.text: If you don't mind sub-par service, and poor food at an expensive price point, then this vacation is for you.  They put the "fun" in dysfunctional.  Cancun is beautiful.  The property itself is not bad.  But it lacks from any direction.  Lines, Lines, and more lines!  Book elsewhere.

reviews.author: Kit-healey
reviews.title: Very,very disappointing
reviews.text: We stayed at moon palace for 7nights,but had to move for 4. After coming from such an amazing hotel to the paradisus I wish we had gone home. Tired rooms, a workman sanding down the dirty wall in our corridor, waiting around on other staff members timetable. The only time we enjoyed ourselves was when we left. It should be 3 1/2 stars- do not waste your money staying here

reviews.author: Cab0c00k
reviews.title: My first trip to Cancun and I won't stay here again
reviews.text:
Our rating of this hotel was actually less than a 1 star.  Here is our review:

We scheduled a timeshare stay at the Paradisus after reviewing hotels online.   My husband and I have traveled many places but it was our first time in Cancun and we were really looking forward to it.  Arrived and was immediately escorted to a building at the far end of the hotel (Pyramid 1) to check in and was immediately scheduled the next morning for a timeshare review.  This check in and scheduling for the following morning was polite but  took over an hour and 1/2 and I was tired from the trip.  We checked into the hotel room assigned in Pyramid 2 (It was Hurricane Season and the hotel wasn't full) and was in a room looking at the Pyramid 1 tower.  "Why did we get this room?" I asked since the hotel was not fully booked.  Complained to management and finally moved into another room facing the ocean for $100 more a day into Pyramid 2.  

A typhoon was coming over the Yucatan peninsula and our new room flooded.  We called Housekeeping to request towels or something to help the water, but the hotel didn't bring in towels so we used the ones in the bathroom so we didn't slip on the wet floor.  The book about what the hotel offers as its service and luxury spa on site that was in our hotel room, stated we were supposed to have turn down service every night.  Nothing for the first 3 days.  The hotel book says that guests receive a free gift upon arrival. Us?  Nothing.  The sheets on the bed didn't fit and it was like being short-sheeted.

Out of the 7 restaurants, only 4 were open and of those 4 only 2 were open for breakfast and lunch.  The other 2 were only open at dinner time and the one only service tacos.   The food at the Buffet line was tepid warm. No steam tables at this place to keep the food warm.  When we complained about the food to the management, the Hotel Room Manager said, "I eat there every day" and acted indignant as if I offended her.  She eats there for free, I'm on vacation and had paid for an All-Inclusive package.  The Hotel site doesn't say anything about the restaurants being closed or specifically what food is not included.   The room service refused to deliver ANY alcohol to the room to eat with a meal even though we paid for the All-inclusive package.  The only snacks in the room were a bag of chips and a 6 pack of oreo's.  No crackers, no fresh fruit    (mangos, local fruit), no local Mayan Chocolate, nothing! 

Our trip was during off-season, not a full hotel and the Cabana's on the beach were still were being offered to us for $100 a day...that's even during a typhoon?   I paid over a $1,000 dollars per person for an all inclusive package.  We mainly ate at the buffet since the other restaurants were closed.  Finally for the last night I ordered a lobster tail for dinner.  It was fantastic but this was not offered in our All-Inclusive package.  I couldn't eat or drink enough of what they offered to make up the cost for what I thought I was paying for.  I talked to other people staying in other parts of the hotel, and they were given primo service, balloons for celebrations, drinks delivered, etc, etc.  My husband and I truly felt we were the LOWLY GUEST TIMESHARE PEOPLE (Pyramid 2). Not even placed into Pyramid 1 where the Guests of Paradisus Timeshare stay or allowed to stay with coffee, drinks, food offered or in the Adult Only part of the hotel (Pyramid 3 &4) and I offered to pay for the upgrade when we checked in but were told no.  

The ONLY saving grace was the humbleness and kindness of most everyone that worked at the Paradisus.  

We may return to Cancun but will definitely not stay at this hotel.  If you stay here, I hope your stay will be better than the one we had.  I doubt the hotel will read this and I truly doubt that the hotel will make any effort to comp us for anything.  About the ratings:  Service at the restaurants were great but he Hotel Management service was terrible..  The Location of the hotel was great!

reviews.author: MichaelPGallagher
reviews.title: Very unhappy with Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: When we arrived we were told there was no room available even though we paid in full 6 months prior to arrival and bookit.com confirmed reservation the day prior to arrival. We were informed that we could be moved to another property called ME, which was a adult orientated resort. We informed the girl at the desk by the name of Guadalupe that we did not think that was sufficient since we were travelling with our children. She continued to argue with us that there was no room and that we had no other option but to stay at ME for over an hour. We refused to accept this offer and insisted we speak with a manager. We also told her we would be contacting the travel agent and will not be providing a favorable review. She stepped away for 15 minute and then came back to inform us that there was an early checkout and there was a room available but we would need to wait 2 hours for them to clean it. When we got to the room 3.5 hours after we arrived, the room was not what we expected. There was just two beds and a small table in the corner. No pull out couch. There was also a puddle of water in the hallway as the A/C was leaking. We called maintenance to fix, which they did and it took 1 hour. During the next two days we discovered that the room had many issues including mold in the bathroom, bugs, the sliding door to the patio was broken, the shower curtain rod was broken and hanging out of the wall. We took photos of all these issues and reported them to the staff. 2 days after staying there the shower stopped working. My wife went down to the front desk and complained and was told by the desk that they would look for another room for us. She told us that she would call us at our room within 20 minutes. 1.5 hours later we did not hear from anyone and went down to the desk and found that the girl had left for the day and had not spoken to anyone about the issue. We then explained our issue to a girl named Alejandra who said she would speak to her manager. We went to eat dinner and when we returned she had another room for us.we received no apologies or acceptance of blame. We came to this resort to unwind and enjoy a vacation, but instead we were extremely upset and stressed out for almost half of our vacation. We were also chased down by the resort after check-in and were told they had a welcome package for us, which we found out was only a ploy to try to get us to sit through a presentation to purchase a vacation package. Based on our experiences, we will never stay with the chain of resorts again, nor would we recommend them to anyone.

reviews.author: Bobbine
reviews.title: Royal PAIN!!
reviews.text:
Wow, were we ever disappointed!!! We have been to this resort before when it was Gran Melia, and we have enjoyed it. So we decided to make our way back here as they "upgraded" to Paradisus. Well, they certainly, 100% didn't make things better... We paid so much more for a much worse experience! The food was worse, and the service was horrible. They probably didn't upgrade all the staff so same people trying to give an illusion of a better 5 star experience.

We also booked the so-called Royal Service as we truly wanted good service and great food and just a relaxing - and for our first time - a more luxurious stay. But it was more like a Royal PAIN. The better food they claimed to have, was the same as from the general buffet just served different so it seemed as if you were getting fancier food. And don't even get me started on the room service. They said on the phone it would take 1 hour, well 1 hour and 30 minutes later the food arrived, completely cold. And as you can see on the pictures: store bought pizza button and plain hard pasta. WOW!

We also had our own butler in Royal Service. You are supposed to make dinner reservations etc through him. Well, the first day we asked him to book a dinner, he said we couldn't get the restaurant we wanted (even though royal service guests are supposed to have first choice). Funny enough we decided to just go to the restaurant at dinner time and ask if they had any tables. Sure enough around five available.
He was also supposed to book our own bali bed outside and second day he promised one on the beach. That didn't happen either.. Around 5 times we called him for something, no answer..
We went to the pool one day after breakfast stayed for four hours, returned, room wasn't made up, we asked them to do it, returned 1 and a half hour later, still not made. What royal service..

We also had our power (just in our room) go out. Took them 45 minutes to send someone, meanwhile we sat in the dark in our room.

And oh yes it was our honeymoon! When we told them this at check-in they said "we will do something special for you". Well, maybe this special thing was to give us two double beds instead of the king size we booked and treat us badly all stay. 
My husband had to carry our own luggage up three flights of stairs at check out.. What a "royal" treat. 

We are not fancy people at all, but when we go out of our way to pay extra for an amazing experience for such an important occasion, it is gutting to get what we got.

If the Caribbean hadn't been gorgeous that week, they would have ruined our honeymoon completely.

reviews.author: Vetusya
reviews.title: Stay away!
reviews.text: Worst experience ever. No air conditioning anywhere besides lobby. Poor service, horrible food . Cant really mention a single thing that was ok.
